bestiary.goblin.name: Goblin
bestiary.goblin.title: Shadow Pillager
bestiary.goblin.lore: Small, cowardly creatures that attack in hordes. Alone they pose little danger, but their sheer numbers can overwhelm even the most prepared defenders.
bestiary.goblin_archer.name: Goblin Archer
bestiary.goblin_archer.title: Petty Sharpshooter
bestiary.goblin_archer.lore: Armed with crude bows fashioned from branches and rat sinew, these goblins prefer striking from a distance. Their aim is terrible, but the sheer volume of arrows compensates.
bestiary.goblin_assassin.name: Goblin Assassin
bestiary.goblin_assassin.title: Blade in the Dark
bestiary.goblin_assassin.lore: Trained in the shadows of the Gob'Zarak caverns, the Goblin Assassin is swift and lethal. Few see it before feeling the cold iron of its claws.
bestiary.goblin_mage.name: Goblin Mage
bestiary.goblin_mage.title: Apprentice of Chaos
bestiary.goblin_mage.lore: Stole a tome of magic from a sleeping wizard. Understands half the spells at best, but the ones that work cause enough destruction to terrify allies and enemies alike.
bestiary.goblin_shaman.name: Goblin Shaman
bestiary.goblin_shaman.title: Voice of the Green Spirits
bestiary.goblin_shaman.lore: The Goblin Shaman communes with the ancestral spirits of fallen goblins. In exchange for offerings of stolen gold, they grant dominion over corrupted nature.
bestiary.goblin_king.name: Zog'Krix
bestiary.goblin_king.title: The Bone Weaver
bestiary.goblin_king.lore: No one knows which goblin Zog'Krix was before he died. What returned from the marshes three days later wore a crown of cracked bones and spoke in a voice that came from everywhere at once.
bestiary.goblin_king.ability.1: Bone Crown — calls goblins to his side
bestiary.goblin_king.ability.2: Raises fallen goblins as skeletal thralls
bestiary.goblin_king.ability.3: Ritual ward — immune to first hit each wave
bestiary.orc.name: Orc
bestiary.orc.title: Horde Warrior
bestiary.orc.lore: The Orcs of the Kar'Vash Horde are raised for war from birth. Every scar on their body is a point of pride. To die in battle is the greatest honor an Orc can achieve.
bestiary.orc_berserker.name: Orc Berserker
bestiary.orc_berserker.title: Uncontrolled Fury
bestiary.orc_berserker.lore: The Berserker consumes hallucinogenic mushrooms from the Zul caverns before every battle. In a frenzy, it feels no pain, recognizes no friend or foe, only destiny.
bestiary.orc_leader.name: Orc Leader
bestiary.orc_leader.title: Iron Fist
bestiary.orc_leader.lore: Orc Leaders emerge after surviving three campaigns without retreating. They carry the Horde Shield, forged from ten shields of defeated enemies fused into one.
bestiary.orc_spearman.name: Orc Spearthrower
bestiary.orc_spearman.title: Steppe Spear-Thrower
bestiary.orc_spearman.lore: Specialists in ambushes, Orc Spear-Throwers learn to calculate wind and distance from youth. Their dragon-bone lances cut through armor like butter.
bestiary.orc_warrior.name: Orc Warrior
bestiary.orc_warrior.title: Horde Executioner
bestiary.orc_warrior.lore: Veterans of dozens of campaigns, Orc Warriors wield two-handed axes heavier than a grown goblin. Each swing can fell an ancient tree.
bestiary.orc_warlord.name: Grakh Ironjaw
bestiary.orc_warlord.title: The Undying Warlord
bestiary.orc_warlord.lore: Grakh Ironjaw has been declared dead eleven times. The first time, his own tribe put a spear through his chest. He pulled it out, broke it in half, and used the pieces to beat the chieftain unconscious.
bestiary.orc_warlord.ability.0: War cry — the whole horde speeds up
bestiary.orc_warlord.ability.3: Berserk below 30% HP — attack speed doubles
bestiary.banshee.name: Banshee
bestiary.banshee.title: The Wailing Grief
bestiary.banshee.lore: A Banshee is a death that has not finished happening yet. She screams because she remembers being alive.
bestiary.banshee.ability.0: Death wail — briefly paralyzes nearest ally
bestiary.banshee.ability.1: Spectral form — immune to physical damage 20% chance
bestiary.banshee.ability.2: Sorrow aura — reduces ally attack speed
bestiary.ghost.name: Ghost
bestiary.ghost.title: The Cold That Walks
bestiary.ghost.lore: It remembers being alive only in the way you remember a dream — as fragments, and mostly the bad ones. The Ghost drifts toward the warmth of the living without quite knowing why, only that it is owed.
bestiary.ghost.ability.1: Chilling touch — briefly slows on hit
bestiary.ghost.ability.2: Fade — hard to see against dark terrain
bestiary.ghost.ability.3: Wail — minor fear effect on a nearby ally
bestiary.ghoul.name: Ghoul
bestiary.ghoul.title: Corpse Devourer
bestiary.ghoul.lore: Once humans who consumed cursed flesh in the forbidden cemeteries of Mal'Katar. Now they sprint on all fours, ravenous for living meat.
bestiary.lich.name: Lich
bestiary.lich.title: Archmage of Death
bestiary.lich.lore: Mages who traded their humanity for immortality. They store their soul in a secret object called a phylactery. While it exists, they cannot be permanently destroyed.
bestiary.mummy.name: Mummy
bestiary.mummy.title: Embalmed King
bestiary.mummy.lore: Pharaohs and nobles of extinct civilizations, preserved by forbidden rites. Slow as tombs, resilient as stone.
bestiary.skeleton.name: Skeleton
bestiary.skeleton.title: Echo of the Past
bestiary.skeleton.lore: Animated remains of warriors fallen in ancient battles. No memory, no purpose beyond destruction.
bestiary.skeleton_warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
bestiary.skeleton_warrior.title: Eternal Guard
bestiary.skeleton_warrior.lore: Elite warriors reanimated with armor intact. Their death in battle made them more efficient — no fear, no fatigue, no mercy.
bestiary.wight.name: Wight
bestiary.wight.title: The Hollow Who Remembers Being Full
bestiary.wight.lore: Wights are what happens when someone so desperately does not want to die that death takes them anyway and they refuse to accept it.
bestiary.wight.ability.0: Life drain — reduces ally max HP temporarily
bestiary.wight.ability.1: Cold aura — slows all nearby allies
bestiary.wight.ability.2: Undead resilience — immune to fear effects
bestiary.wraith.name: Wraith
bestiary.wraith.title: The Wound That Walks
bestiary.wraith.lore: A Wraith is grief given direction. It passes through walls not because it is clever but because walls are a concern for the living.
bestiary.wraith.ability.0: Ethereal pass — can move through obstacles
bestiary.wraith.ability.1: Soul rend — high damage ignoring armor
bestiary.wraith.ability.2: Darkness aura — reduces ally vision and range
bestiary.grim_reaper.name: Grim Reaper
bestiary.grim_reaper.title: Harvester of Souls
bestiary.grim_reaper.lore: The Grim Reaper drifts onto the battlefield when the dead outnumber the living. With a scythe that cuts through matter and spirit alike, it reaps without malice or mercy.
bestiary.grim_reaper.ability.1: Cold aura — nearby heroes attack slower
bestiary.grim_reaper.ability.2: Soul sever — void burn over time
bestiary.grim_reaper.ability.3: Spectral form — 20% chance to phase through projectiles
bestiary.velshade.name: Vel'Shade
bestiary.velshade.title: The Voidwalker
bestiary.velshade.lore: There is no record of Vel'Shade ever having been alive. It appeared from the void fog alongside the Grim Reaper, a shadowy specter whose presence chills the heart of any defender.
bestiary.elf.name: Elf
bestiary.elf.title: Forest Sentinel
bestiary.elf.lore: The Elves of Sylvara'neth serve their forest with religious fanaticism. Agile as wind, precise as clockwork.
bestiary.elf_arcanist.name: Elf Arcanist
bestiary.elf_arcanist.title: Arcane Weaver
bestiary.elf_arcanist.wave: Act I · Elf incursion (W16-19) · Act II (W1-9)
bestiary.elf_arcanist.lore: Elven mages who channel arcane energy from the forest itself. Their spells carry the beauty of the seasons and the brutality of a storm.
bestiary.elf_scout.name: Elf Scout
bestiary.elf_scout.title: Forest Shadow
bestiary.elf_scout.wave: Act I · Elf incursion (W16-19) · Act II (W1-9)
bestiary.elf_scout.lore: Elven scouts who can traverse a dense forest without snapping a single twig. Their attacks come from nowhere.
bestiary.elf_champion.name: Aeryn Dawnblade
bestiary.elf_champion.title: Blade of Eternity
bestiary.elf_champion.wave: Act I · Boss (W20) · Act II · Boss (W10)
bestiary.elf_champion.lore: Aeryn does not remember when she stopped aging. The tiara she wears is three thousand years old; she forged it herself the morning after her first battle. She has fought in forty-seven wars. She has never lost.
bestiary.elf_champion.ability.3: Counter — parries one projectile per second
bestiary.minotaur.name: Minotaur
bestiary.minotaur.title: Bull of the Scorched Plains
bestiary.minotaur.lore: Born on the plains of Kha'zar, Minotaurs are half man, half bull, and one hundred percent violence.
bestiary.minotaur_archer.name: Minotaur Archer
bestiary.minotaur_archer.title: Bull's Eye
bestiary.minotaur_archer.lore: Rare among Minotaurs, the Archers developed enough patience to use a bow. Their arrows are more like spears.
bestiary.minotaur_guard.name: Minotaur Guard
bestiary.minotaur_guard.title: Red-Horned Sentinel
bestiary.minotaur_guard.lore: Guardians of the temples of Kha'zar. Their horns were painted red with the blood of invaders who tried to defile the sacred grounds.
bestiary.minotaur_warrior.name: Minotaur Warrior
bestiary.minotaur_warrior.title: Iron and Horn Warrior
bestiary.minotaur_warrior.lore: Minotaur Warriors forge their own armor in volcanic lava furnaces. Each piece was tempered with the wearer's own blood.
bestiary.minotaur_king.name: Khor'Zal Ironhide
bestiary.minotaur_king.title: The Unbroken
bestiary.minotaur_king.wave: Act II · Boss (W20) · Act V · Boss (W20)
bestiary.minotaur_king.lore: The plains of Kha'zar have no word for surrender. Khor'Zal was born there, raised on war, and made of something that doesn't break.
bestiary.centaur.name: Centaur
bestiary.centaur.title: Dune Rider
bestiary.centaur.wave: Act I · Children of the Ruins (W21-24)
bestiary.centaur.lore: Nomads of the sand that swallowed the old city. They never learned to build; they only learned that whoever builds has something to lose.
bestiary.centaur_archer.name: Centaur Archer
bestiary.centaur_archer.title: Rider of the Long Shot
bestiary.centaur_archer.wave: Act I · Children of the Ruins (W21-24)
bestiary.centaur_archer.lore: Shoots from horseback at a full gallop and rarely misses. The desert is flat and has nowhere to hide; the centaurs have known this longer than anyone.
bestiary.harpy.name: Harpy
bestiary.harpy.title: Ruin Scavenger
bestiary.harpy.wave: Act I · Children of the Ruins (W21-24)
bestiary.harpy.lore: They circle before the fight is over, because they already know how it ends. Fast, loud, and interested only in what is left behind.
bestiary.stone_guardian.name: Stone Guardian
bestiary.stone_guardian.title: Six Arms of the Buried Temple
bestiary.stone_guardian.wave: Act I · Children of the Ruins (W21-24)
bestiary.stone_guardian.lore: Carved to guard a temple that no longer exists, for a god no one remembers. It still shows up for work.
bestiary.medusa.name: Medusa
bestiary.medusa.title: The Last Priestess
bestiary.medusa.lore: The sand took the city, the temple, and everyone who prayed there. It did not take her. She has had a long time to decide how she feels about that.
bestiary.medusa.ability.0: Petrifying gaze — turns every hero to stone for 3 s
bestiary.fire_dragon.name: Fire Dragon
bestiary.fire_dragon.title: Sun-Scaled
bestiary.fire_dragon.lore: Where the frost dragons went north, these stayed and learned to like the heat. The desert did not make them; it only made them worse.
bestiary.dragon.name: Dragon
bestiary.dragon.title: Lord of the Green Flames
bestiary.dragon.wave: Act I · Dragon flight (W26-29) · Act II (W21-29)
bestiary.dragon.lore: The Green Dragons of the Venomara Ruins are known for their cruel intelligence. They do not merely burn, they plan.
bestiary.frost_dragon.name: Ice Dragon
bestiary.frost_dragon.title: Dragon of Eternal Winter
bestiary.frost_dragon.lore: From the frozen peaks of Glacimor, the Ice Dragon brings winter with it. Its breath does not burn, it freezes.
bestiary.mini_dragon.name: Dragon Whelp
bestiary.mini_dragon.title: Small Now. Not For Long.
bestiary.mini_dragon.lore: A young dragon, barely past the age of leaving the nest. It has all the arrogance of its elders and only a fraction of the control, which somehow makes it more dangerous rather than less.
bestiary.mini_dragon.ability.0: Wild firebreath — powerful but poorly aimed
bestiary.mini_dragon.ability.1: Hardening scales — armor grows as it takes damage
bestiary.mini_dragon.ability.2: Tantrum — brief frenzy of rapid attacks
bestiary.mini_dragon.ability.3: Growing menace — stronger the longer it survives
bestiary.wyvern.name: Wyvern
bestiary.wyvern.title: Lesser Cousin of Dragons
bestiary.wyvern.wave: Act I · Dragon flight (W26-29) · Act II (W21-29)
bestiary.wyvern.lore: Not a true dragon, and deeply resentful of the distinction. The Wyvern compensates for its lesser stature with a viciousness the great dragons consider undignified — and therefore never see coming.
bestiary.wyvern.ability.0: Diving strike — swoops from above for bonus damage
bestiary.wyvern.ability.1: Venomous barb — poison DoT on tail hit
bestiary.wyvern.ability.2: Aerial harassment — hard to hit while airborne
bestiary.wyvern.ability.3: Screeching cry — briefly rattles nearby allies
bestiary.dragon_lord.name: Vreth'Kal
bestiary.dragon_lord.title: The Ashborn
bestiary.dragon_lord.wave: Act I · Final boss (W30) · Act II · Final boss (W30)
bestiary.dragon_lord.lore: Vreth'Kal does not hate the things it burns. Hate requires attention, and Vreth'Kal stopped paying attention to individual creatures around the time your civilization's name was still just a sound someone made at a fire.
bestiary.dragon_lord.ability.1: Ancient wings — gust slows all allies
bestiary.earth_elemental.name: Earth Elemental
bestiary.earth_elemental.title: The Living Mountain
bestiary.earth_elemental.lore: It moves like a landslide and strikes like one too. Earth Elementals are patience made physical.
bestiary.fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental
bestiary.fire_elemental.title: Born of the Eternal Flame
bestiary.fire_elemental.lore: It was not summoned. It simply arrived, drawn by the warmth of conflict.
bestiary.ice_witch.name: Ice Witch
bestiary.ice_witch.title: Mistress of the Frozen Wastes
bestiary.ice_witch.lore: She learned ice magic the way most people learn grief — slowly, then all at once.
bestiary.ice_witch.ability.1: Blizzard aura — slows all nearby allies
bestiary.pixie.name: Pixie
bestiary.pixie.title: Thorn of the Fae Courts
bestiary.pixie.lore: Do not let the size fool you. Pixies are not small creatures with small problems. They are ancient, vindictive, and utterly without mercy.
bestiary.pixie.ability.0: Faerie dust — weakens ally damage briefly
bestiary.troll.name: Troll
bestiary.troll.title: Child of the Ancient Forest
bestiary.troll.lore: Trolls have lived in these forests since before any kingdom was built here. They do not hate the defenders of Grimhold. They simply do not consider them worth keeping alive.
bestiary.deepling_scout.name: Abyssal Scout
bestiary.deepling_scout.title: First Blade of the Drowned Halls
bestiary.deepling_scout.lore: It was sent ahead because it is fast. When it does not return, they send more.
bestiary.deepling_warrior.name: Abyssal Warrior
bestiary.deepling_warrior.title: Spear of the Sunken Kingdom
bestiary.deepling_warrior.lore: The trident it carries was forged in pressure so extreme that the metal remembers it. Abyssal Warriors do not retreat.
bestiary.bonelord.name: Ossivern
bestiary.bonelord.title: Architect of the Bone Courts
bestiary.bonelord.lore: Ossiverns are categorically offended by organic life. They consider bones the only worthwhile part of any creature.
bestiary.bonelord.ability.0: Bone bolt — long range magical attack
bestiary.bonelord.ability.1: Skeleton summon — raises nearby bones as minions
bestiary.bonelord.ability.3: Curse beam — reduces ally damage output
bestiary.nightmare.name: Ashmare
bestiary.nightmare.title: The Horse That Dreams of Fire
bestiary.nightmare.lore: Where a Nightmare walks, the ground does not cool for hours. It was a warhorse once, before the shadow plane claimed it.
bestiary.nightmare.ability.1: Terror charge — tramples through multiple allies
bestiary.nightmare.ability.3: Shadow mane — periodic AoE darkness burst
bestiary.nightstalker.name: Umbrafiend
bestiary.nightstalker.title: The One You Do Not See Coming
bestiary.nightstalker.wave: Act II · Deep horrors (W21-29) · Act III (W21-29)
bestiary.nightstalker.lore: It has never lost a target. Not because it is particularly fast — though it is — but because it is patient in a way that feels personal.
bestiary.nightstalker.ability.0: Stealth approach — invisible until in attack range
bestiary.nightstalker.ability.1: Backstab — massive damage on first strike from stealth
bestiary.nightstalker.ability.2: Shadow step — teleports behind target ally
bestiary.shadow_beast.name: Shadow Beast
bestiary.shadow_beast.title: The Dark Between the Stars
bestiary.shadow_beast.lore: It has no eyes because it does not need them. The darkness does not hide the Shadow Beast — the Shadow Beast is the darkness.
bestiary.shadow_beast.ability.0: Shadow lunge — extremely fast melee strike
bestiary.shadow_beast.ability.2: Terror aura — reduces nearby ally attack speed
bestiary.cyclops.name: Cyclops
bestiary.cyclops.title: The One-Eyed Storm
bestiary.cyclops.wave: Act III · Giant vanguard (W1-9) · Act II (W21-29)
bestiary.cyclops.lore: Cyclopes view the world through a single massive eye that sees further and sharper than any pair could hope to match. The depth perception they lack, they compensate for with caution and a very large club.
bestiary.cyclops.ability.2: Singular focus — targets highest HP ally
bestiary.cyclops_stonehurler.name: Cyclops Stonehurler
bestiary.cyclops_stonehurler.title: The Living Catapult
bestiary.cyclops_stonehurler.lore: Developed a taste for siege warfare after watching an actual catapult in action. Decided it could do the same thing, faster, and without assembly instructions.
bestiary.golem.name: Golem
bestiary.golem.title: The Patient Wall
bestiary.golem.lore: The Golem does not hurry. It has nowhere to be that it will not eventually arrive at, and nothing that can stop it from arriving. Your defenses will hold, and hold, and then they will not.
bestiary.golem.ability.1: Ground slam — AoE stun on impact
bestiary.golem.ability.2: Unstoppable march — immune to knockback and slows
bestiary.golem.ability.3: Crumble — splits into rubble hazards when destroyed
bestiary.ogre.name: Ogre
bestiary.ogre.title: Monument of Violence
bestiary.ogre.wave: Act III · Giant vanguard (W1-9) · Act II (W21-29)
bestiary.ogre.lore: Ogres are not born large. They grow. The longer they live and the more they fight, the bigger they get. The oldest Ogres are the size of houses. They rarely live that long.
bestiary.ogre_berserker.name: Ogre Berserker
bestiary.ogre_berserker.title: The Red Thunder
bestiary.ogre_berserker.lore: An Ogre that has crossed the threshold into permanent rage. It no longer sleeps, no longer eats, it only destroys.
bestiary.slime.name: Slime
bestiary.slime.title: The Thing That Keeps Coming
bestiary.slime.lore: Cut it and you get two. This is well documented, widely known, and somehow always a surprise in the moment. The Slime is less a threat than a lesson in not letting problems divide.
bestiary.slime.ability.0: Split — divides into smaller slimes when struck
bestiary.slime.ability.1: Corrosive body — weakens ally weapons on contact
bestiary.slime.ability.2: Absorb — slowly regenerates if left alone
bestiary.slime.ability.3: Sticky mass — briefly slows the first ally to hit it
bestiary.half_brother_cyclops.name: Vhar
bestiary.half_brother_cyclops.title: Half-Brother, Eye of the Storm
bestiary.half_brother_cyclops.lore: Vhar sees everything. One eye is enough when it is the size of a shield and glows like a furnace.
bestiary.half_brother_cyclops.ability.2: Half-brother bond — immune to fear while Grak alive
bestiary.half_brother_ogre.name: Grak
bestiary.half_brother_ogre.title: Half-Brother, Bound in Bone
bestiary.half_brother_ogre.lore: Grak does not speak much. When he does, it sounds like a door being wrenched off its hinges.
bestiary.half_brother_ogre.ability.2: Half-brother bond — immune to fear while Vhar alive
bestiary.dhampir.name: Dhampir
bestiary.dhampir.title: Child of Two Bloods
bestiary.dhampir.lore: Born of a vampire parent and a mortal, Dhampirs exist between two worlds and are welcomed in neither.
bestiary.dhampir_ballister.name: Dhampir Ballister
bestiary.dhampir_ballister.title: Blood-Tipped Bolt
bestiary.dhampir_ballister.lore: Ballisters operate from the dark. Their crossbow bolts are tipped with a compound distilled from vampire blood.
bestiary.dhampir_mage.name: Dhampir Mage
bestiary.dhampir_mage.title: Crimson Scholar
bestiary.dhampir_mage.lore: Dhampir Mages study the intersection of blood and magic. The blood orbs they conjure are not symbolic. They are blood.
bestiary.vampire.name: Vampire
bestiary.vampire.title: Noble of Darkness
bestiary.vampire.lore: Immortal aristocrats who traded sunlight for eternal life. Their bite drains not only blood, it drains hope.
bestiary.vampire_lord.name: Valdris the Pale
bestiary.vampire_lord.title: Lord of Eternal Night
bestiary.vampire_lord.wave: Act III · Boss (W20) · Act IV · Boss (W20)
bestiary.vampire_lord.lore: Valdris has not fed from a living creature in three centuries — not out of mercy, but because he considers it beneath him now.
bestiary.vampire_lord.ability.1: Hypnotic gaze — paralyzes one ally for 3s
bestiary.vampire_lord.ability.2: Blood drain — heals on melee hit
bestiary.vampire_lord.ability.3: Mist form — untargetable for 2s below 40% HP
bestiary.demon_skeleton.name: Demon Skeleton
bestiary.demon_skeleton.title: Cursed Bones of the Abyss
bestiary.demon_skeleton.lore: Skeletons of demons slain in ages past, reanimated by residual energy of the Abyss.
bestiary.devil.name: Devil
bestiary.devil.title: The Bargain That Bites
bestiary.devil.lore: The Devil is a creature of contracts, and it has read yours more carefully than you have. It fights not because it must, but because it has calculated, precisely, that it will win.
bestiary.devil.ability.0: Soul tax — heals when it damages an ally
bestiary.devil.ability.1: Forked strike — hits two adjacent targets
bestiary.devil.ability.2: Sudden clause — brief burst of speed to close distance
bestiary.devil.ability.3: Sear — leaves a lingering burn on hit
bestiary.fire_devil.name: Fire Devil
bestiary.fire_devil.title: Ember Demon
bestiary.fire_devil.lore: Entities of pure fire summoned from the infernal layers. They leave trails of fire as they walk.
bestiary.imp.name: Imp
bestiary.imp.title: The Small Nuisance
bestiary.imp.lore: Fast, spiteful, and entirely too pleased with itself. The Imp rarely kills anything on its own, but it has ended more runs than it is given credit for — usually by slipping past exactly when you were looking elsewhere.
bestiary.imp.ability.2: Slip through — hard to pin down in a crowd
bestiary.imp.ability.3: Cackle — briefly distracts a nearby ally
bestiary.demon.name: Demon
bestiary.demon.title: The Fire Made Flesh
bestiary.demon.wave: Act III · Final boss (W30) · Act V (W1-9)
bestiary.demon.lore: The Demon does not hate you. Hatred requires knowing your name. To the Demon you are simply the next thing between it and the far side of the wall, and it has crossed many such things before.
bestiary.demon.ability.0: Hellfire nova — expanding ring of fire damage
bestiary.demon.ability.1: Infernal grip — pulls a distant ally into melee
bestiary.demon.ability.2: Molten hide — reflects a share of melee damage
bestiary.demon.ability.3: Rain of cinders — persistent burning zones
bestiary.fallen_seraph.name: Fallen Seraph
bestiary.fallen_seraph.title: Heaven Unmade
bestiary.fallen_seraph.lore: It fell willingly. That is the part no one discusses. The Fallen Seraph looked at what it was supposed to protect and decided the protected did not deserve it.
bestiary.fallen_seraph.ability.0: Corrupted smite — holy damage that bypasses armor
bestiary.fallen_seraph.ability.2: Fallen blessing — briefly empowers nearby dark creatures
bestiary.fallen_seraph.ability.3: Judgment strike — marks then detonates target
bestiary.flux_anomaly.name: Arcane Rift
bestiary.flux_anomaly.title: A Tear in What Should Be
bestiary.flux_anomaly.lore: No one created it. It is what happens when too much raw arcane energy accumulates in a single point and decides it is tired of being contained.
bestiary.flux_anomaly.ability.1: Teleport — repositions randomly every few seconds
bestiary.lesser_demon.name: Lesser Demon
bestiary.lesser_demon.title: The Expendable Legion
bestiary.lesser_demon.lore: Individually, the Lesser Demon is not much. That is entirely the point. It is not meant to win — it is meant to spend your defenses so that what comes after does not have to.
bestiary.lesser_demon.ability.0: Reckless charge — rushes forward heedless of danger
bestiary.lesser_demon.ability.1: Burning touch — minor fire DoT on hit
bestiary.lesser_demon.ability.2: Swarm courage — bolder in large numbers
bestiary.lesser_demon.ability.3: Death spasm — small fire burst when killed
bestiary.void_herald.name: Void Herald
bestiary.void_herald.title: Announcer of the End
bestiary.void_herald.lore: The Herald does not come to fight. It comes to announce. Unfortunately, what it is announcing is the imminent arrival of things considerably worse than itself.
bestiary.void_herald.ability.0: Rift opening — creates persistent damage zones
bestiary.void_herald.ability.1: Void bolt — high damage ranged attack
bestiary.void_herald.ability.2: Herald call — signals other void creatures to accelerate
bestiary.void_herald.ability.3: Dimensional anchor — prevents ally abilities briefly
bestiary.warlock_shade.name: Warlock Shade
bestiary.warlock_shade.title: The Price of Forbidden Power
bestiary.warlock_shade.lore: He made a deal he could not keep and spent the next century paying it off in pieces.
bestiary.warlock_shade.ability.0: Shadow bolt — high damage ranged attack
bestiary.warlock_shade.ability.2: Curse — marks an ally for bonus damage
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.name: Corrupt Paladin
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.title: The Shield Turned Blade
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.lore: He still prays. Every morning, every night, the same words he was taught as a novice. Something answers now that did not answer before.
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.ability.0: Unholy crusade — aura that suppresses ally healing
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.ability.1: Dark consecration — corrupts ground dealing DoT
bestiary.corrupt_paladin.ability.3: Corrupted blessing — heals self and nearby enemies
bestiary.death_knight.name: Death Knight
bestiary.death_knight.title: Champion of the Endless War
bestiary.death_knight.lore: He remembers being a paladin. He remembers the oaths, the ideals, the absolute certainty that he was one of the good ones.
bestiary.death_knight.ability.1: Death coil — projectile that slows and weakens
bestiary.death_knight.ability.2: Dark aura — empowers all undead nearby
bestiary.hydra.name: Hydra
bestiary.hydra.title: The Unkillable Many
bestiary.hydra.lore: The problem is not the heads. The heads can be dealt with. The problem is that dealing with the heads causes more heads.
bestiary.hydra.ability.0: Triple bite — attacks three allies simultaneously
bestiary.hydra.ability.1: Regeneration — regrows health at low HP
bestiary.hydra.ability.2: Acid spit — applies DoT from all heads
bestiary.beholder.name: Beholder
bestiary.beholder.title: The Eye That Judges All
bestiary.beholder.lore: The Beholder does not hate you. It simply cannot conceive of why you should exist.
bestiary.beholder.ability.2: Disintegration ray — heavy single target damage
bestiary.beholder.ability.3: Charm ray — temporarily confuses ally targeting
bestiary.demon_eyes.name: Demon Eyes
bestiary.demon_eyes.title: The Hundred Watching
bestiary.demon_eyes.lore: It is mostly eyes. This is not a metaphor. Every surface of it watches, and the ones facing away from you are watching something you cannot see, and reacting to it.
bestiary.demon_eyes.ability.0: Baleful gaze — long-range eye beams that ignore cover
bestiary.demon_eyes.ability.1: Hex sight — marked ally takes bonus damage
bestiary.demon_eyes.ability.2: Unblinking guard — cannot be flanked or backstabbed
bestiary.demon_eyes.ability.3: Split focus — attacks two allies at once
bestiary.lord_demon.name: Lord Demon
bestiary.lord_demon.title: Warlord of the Lower Fire
bestiary.lord_demon.lore: Where lesser demons swarm, the Lord Demon commands. It has fought organized defenders before and lost — once. It does not intend to make the acquaintance of that feeling twice.
bestiary.lord_demon.ability.0: Command aura — nearby demons hit harder
bestiary.lord_demon.ability.1: Cleaving strike — damages allies in a wide arc
bestiary.lord_demon.ability.2: Infernal endurance — briefly shrugs off crowd control
bestiary.lord_demon.ability.3: Ember burst — short-range fire explosion on hit
bestiary.mind_flayer.name: Mind Flayer
bestiary.mind_flayer.title: Devourer of Thought
bestiary.mind_flayer.wave: Act IV · Chaos (W21-29) · Act X · The Hunger
bestiary.mind_flayer.lore: It does not want your gold or your land or your life. It wants what is inside your skull.
bestiary.mind_flayer.ability.1: Mind blast (in the Hunger) — stuns nearby heroes for 1 s
bestiary.void_stalker.name: Void Stalker
bestiary.void_stalker.title: The Thing Between Waves
bestiary.void_stalker.lore: It moves faster than something its size has any right to, and it always seems to arrive a half-second before you expected it. The Void Stalker does not come through the rift so much as it remembers being on this side and simply resumes.
bestiary.void_stalker.ability.3: Pack instinct — faster when other stalkers are near
bestiary.infernatil.name: Pyranthax
bestiary.infernatil.title: The Elemental Emperor
bestiary.infernatil.lore: Pyranthax was not born. He was assembled — over millennia, from the concentrated essence of every great fire, storm, earthquake, and flood that ever erased a civilization.
bestiary.infernatil.ability.0: Meteor rain — launches multiple fire meteors
bestiary.infernatil.ability.3: Final inferno (below 30% HP) — AoE that covers entire field
bestiary.ghazbaran.name: Varkthos
bestiary.ghazbaran.title: The Ruthless Archdemon of Devastation
bestiary.ghazbaran.lore: Varkthos has sacked seventeen civilizations. He keeps a list. Not out of pride — out of professional thoroughness.
bestiary.ghazbaran.ability.0: Shadow eruption — massive AoE dark damage
bestiary.ghazbaran.ability.1: Infernal wings — immune to ranged attacks briefly
bestiary.ghazbaran.ability.2: Abyssal roar — reduces all ally stats for 10s
bestiary.ghazbaran.ability.3: Devastation mark — targeted ally takes double damage
bestiary.ghazbaran.ability.4: Dark regeneration — slowly heals below 50% HP
bestiary.zathroth.name: Morkavel
bestiary.zathroth.title: God of Destruction, Shaper of Ends
bestiary.zathroth.lore: He was not always a god of destruction. He was a god of creation first — he built the framework of existence with his own hands and was extraordinarily proud of it. Then he watched what was done with it.
bestiary.zathroth.ability.0: Obliteration beam — kills any ally below 30% HP
bestiary.zathroth.ability.1: Summon void legion — calls fallen seraphs and void heralds
bestiary.zathroth.ability.2: Soul annihilation — removes all active buffs from allies
bestiary.zathroth.ability.3: Reality fracture — permanent rift zone covering 40% of field
bestiary.zathroth.ability.4: God Form (below 30% HP) — becomes immune for 3s
bestiary.zathroth.ability.5: Wrath of Morkavel — massive AoE damage every 8s
bestiary.soldado_ashfen.name: Ashfen Soldier
bestiary.soldado_ashfen.title: Turncoat Levy
bestiary.soldado_ashfen.lore: Ashfen sold its oath for coin. Its soldiers march on the walls they once swore to guard.
bestiary.capanga.name: Treasurer's Thug
bestiary.capanga.title: Hired Muscle
bestiary.capanga.lore: Paid by the Treasurer to open the way. Loyal only until the purse runs dry.
bestiary.cavaleiro_negro.name: Black Knight
bestiary.cavaleiro_negro.title: Oathless Knight
bestiary.cavaleiro_negro.lore: Heavy plate painted black, so no one remembers which banner it once served.
bestiary.saqueador.name: Marauder
bestiary.saqueador.title: Wall Looter
bestiary.saqueador.lore: Marauders who smelled a falling city. They come with spear, hammer and sword.
bestiary.lich5.name: Grimhold Lich
bestiary.lich5.title: Buried Scholar
bestiary.lich5.lore: A scholar of Grimhold who never left the library, not even after dying in it.
bestiary.mago_colegiado.name: Collegium Mage
bestiary.mago_colegiado.title: Collegium Adept
bestiary.mago_colegiado.lore: The Collegium chose the winning side early. Its mages cast from behind the soldiers.
bestiary.runa_hostil.name: Hostile Rune
bestiary.runa_hostil.title: Stolen Glyph
bestiary.runa_hostil.lore: A rune torn from Grimhold's wards and turned against it. Veltharion's runes refuse its orders.
bestiary.sargento_ashfen.name: Ashfen Sergeant
bestiary.sargento_ashfen.title: Drillmaster of Treason
bestiary.sargento_ashfen.lore: He taught the levies to march. Now he teaches them where.
bestiary.tesoureiro.name: The Treasurer
bestiary.tesoureiro.title: Keeper of the Purse
bestiary.tesoureiro.lore: He carries no weapon. He never needed one: every soldier on this field is on his payroll.
bestiary.tesoureiro.ability.0: Steals gold at the wall; returns it if slain
bestiary.chefe_saqueador.name: Marauder Chief
bestiary.chefe_saqueador.title: First to the Spoils
bestiary.chefe_saqueador.lore: The loudest of the marauders, and the first to run with the gold.
bestiary.capitao_ashfen.name: Captain of Ashfen
bestiary.capitao_ashfen.title: Voice of the Betrayal
bestiary.capitao_ashfen.lore: He signed the order that opened the gates. His war cry still carries the weight of it.
bestiary.lich_colegiado.name: Collegium Lich
bestiary.lich_colegiado.title: Dean of the Dead
bestiary.lich_colegiado.lore: The Collegium's oldest member. Death was just another chair on the council.
bestiary.reitor.name: The Rector
bestiary.reitor.title: Master of the Collegium
bestiary.reitor.lore: He sold Grimhold's wards stone by stone. Now he commands the runes that once protected it.
bestiary.cultista_vermelho.name: Crimson Cultist
bestiary.cultista_vermelho.title: Channeler of Wrath
bestiary.cultista_vermelho.lore: Its chant feeds the demons around it. Where it walks, they strike twice as hard.
bestiary.cultista_branco.name: Pale Cultist
bestiary.cultista_branco.title: Mender of the Faithful
bestiary.cultista_branco.lore: Pale robes, pale hands. It stitches the wounds of the other side shut.
bestiary.cultista_verde.name: Blight Cultist
bestiary.cultista_verde.title: Walking Blight
bestiary.cultista_verde.lore: It does not fight. It reaches you, glows, and bursts.
bestiary.cultista_verde.ability.0: Explodes near heroes or the wall
bestiary.cultista_negro.name: Shadow Cultist
bestiary.cultista_negro.title: Voice in the Dark
bestiary.cultista_negro.lore: The rank and file of the cult. They sing so the far shore can hear.
bestiary.lanterna.name: Lantern Phantom
bestiary.lanterna.title: Light of the Lost
bestiary.lanterna.lore: A lantern that walks by itself, looking for those who crossed without a guide.
bestiary.anjo.name: Fallen Angel
bestiary.anjo.title: Wing of the Host
bestiary.anjo.lore: The Host that fell with the Seraph. Crimson and shadow feathers alike.
bestiary.anjo_sem_asas.name: Wingless Angel
bestiary.anjo_sem_asas.title: Grounded Host
bestiary.anjo_sem_asas.lore: They lost their wings in the fall. Not their spears.
bestiary.morcego.name: Rift Bat
bestiary.morcego.title: Rift Flutter
bestiary.morcego.lore: They pour out of the rift in clouds, too fast to count.
bestiary.acaro_azul.name: Chaos Mite
bestiary.acaro_azul.title: Chaos Swarm
bestiary.lich6.name: Far-Shore Lich
bestiary.lich6.title: Warden of the Far Shore
bestiary.lich6.lore: The dead of the other shore keep their own sorcerers. Some wear crimson, some gold.
bestiary.cavaleiro_caido.name: Fallen Knight
bestiary.cavaleiro_caido.title: Knight of the Wrong Side
bestiary.cavaleiro_caido.lore: He crossed the river to save someone. He never crossed back.
bestiary.esqueleto6.name: Rift Skeleton
bestiary.esqueleto6.title: Rift Bones
bestiary.esqueleto6_lanca.name: Rift Spearman
bestiary.esqueleto6_lanca.title: Spear of the Rift
bestiary.esqueleto6_lanca.lore: A skeleton that kept its spear and its drill.
bestiary.esqueleto6_escudo.name: Rift Shieldbearer
bestiary.esqueleto6_escudo.title: Shield of the Rift
bestiary.esqueleto6_escudo.lore: It walks in front so the others can walk behind.
bestiary.fenix.name: Lesser Phoenix
bestiary.fenix.title: Ember Wing
bestiary.fenix.lore: A spark of the Elder Phoenix, flying ahead of her.
bestiary.fenix_do_caos.name: Chaos Phoenix
bestiary.fenix_do_caos.title: Burning Omen
bestiary.fenix_do_caos.lore: Its fire is the wrong color. Nothing that burns in it comes back the same.
bestiary.cultista_mor.name: Cultist Lord
bestiary.cultista_mor.title: High Priest of the Crossing
bestiary.cultista_mor.lore: He leads the cult across the river, and never walks alone.
bestiary.coro.name: The Choir
bestiary.coro.title: Eight Voices, One Song
bestiary.coro.lore: A conductor and eight choristers. Silence them all at once, or the song begins again.
bestiary.anjo_caido.name: Fallen Angel
bestiary.anjo_caido.title: First to Fall
bestiary.anjo_caido.lore: He fell before the Host did, and dragged it down with him.
bestiary.irma_de_cassiel.name: Sister of Cassiel
bestiary.irma_de_cassiel.title: Sister Who Stayed
bestiary.irma_de_cassiel.lore: Cassiel crossed back. She did not. She still hopes he will come home.
bestiary.fenix_ancia.name: Elder Phoenix
bestiary.fenix_ancia.title: Twice-Born Flame
bestiary.fenix_ancia.lore: She has died before. She will do it again, and then rise.
bestiary.serafim_caido.name: Fallen Seraph
bestiary.serafim_caido.title: Judge of the Far Shore
bestiary.serafim_caido.lore: Once he weighed souls. Now he weighs only who is strongest, and cuts them down.
bestiary.sapo.name: Ravine Frog
bestiary.sapo.title: Ravine Croaker
bestiary.sapo.lore: The ravine is full of them. So is the night.
bestiary.sapo_xama.name: Frog Shaman
bestiary.sapo_xama.title: Totem Raiser
bestiary.sapo_xama.lore: It stops, croaks a prayer, and the ground answers with a totem.
bestiary.totem_xama.name: Shaman Totem
bestiary.totem_xama.title: Croaking Idol
bestiary.totem_xama.lore: Carved in a hurry, blessed in mud. It lasts ten seconds, and that is enough.
bestiary.rato.name: Ravine Rat
bestiary.rato.title: Scurrier
bestiary.rato.lore: Fast, hungry, and everywhere at once.
bestiary.inseto.name: Mantis Stalker
bestiary.inseto.title: Grass Blade
bestiary.inseto.lore: You will not see it until it cuts.
bestiary.vespa.name: Chaos Wasp
bestiary.vespa.title: Stinging Cloud
bestiary.vespa.lore: Its buzz is the last warning the ravine gives.
bestiary.lagarto.name: Lizardfolk
bestiary.lagarto.title: Scaled Hunter
bestiary.lagarto.lore: Cold-blooded and patient. Some hunt alone, some for the tribes.
bestiary.lobo.name: Ravine Wolf
bestiary.lobo.title: Pack Runner
bestiary.lobo.lore: Where one wolf is seen, the pack is already near.
bestiary.javali.name: Tusked Boar
bestiary.javali.title: Tusked Charge
bestiary.javali.lore: It does not stop for walls. It stops at them.
bestiary.raptor.name: Raptor
bestiary.raptor.title: Ravine Sprinter
bestiary.raptor.lore: Older than the tribes, faster than their arrows.
bestiary.tribo_lobo.name: Wolf-Tribe Warrior
bestiary.tribo_lobo.title: Wolf-Blooded
bestiary.tribo_lobo.lore: The Wolf tribe fights like its namesake: together, and without mercy.
bestiary.tribo_raposa.name: Fox-Tribe Warrior
bestiary.tribo_raposa.title: Fox-Cunning
bestiary.tribo_ave.name: Bird-Tribe Warrior
bestiary.tribo_ave.title: Feathered Spear
bestiary.tribo_ave.lore: The Bird tribe strikes from above the reeds.
bestiary.tribo_peixe.name: Fish-Tribe Warrior
bestiary.tribo_peixe.title: River-Born
bestiary.tribo_peixe.lore: The Fish tribe came up from the ravine's river, slick and hard to hold.
bestiary.sapo_rei.name: Frog King
bestiary.sapo_rei.title: Lord of the Marsh
bestiary.sapo_rei.lore: A crown of reeds and a court of frogs.
bestiary.kwazul.name: Kwa'Zul, the Frog Shaman
bestiary.kwazul.title: The Long Tongue
bestiary.kwazul.lore: Kwa'Zul reaches for whoever hides at the back, and pulls them to the front.
bestiary.kwazul.ability.0: Tongue: pulls the farthest hero forward and stuns
bestiary.alfa_matilha.name: Pack Alpha
bestiary.alfa_matilha.title: Leader of the Hunt
bestiary.alfa_matilha.lore: When it howls, every wolf in the ravine runs faster and bites harder.
bestiary.xiphra.name: Xiphra, the Mantis
bestiary.xiphra.title: The Patient Blade
bestiary.xiphra.lore: Xiphra always strikes the weakest first. It is not cruelty. It is efficiency.
bestiary.xiphra.ability.0: Targets the hero with lowest HP%
bestiary.chefe_tribal.name: Tribal Chief
bestiary.chefe_tribal.title: Voice of the Four Tribes
bestiary.chefe_tribal.lore: Wolf, Fox, Bird and Fish answer to him, for now.
bestiary.chefe_tribal.ability.0: At 66% and 33%: one warrior of each tribe
bestiary.ossoth.name: Ossoth, Ash Shaman
bestiary.ossoth.title: Keeper of the Ashes
bestiary.ossoth.lore: Ossoth burns the dead and asks the ashes to stand. Sometimes they do.
bestiary.afogado.name: Drowned Sailor
bestiary.afogado.title: Crew of the Deep
bestiary.afogado.lore: Sailors who went down with their ships and came back up without them.
bestiary.afogado_veterano.name: Drowned Veteran
bestiary.afogado_veterano.title: Salt-Hardened
bestiary.afogado_veterano.lore: He has drowned more times than you have slept.
bestiary.cardume.name: Abyss Shoal
bestiary.cardume.title: Silver Tide
bestiary.cardume.lore: A shoal that swims through air as if it were water.
bestiary.agua_viva.name: Rift Jelly
bestiary.agua_viva.title: Drifting Shock
bestiary.agua_viva.lore: Pretty to look at. Do not look too long.
bestiary.agua_viva.ability.1: On death: stuns its last target and nearby heroes
bestiary.caranguejo.name: Reef Crab
bestiary.caranguejo.title: Reef Pincer
bestiary.caranguejo.lore: Sideways, stubborn, and very hard to crack.
bestiary.tartaruga.name: Shell Turtle
bestiary.tartaruga.title: Living Bulwark
bestiary.tartaruga.lore: It carries its fortress on its back.
bestiary.serpente_mar.name: Sea Serpent
bestiary.serpente_mar.title: Coil of the Tide
bestiary.serpente_mar.lore: Sailors called them legends. The legends disagreed.
bestiary.capitao_afogado.name: Drowned Captain
bestiary.capitao_afogado.title: Last to Leave the Ship
bestiary.capitao_afogado.lore: He never let go of the anchor. Now he throws it.
bestiary.capitao_afogado.ability.0: Anchor: damages and stuns the nearest hero
bestiary.mae_das_aguas.name: Mother of Waters
bestiary.mae_das_aguas.title: She Who Divides
bestiary.mae_das_aguas.lore: Every wound makes her more. That is how the sea grows.
bestiary.garuda.name: Garuda, Storm Bird
bestiary.garuda.title: Wings of the Gale
bestiary.garuda.lore: Where Garuda flies, the storm follows.
bestiary.rei_caranguejo.name: Crab King
bestiary.rei_caranguejo.title: The Unbroken Shell
bestiary.rei_caranguejo.lore: Strike when the shell opens. Wait when it does not.
bestiary.rei_caranguejo.ability.0: Takes 70% less damage except when guard opens
bestiary.serpente_ancia.name: Elder Serpent
bestiary.serpente_ancia.title: The Deep Coil
bestiary.serpente_ancia.lore: She dives, vanishes, and surfaces closer than before.
bestiary.serpente_ancia.ability.0: Dive: untargetable, resurfaces closer to the wall
bestiary.kraken.name: The Kraken
bestiary.kraken.title: What the Sea Hides
bestiary.kraken.lore: It never comes ashore. It does not need to.
bestiary.kraken.ability.0: Tentacles: hit a whole row of heroes
bestiary.legiao.name: Bone Legionnaire
bestiary.legiao.title: Soldier of the Old Legion
bestiary.legiao.lore: They still march in formation, centuries after the last order was given.
bestiary.cranio.name: Grave Skull
bestiary.cranio.title: Floating Grudge
bestiary.cranio.lore: A skull that refused to rest. Some of them burn.
bestiary.mumia.name: Wrapped Guardian
bestiary.mumia.title: Bound Sentinel
bestiary.mumia.lore: Wrapped to keep something in. Or to keep it standing.
bestiary.estatua_lamina.name: Blade Statue
bestiary.estatua_lamina.title: Stone That Cuts
bestiary.estatua_lamina.lore: The gate's builders did not trust locks.
bestiary.beholder9.name: Gate Eye
bestiary.beholder9.title: Watcher of the Gate
bestiary.beholder9.lore: It has not blinked since the gate was sealed.
bestiary.cerbero.name: Cerberus
bestiary.cerbero.title: Three-Headed Hound
bestiary.aranha.name: Drider Spawn
bestiary.aranha.title: Thread-Born
bestiary.aranha.lore: The Drider's young, lowered from above on her silk.
bestiary.general_ossos.name: Bone General
bestiary.general_ossos.title: Commander of the Dead Legion
bestiary.general_ossos.lore: He never lost a battle. He simply died in the middle of one.
bestiary.general_ossos.ability.0: Calls a block of 6 legionnaires every 15s
bestiary.cranio_ancestral.name: Ancestral Skull
bestiary.cranio_ancestral.title: Oldest of the Skulls
bestiary.cranio_ancestral.lore: It remembers who built the gate. It will not tell you.
bestiary.drider.name: The Drider Queen
bestiary.drider.title: Queen of the Web
bestiary.drider.lore: She hangs from the dark above the arena, and drops her children on you.
bestiary.drider.ability.0: Climbs out of reach on her thread
bestiary.estatua_leste.name: East Statue
bestiary.estatua_leste.title: Twin Guardian of the Dawn
bestiary.estatua_leste.lore: East and West guard the gate together. They heal each other while both stand.
bestiary.estatua_leste.ability.0: Fell both within 8s, or the fallen one returns
bestiary.estatua_oeste.name: West Statue
bestiary.estatua_oeste.title: Twin Guardian of the Dusk
bestiary.estatua_oeste.lore: The West statue answers the East. One never falls alone.
bestiary.cerbero_alfa.name: Cerberus Alpha
bestiary.cerbero_alfa.title: Hound of the Threshold
bestiary.cerbero_alfa.lore: Each head picks a different hero.
bestiary.cerbero_alfa.ability.0: Each bite also hits 2 nearby heroes
bestiary.quimera.name: The Chimera
bestiary.quimera.title: Last Guardian
bestiary.quimera.lore: Lion, goat and serpent. Beyond her, only the Belly.
bestiary.quimera.ability.1: Fire breath on a row of heroes
bestiary.celula.name: Cell Spawn
bestiary.celula.title: Piece of the Hunger
bestiary.celula.lore: The Belly's walls shed them constantly. Each one is a little bit of the Hunger.
bestiary.tentaculo.name: Gut Tentacle
bestiary.tentaculo.title: Grasping Gut
bestiary.tentaculo.lore: It does not walk. It waits, rooted in the flesh of the Belly.
bestiary.tentaculo.ability.0: Does not move; strikes at short range
bestiary.slime_grande.name: Great Slime
bestiary.slime_grande.title: Digesting Mass
bestiary.slime_grande.lore: Whatever the Hunger swallowed and could not finish.
bestiary.bolha.name: Belly Blob
bestiary.bolha.title: Swelling Sac
bestiary.bolha.lore: It pulses in time with a heartbeat you cannot see.
bestiary.fome_ponto.name: Weak Point
bestiary.fome_ponto.title: Eye of the Hunger
bestiary.fome_ponto.lore: The Hunger has no face. It has these: four places where it can be hurt.
bestiary.fome_ponto.ability.1: Fall of the four opens the Heart
bestiary.fome_coracao.name: The Heart
bestiary.fome_coracao.title: What Beats in the Belly
bestiary.fome_coracao.lore: The end of the campaign. It does not heal. It only beats, slower and slower.
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.name: Elder Mind Flayer
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.title: The Hunger's Thought
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.lore: The oldest of those the Hunger swallowed. It does not fight for it: it thinks for it. While it lives, the Heart feels only half the pain.
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.ability.0: Mind blast — stuns heroes in a wide radius for 1.5 s
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.ability.1: Dominate — one hero cannot act for 3 s
bestiary.mind_flayer_anciao.ability.2: While alive, the Heart takes half damage
bestiary.corrupted_mage.name: Corrupted Hero
bestiary.corrupted_mage.title: What the Hunger Kept
bestiary.corrupted_mage.lore: Whoever defeats the Hunger stays at its door. In the next campaign, that hero waits at the end of Act X, corrupted.
bestiary.corrupted_mage.ability.0: Uses a dark version of the hero's ability
bestiary.corrupted_mage.ability.1: Beat it with the same hero to free them
bestiary.malachar.name: Malachar
bestiary.malachar.title: The Eternal Heretic
bestiary.malachar.lore: He was the first defender of Grimhold, and its finest. He held the wall longer than any before him — long enough to learn what was on the other side, and long enough to decide it was right. Everything that comes for you now comes because he opened the door.
bestiary.malachar.ability.0: Heretic decree — periodically empowers every enemy on the field
bestiary.malachar.ability.1: Void collapse — massive AoE that pulls allies inward
bestiary.malachar.ability.2: Eternal return — resurrects once at 50% HP
bestiary.malachar.ability.3: Apostasy — converts a fallen ally against you
bestiary.malachar.ability.4: Unmaking strike — ignores all armor and shields

skill.sk_morri_a4.desc: On entering Devour Mode: heals all allies for 15 HP and grants them +10% attack speed for 5s.
skill.sk_morri_b1.name: Predator
skill.sk_morri_b1.desc: Consuming Strike now grants +20% per charge (was +15%). Missing a shot no longer resets the streak if Morrigan has 20+ souls.
skill.sk_morri_b2.name: Devour Mastery
skill.sk_morri_b2.desc: Devour Mode duration extended to 8s. Projectiles during Devour Mode pierce through all enemies.
skill.sk_morri_b3.name: Soul Storm
skill.sk_morri_b3.desc: Every 10 souls, instead of Devour Mode, triggers Soul Storm: all enemies on screen take damage equal to 50% of Morrigan total soul count.
skill.sk_morri_b4.name: Dark Persistence
skill.sk_morri_b4.desc: Soul bonuses (damage and range) carry over between runs and stack permanently on the account.
skill.sk_morri_cap.name: Ascendant Witch
skill.sk_morri_cap.desc: Morrigan transcends — all souls ever collected this run count double. Soul Storm and Devour Mode trigger simultaneously. At 100+ souls, Morrigan becomes the strongest ally on the field, permanently.
skill.sk_ixara_root.name: Primal Rage
skill.sk_ixara_root.desc: Starts each wave with 2 Fury stacks.
skill.sk_ixara_a1.name: Feeding Frenzy
skill.sk_ixara_a1.desc: Each kill grants +1 Fury stack (was only from Chaos Nova).
skill.sk_ixara_a2.name: Bloodrush
skill.sk_ixara_a2.desc: With 5+ stacks, Ixara gains +20% projectile speed.
skill.sk_ixara_a3.name: Berserker State
skill.sk_ixara_a3.desc: With 8+ stacks, Ixara cannot die (survives with 1 HP, once per wave).
skill.sk_ixara_a4.name: Wrath Buildup
skill.sk_ixara_a4.desc: Fury stacks do not decay between waves.
skill.sk_ixara_b1.name: Nova Amplifier
skill.sk_ixara_b2.name: Shockwave
skill.sk_ixara_b2.desc: Chaos Nova also knocks enemies back in addition to damage.
skill.sk_ixara_b3.name: Supernova
skill.sk_ixara_b4.name: Chain Reaction
skill.sk_ixara_b4.desc: Kills with Chaos Nova have a 30% chance to trigger another Nova immediately.
skill.sk_ixara_cap.name: Demon Unleashed
skill.sk_ixara_cap.desc: Upon reaching 10 Fury stacks: +100% damage, Chaos Nova available every 2 attacks, HP regenerates 5/s for 8s.
skill.sk_berserker_root.name: Blood Oath
skill.sk_berserker_root.desc: Berserker starts each wave with Blood Rage already active at 1.5× multiplier (barrier is treated as 40% lower for the first 8s).
skill.sk_berserker_a1.name: Savage Strikes
skill.sk_berserker_a1.desc: +15% base damage. Rampage also increases projectile speed by 50%.
skill.sk_berserker_a2.name: War Drums
skill.sk_berserker_a2.desc: Rampage cooldown reduced from 12s to 9s. Duration extended to 5s.
skill.sk_berserker_a3.name: Unstoppable
skill.sk_berserker_a3.desc: During Rampage: Berserker is immune to slow and freeze. All hits during Rampage are guaranteed crits.
skill.sk_berserker_a4.name: Iron Skin
skill.sk_berserker_a4.desc: +20% max HP. Each barrier hit also heals Berserker for 5 HP.
skill.sk_berserker_b1.name: Pain is Power
skill.sk_berserker_b1.desc: Blood Rage 3× threshold lowered: activates at 20% barrier HP instead of 10%.
skill.sk_berserker_b2.name: Adrenaline
skill.sk_berserker_b2.desc: +10% attack speed. Each time the barrier takes damage, attack speed is boosted by 5% for 3s (stacks up to 4×).
skill.sk_berserker_b3.name: Death Before Defeat
skill.sk_berserker_b3.desc: When Berserker would die, instead survives with 1 HP and instantly triggers Rampage (once per wave).
skill.sk_berserker_b4.name: Berserker Howl
skill.sk_berserker_b4.desc: At the start of Rampage, all allies gain +20% attack speed for 4s.
skill.sk_berserker_cap.name: Warlord Incarnate
skill.sk_berserker_cap.desc: Blood Rage is always at maximum (3×). Rampage is always active. Barrier damage instead fuels a permanent damage counter (+1% per hit, no cap).
skill.sk_frost_warden_root.name: Permafrost
skill.sk_frost_warden_root.desc: Ice Patches now form with only 2 frost marks instead of 3.
skill.sk_frost_warden_a1.name: Deep Freeze
skill.sk_frost_warden_a1.desc: Enemies on Ice Patches are slowed by 65% instead of 50%. Frost marks last 2s longer.
skill.sk_frost_warden_a2.name: Crystallize
skill.sk_frost_warden_a2.desc: Enemies that stand on a patch for 2s become fully frozen for 1.5s.
skill.sk_frost_warden_a3.name: Tundra
skill.sk_frost_warden_a3.desc: All Ice Patches are permanent for the entire wave. Maximum of 5 patches on the field at once.
skill.sk_frost_warden_a4.name: Arctic Wind
skill.sk_frost_warden_a4.desc: +20% range. Frost marks spread to 1 nearby enemy when applied.
skill.sk_frost_warden_b1.name: Glacial Spike
skill.sk_frost_warden_b1.desc: +15% damage. Frost marks deal 10 damage when applied to the target.
skill.sk_frost_warden_b2.name: Wall Mastery
skill.sk_frost_warden_b2.desc: Glacial Wall cooldown reduced from 18s to 12s. Wall lasts 2s longer.
skill.sk_frost_warden_b3.name: Avalanche
skill.sk_frost_warden_b3.desc: When Glacial Wall expires, it shatters dealing 3× its base damage to all enemies within 150px.
skill.sk_frost_warden_b4.name: Cold Snap
skill.sk_frost_warden_b4.desc: Every 5th Frost Warden shot fires a Cold Snap that instantly freezes the target for 1s.
skill.sk_frost_warden_cap.name: Absolute Zero
skill.sk_frost_warden_cap.desc: The entire battlefield becomes an Ice Patch at all times. Glacial Wall is permanent. All frozen enemies take +50% damage from all sources.
skill.sk_inquisitor_root.name: Studied Enemy
skill.sk_inquisitor_root.desc: Verdict activates every 3 kills instead of 5 (faster bonus accumulation).
skill.sk_inquisitor_a1.name: Deep Knowledge
skill.sk_inquisitor_a1.desc: Verdict bonus per threshold increased from +20% to +30% per enemy type.
skill.sk_inquisitor_a2.name: Heresy Hunter
skill.sk_inquisitor_a2.desc: Verdict cap increased from +100% to +150%. Inquisitor also deals +10% damage to elite enemies.
skill.sk_inquisitor_a3.name: Grand Inquisitor
skill.sk_inquisitor_a3.desc: All Verdict bonuses apply to ALL allies (not just Inquisitor). Sharing the knowledge.
skill.sk_inquisitor_a4.name: Tactical Analysis
skill.sk_inquisitor_a4.desc: Verdict bonuses never reset between waves (with or without the Holy Mandate relic).
skill.sk_inquisitor_b1.name: Swift Judgment
skill.sk_inquisitor_b1.desc: Sentence cooldown reduced from 20s to 14s. Sentenced target takes +40% damage (was +30%).
skill.sk_inquisitor_b2.name: Death Warrant
skill.sk_inquisitor_b2.desc: When a Sentenced enemy dies, all enemies of the same type on screen take 80 damage.
skill.sk_inquisitor_b3.name: Execution Order
skill.sk_inquisitor_b3.desc: Sentence causes the target to explode on death dealing 200% Inquisitor damage in AoE.
skill.sk_inquisitor_b4.name: Mark of Shame
skill.sk_inquisitor_b4.desc: Sentenced enemy also has -30% damage and -20% speed (in addition to taking extra damage).
skill.sk_inquisitor_cap.name: Divine Purge
skill.sk_inquisitor_cap.desc: Sentence now applies to ALL enemies simultaneously. Verdict bonuses are shared globally. Every kill restores 1 barrier HP.
skill.sk_mal_root.name: Open Grimoire
skill.sk_mal_root.desc: Spell cycle speeds up by 15%. Each Empowered spell deals +25% extra damage on top of the normal empowered bonus.
skill.sk_mal_a1.name: Arcane Mastery
skill.sk_mal_a1.desc: +20% damage. Arcane Bolt now pierces 3 enemies and ricochets once.
skill.sk_mal_a2.name: Death Resonance
skill.sk_mal_a2.desc: Death Nova radius +50%. Enemies hit by Death Nova take +20% damage from all sources for 4s.
skill.sk_mal_a3.name: Void Mastery
skill.sk_mal_a3.desc: Void Chains now fires in all directions. Chain slow increased to -75%. Meteor leaves a void zone for 5s dealing continuous damage.
skill.sk_mal_a4.name: Empowered Soul
skill.sk_mal_a4.desc: Soul threshold reduced from 10 to 6. Empowered spells also fire a secondary smaller projectile.
skill.sk_mal_b1.name: Solitude
skill.sk_mal_b1.desc: Solitary bonus doubled at each tier. Alone: +160% damage and immune to targeting.
skill.sk_mal_b2.name: Swift Ascension
skill.sk_mal_b2.desc: Ascension charge threshold reduced by 30%. Ascension duration extended to 15s.
skill.sk_mal_b3.name: Full Ascension
skill.sk_mal_b3.desc: During Ascension: all 4 spells fire simultaneously. Attack speed doubled. All spells are auto-Empowered.
skill.sk_mal_b4.name: Soul Harvest
skill.sk_mal_b4.desc: Soul collection radius +100px. Collecting a soul heals Malachar for 8 HP. Every 3rd soul also charges Ascension.
skill.sk_mal_cap.name: Final Form
skill.sk_mal_cap.desc: Extinction triggers every 3 cycles instead of 5. Ascension is permanent after first activation. Solitary bonus applies even with allies present (+20% per ally slot regardless).
compendium.new-mage.title: Summon: Krash
compendium.new-mage.flavorText: Masters of the basic arcane arts, essential to any defense.
compendium.new-archer.title: Summon: Ifigenia
compendium.new-archer.description: High speed, long range. Applies bleed.
compendium.new-archer.flavorText: Eagle eyes watching over the kingdom's borders.
compendium.new-warlock.title: Summon: Sibilus
compendium.new-warlock.flavorText: Dark pacts bring immense power, but at a cost of speed.
compendium.new-druid.title: Summon: Vindimia
compendium.new-druid.description: Season Cycle: Spring heals, Summer +dmg, Autumn explodes, Winter freezes. Every 10 shots.
compendium.new-druid.flavorText: The forest rises to protect its secrets.
compendium.new-necro.title: Summon: Ikan
compendium.new-necro.description: Summons a Common Undead at wave start. Commands the dead.
compendium.new-necro.flavorText: Death is not the end. It is merely the beginning of service.
compendium.new-bard.title: Summon: Sonetto
compendium.new-bard.flavorText: Songs that inspire courage even in the most fearful hearts.
compendium.new-cleric.title: Summon: Alva
compendium.new-cleric.flavorText: Faith moves mountains and brings down armies.
compendium.new-priest.title: Summon: Hyo
compendium.new-priest.description: Heals wounded allies on the field.
compendium.new-priest.flavorText: Sacred light restores body and spirit.
compendium.expand-slots.title: Command Expansion
compendium.expand-slots.flavorText: A better general can command a larger army.
compendium.archer-thousandcuts.title: Thousand Cuts
compendium.archer-thousandcuts.descripti: Stackable (up to 5x): each copy gives Archers +8% permanent damage.
compendium.archer-thousandcuts.flavorTex: A thousand small wounds bleed more than one large one.
compendium.archer-explosive.title: Explosive Arrow
compendium.archer-explosive.description: Archers have a 10% chance to fire explosive arrows (AoE).
compendium.archer-explosive.flavorText: An unstable surprise at the tip of the arrow.
compendium.archer-rain.title: Arrow Rain
compendium.archer-rain.description: Archers attack all enemies every 12 hits.
compendium.archer-rain.flavorText: The sky darkens with elven fury.
compendium.warlock-lightning.title: Black Storm
compendium.warlock-lightning.description: Warlocks have a 15% chance to cast Lightning (AoE).
compendium.warlock-lightning.flavorText: The sky darkens when they whisper.
compendium.necro-explosion.title: Explosive Plague
compendium.necro-explosion.description: Necromancers have a 15% chance to cast vile fire. On kill, explodes in an area.
compendium.necro-explosion.flavorText: The enemy's body becomes the perfect weapon.
compendium.druid-roots.title: Ancestral Roots
compendium.druid-roots.description: On entering Spring, the earth erupts in roots — all enemies are rooted for 1.5s.
compendium.druid-roots.flavorText: The earth reclaims those who dare tread upon it.
compendium.cleric-blessing.title: Holy Fervor
compendium.cleric-blessing.description: ✨ Each Cleric shot has a chance to double ALL ally damage for 3s. Max 5 stacks.
compendium.cleric-blessing.flavorText: A divine light bathes the battlefield, guiding every strike.
compendium.dmg-boost.title: Global Arcane Power
compendium.gold-cache.title: Hidden Treasure
compendium.gold-cache.flavorText: What was lost, now is found.
compendium.mage-surge.title: Arcane Surge
compendium.mage-surge.flavorText: Raw arcane power concentrated into every shot.
compendium.mage-fireball-base.title: Igniblast
compendium.mage-fireball-base.descriptio: 🔮 Stackable (5x): +8% chance per stack to fire a Fireball (AoE) on hit.
compendium.mage-fireball-base.flavorText: Some mages ask why. This one asks how much.
compendium.mage-blink.title: Arcane Blink
compendium.warlock-drain.title: Soul Drain
compendium.warlock-drain.description: 🌑 Stackable (5x): +2% HP stolen per kill per stack. Max 10% lifesteal.
compendium.warlock-drain.flavorText: Every soul consumed feeds the hunger.
compendium.warlock-void.title: Void Pact
compendium.warlock-void.description: 🌑 Stackable (3x): each copy trades -20% attack speed for +50% damage.
compendium.warlock-void.flavorText: The void does not negotiate. It only takes.
compendium.druid-cycle.title: Accelerated Cycle
compendium.druid-cycle.description: 🌿 Seasons advance every 7/6/5 shots (instead of 10). Max 3 stacks.
compendium.druid-eclipse.title: Druidic Eclipse
compendium.druid-eclipse.description: 🌑 After completing a full cycle, the next projectile applies ALL 4 seasons at once.
compendium.druid-eclipse.flavorText: When the seasons align, nature stands still.
compendium.necro-power.title: Dark Pact
compendium.necro-power.description: 💀 All Undead deal +15% damage per stack. Max 5 stacks (+75% total).
compendium.necro-power.flavorText: A pact sealed in bone and shadow.
compendium.necro-raise.title: Raise Undead
compendium.necro-raise.description: 💀 Uncommon — Enemy deaths have a 3% chance to rise as Undead. Each stack adds +2%. Max 5 stacks (13% total).
compendium.necro-raise.flavorText: No corpse goes to waste on his battlefield.
compendium.necro-plague-mastery.title: Plague Mastery
compendium.necro-plague-mastery.descript: 💀 Stackable (3x): Necromancer shots have +15% chance to inflict a wasting curse — cursed enemies take +20% damage from all sources and move 10% slower.
compendium.necro-plague-mastery.flavorTe: Disease is just another form of control.
compendium.necro-death-lord.title: Death Lord
compendium.necro-death-lord.description: 💀 MYTHIC — Necromancer ascends. Spawns 3 Undead at wave start, all Undead +100% damage, curses all enemies at wave start (−30% speed & damage for 10s).
compendium.necro-death-lord.flavorText: The dead do not follow him. They worship him.
compendium.bard-radius.title: Crescendo
compendium.bard-radius.description: 🎵 Bard aura radius increases by +25%. Max 5 stacks.
compendium.bard-radius.flavorText: The melody reaches further than any blade.
compendium.bard-hymn.title: Battle Hymn
compendium.bard-hymn.description: 🎵 Stackable (5x): each copy increases Bard aura attack speed buff by +10% (starts at +35%).
compendium.bard-hymn.flavorText: The rhythm of war has its own tempo.
compendium.bard-anthem.title: Anthem of Ruin
compendium.bard-anthem.description: 🎵 Bard joins combat: +100% damage and 25% crit; the aura gives all allies +20% damage. Max 2 stacks.
compendium.bard-anthem.flavorText: The last song they will ever hear.
compendium.cleric-sacred.title: Sacred Ground
compendium.cleric-sacred.description: ✨ Stackable (5x): each copy adds +1% max HP self-heal per shot fired by Cleric.
compendium.paladin-will.title: Iron Will
compendium.paladin-caldera.title: Divine Caldera
compendium.paladin-caldera.description: 🛡 Stackable (5x): Paladin radiates AoE holy fire, each copy adds +20% caldera damage.
compendium.paladin-martyr.title: Martyr's Oath
compendium.paladin-martyr.description: 🛡 Stackable (3x): below HP threshold, attack speed doubles until healed.
compendium.paladin-martyr.flavorText: The closer to death, the stronger the resolve.
compendium.priest-mending.title: Mending Touch
compendium.priest-mending.description: ⚕ Priest heal power increases by +30% per copy. Stackable.
compendium.priest-mending.flavorText: The gentle touch that turns the tide.
compendium.priest-guard.title: Guardian Aura
compendium.priest-guard.description: ⚕ Stackable (5x): each copy reduces all ally damage taken by -5%. Max -25%.
compendium.priest-guard.flavorText: Under the Priest's watch, no one falls alone.
compendium.priest-res.title: Resurrection
compendium.priest-res.description: ⚕ Instantly restore 40%+ HP to ALL allies. Can be taken multiple times for larger heals.
compendium.priest-res.flavorText: Death is not the end. Not today.
compendium.cleric-battle-prayer.title: Battle Prayer
compendium.cleric-battle-prayer.descript: ✨ Stackable (5x): Cleric has increasing chance to triple ALL ally damage for 3s per shot.
compendium.new-runesmith.title: Summon: Veltharion
compendium.new-runesmith.description: The Runesmith. Inscribes arcane runes that unleash chain lightning every 5th shot.
compendium.new-runesmith.flavorText: He does not aim. He calculates.
compendium.new-sylvanite.title: Summon: Aelindra
compendium.new-sylvanite.description: The Sylvanite. Ancient forest spirit that poisons enemies and heals allies passively.
compendium.new-sylvanite.flavorText: The roots remember every war ever fought above them.
compendium.new-dreadlord.title: Summon: Kael'Vor
compendium.new-dreadlord.description: The Dreadlord. Burns own life force for catastrophic damage. Deadlier near death.
compendium.new-dreadlord.flavorText: Pain is not a weakness. It is the fuel.
compendium.new-vex.title: Summon: Vex
compendium.new-vex.description: The Assassin. Every 5th attack she vanishes and reappears on the target, dealing AoE damage. Kills restore her HP.
compendium.vex-hunger.title: Hunger
compendium.vex-hunger.description: 🩸 Vex: Sai Rush now steals 12% of damage dealt as HP (up from 5%). The more she kills, the harder she is to kill.
compendium.vex-hunger.flavorText: The hunger never leaves. It just becomes more polite.
compendium.vex-blink.title: Blink Strike
compendium.vex-blink.description: 🩸 Vex: Sai Rush AoE radius increases from 120 to 160px. More enemies caught in every teleport.
compendium.vex-blink.flavorText: The trick isn't being fast. It's arriving before you're seen.
compendium.vex-veil.title: Veil of Shadow
compendium.vex-veil.description: 🩸 Vex: 35% chance to dodge each enemy projectile.
compendium.vex-veil.flavorText: The veil hides not the face. It hides the intent.
compendium.new-zylvara.title: Summon: Zylvara
compendium.new-zylvara.description: The Shadow Archer. Poisons on every hit. Every 6th attack vanishes into shadow and reappears with a triple-damage kill shot.
compendium.new-zylvara.flavorText: She was never here. The arrow was.
compendium.zylvara-poison.title: Venom of the Deep
compendium.zylvara-poison.description: 🌑 Zylvara: poison lasts 1s longer and each arrow has a 15% chance to apply an extra stack.
compendium.zylvara-poison.flavorText: The caves taught patience. The toxin teaches permanence.
compendium.zylvara-cloak.title: Shadow Cloak
compendium.zylvara-cloak.description: 🌑 Zylvara: Shadow Step every 4 attacks (was 6) and its immunity lasts 2.5s (was 1.5s).
compendium.zylvara-cloak.flavorText: Between light and dark lives the deadliest second.
compendium.zylvara-extinct.title: Extinction Protocol
compendium.zylvara-extinct.description: 🌑 Legendary: Shadow Step instantly kills non-boss enemies below 25% HP. Each execution grants +1 gold.
compendium.zylvara-extinct.flavorText: She does not finish fights. She ends them.
compendium.new-morrigan.title: Summon: Morrigan
compendium.new-morrigan.description: The Soul Devourer. Every nearby kill grants a soul: +2% damage and +4px range permanently. Consuming Strike rewards consecutive hits. Devour Mode every 10 souls: AoE explosive shots for 5s.
compendium.new-morrigan.flavorText: She arrived before the battle did. She always does. She has been counting since 1247.
compendium.morrigan-ravenous.title: Ravenous
compendium.morrigan-ravenous.description: 💜 Rare: Soul collection radius +80px. Morrigan also collects souls from kills made by any ally within range.
compendium.morrigan-ravenous.flavorText: She does not discriminate. A soul is a soul.
compendium.morrigan-bitterharvest.title: Bitter Harvest
compendium.morrigan-bitterharvest.descri: 💜 Rare: Each soul grants +3% damage instead of +2%. Soul bonus doubled during Devour Mode.
compendium.morrigan-bitterharvest.flavor: The longer she waits, the worse it gets. For everyone else.
compendium.morrigan-devourstorm.title: Devouring Storm
compendium.morrigan-devourstorm.descript: 💜 Legendary: At 50+ souls: permanently enter half-Devour state. All projectiles deal AoE splash. No soul cap, no diminishing returns.
compendium.morrigan-devourstorm.flavorTe: Four hundred years of patience. This is what patience looks like.
compendium.morrigan-plague.title: Soul Plague
compendium.morrigan-plague.description: 💜 Mythic: Morrigan's attacks infect enemies with a living plague for 5s. The plague jumps to the nearest enemy on host death and refreshes.
compendium.morrigan-plague.flavorText: It does not end with death. Death is how it travels.
compendium.new-ixara.title: Summon: Ixara
compendium.new-ixara.description: The Chaos Demoness. Gains Fury when hit. Chaos Nova scales with rage. At max fury: clears the field at the cost of her own mobility.
compendium.new-ixara.flavorText: Pain is not a problem. It is the point.
compendium.ixara-rage.title: Rage Conduit
compendium.ixara-rage.description: 💥 Ixara: each Fury stack also grants +3% attack speed (max +30%). Fury stacks decay 50% slower between waves.
compendium.ixara-ricochet.title: Horns of Chaos
compendium.ixara-ricochet.description: 💥 Ixara: Chaos Nova radius goes from 110px to 150px and its stun lasts 1.2s.
compendium.ixara-ricochet.flavorText: The chaos does not pick a direction. It picks everyone.
compendium.ixara-collapse.title: Total Collapse
compendium.ixara-collapse.description: 💥 Legendary: Chaos Nova at 10 Fury removes 60% of current HP from every non-boss enemy and heals all allies for 30 HP. Fury resets to zero.
compendium.ixara-collapse.flavorText: She calls it a controlled explosion. Nothing about it is controlled.
compendium.new-jester.title: Summon: Ming
compendium.new-jester.description: The Jester. Cycles Red (slow) / Gold (heal) / Purple (confuse) balls. Pure chaos.
compendium.new-jester.flavorText: The joke is always on the enemy.
compendium.jester-dead-mans-hand.title: Dead Man's Hand
compendium.jester-dead-mans-hand.descrip: ☠ ULTIMATE: 5% chance per kill (max 1 every 8s) to drop a card stolen from the soul of the slain — a random upgrade appears mid-battle for you to claim.
compendium.jester-dead-mans-hand.flavorT: He deals the cards. You play them. Nobody asked the dead.
compendium.jester-chaos.title: Chaos Aura
compendium.jester-chaos.description: 🃏 At wave start, randomly buffs ALL allies: +30% atk speed, +25% damage, or +20% range for 15s.
compendium.jester-chaos.flavorText: Order is just chaos that hasn't introduced itself yet.
compendium.jester-pratfall.title: Pratfall
compendium.jester-pratfall.description: 🃏 Jester hits have a 20% chance to stun the enemy for 0.6s.
compendium.jester-pratfall.flavorText: Dignity is overrated in a war zone.
compendium.jester-roulette.title: Roulette
compendium.jester-roulette.description: 🃏 Each kill has an 8% chance to trigger a massive random effect: AoE explosion, full heal, enemy teleport, speed frenzy, or mass confusion.
compendium.jester-roulette.flavorText: Spin the wheel. Pray to no one in particular.
compendium.jester-tricks.title: Bag of Tricks
compendium.jester-tricks.description: 🃏 Stackable (3x): Jester +20% damage and stronger ball effects per stack.
compendium.jester-tricks.flavorText: The bag is bottomless. The tricks are not.
compendium.runesmith-resonance.title: Rune Resonance
compendium.runesmith-resonance.descripti: ⚡ Stackable (4x): each Runesmith shot has +8% chance to chain to a second nearby enemy for 60% damage.
compendium.runesmith-volley.title: Rune Volley
compendium.runesmith-volley.description: ⚡ Stackable (5x): Runesmith fires +1 projectile per shot per stack. Max 5 stacks.
compendium.runesmith-overload.title: Rune Overload
compendium.runesmith-overload.descriptio: ⚡ Stackable (3x): chain lightning deals +40% per stack and hits 1 more enemy. Max 3 stacks.
compendium.runesmith-overload.flavorText: The rune screams. The enemy burns.
compendium.runesmith-reach.title: Extended Inscription
compendium.runesmith-reach.description: ⚡ Runesmith range increases by +30% and chain hits 1 more enemy. Max 5 stacks.
compendium.runesmith-reach.flavorText: A rune cast further seals fate sooner.
compendium.sylvanite-spore-burst.title: Spore Burst
compendium.sylvanite-spore-burst.descrip: 🌿 Stackable (3x): every 5th Sylvanite shot releases a poison cloud that lingers for 3s, poisoning all enemies who pass through it.
compendium.sylvanite-spore-burst.flavorT: The forest exhales. Nothing survives the breath.
compendium.sylvanite-toxin.title: Virulent Toxin
compendium.sylvanite-toxin.description: 🌿 Stackable (5x): Sylvanite poison deals +25% damage per tick per stack. Max 5 stacks.
compendium.sylvanite-toxin.flavorText: The forest has millennia of practice.
compendium.sylvanite-bloom.title: Nature's Bloom
compendium.sylvanite-bloom.description: 🌿 Stackable (3x): at the start of each wave, ALL allies are healed for 10–30 HP.
compendium.sylvanite-bloom.flavorText: New life springs even in the darkest soil.
compendium.sylvanite-roots.title: Entangling Roots
compendium.sylvanite-roots.description: 🌿 Stackable (3x): poisoned enemies have a 20–65% chance to be rooted for 1.5 seconds.
compendium.sylvanite-roots.flavorText: The earth holds what the eye cannot.
compendium.dreadlord-hunger.title: Void Hunger
compendium.dreadlord-hunger.description: 💀 Stackable (4x): each kill permanently increases Dreadlord damage by +2%. Stacks are lost if Dreadlord dies.
compendium.dreadlord-hunger.flavorText: Every soul feeds the darkness inside.
compendium.dreadlord-edge.title: Void Strike
compendium.dreadlord-edge.description: 💀 Dreadlord +25% base dmg + double hit chance. Each Void Harvest stack also adds +4% dmg.
compendium.dreadlord-rupture.title: Void Rupture
compendium.dreadlord-rupture.description: 💀 Stackable (3x): Dreadlord shots have a 30–90% chance to explode in an area for 50% splash damage.
compendium.dreadlord-harvest.title: Void Gluttony
compendium.dreadlord-harvest.description: 💀 Stackable (3x): increases max Void Harvest cap by +5 per stack (base 15 → up to 30). More kills = more power.
compendium.dreadlord-harvest.flavorText: The void is never full. Neither is he.
compendium.iron-discipline.title: Iron Discipline
compendium.iron-discipline.description: ⚔️ ALL allies gain +5% damage per living ally on the field. Scales with army size.
compendium.iron-discipline.flavorText: A disciplined army fights as one blade.
compendium.blood-price.title: Blood Price
compendium.blood-price.description: 💉 ALL allies lose 10% max HP but gain +30% permanent damage. No pain, no gain.
compendium.blood-price.flavorText: The price was worth it. It always is.
compendium.arcane-efficiency.title: Arcane Efficiency
compendium.arcane-efficiency.description: ✨ Each attack has a 10% chance to not trigger cooldown — firing again instantly.
compendium.arcane-efficiency.flavorText: Less wasted time. More wasted enemies.
compendium.eagle-eye.title: Eagle's Eye
compendium.eagle-eye.description: 🦅 ALL allies gain +15% range permanently. Stackable.
compendium.last-stand.title: Last Stand
compendium.last-stand.description: 🔥 ALL allies gain +15% damage per ally who has died this run. Grows as the army falls.
compendium.last-stand.flavorText: Those who fall make those who stand unstoppable.
compendium.overkill.title: Overkill
compendium.overkill.description: 💥 Excess damage on a kill ricochets to the nearest enemy.
compendium.momentum.title: Momentum
compendium.momentum.description: Each 5 kills without Barrier taking damage: ALL allies +2% damage (max +20%, 50 kills). Resets and reverts if Barrier is hit.
compendium.glass-cannon.title: Glass Cannon
compendium.glass-cannon.description: 🔱 ALL allies lose 50% max HP but gain +80% permanent damage. High risk, devastating reward.
compendium.glass-cannon.flavorText: They shatter on first touch. Everything else shatters first.
compendium.fortitude.title: Fortitude
compendium.fortitude.description: 💚 ALL allies passively regenerate 2 HP per second.
compendium.fortitude.flavorText: A wound that cannot kill only hardens the resolve.
compendium.shield-wall.title: Shield Wall
compendium.shield-wall.description: The ally with most HP absorbs 30% of damage dealt to all other allies.
compendium.shield-wall.flavorText: The strongest stands between the weak and the storm.
compendium.second-wind.title: Second Wind
compendium.second-wind.description: 💨 Once per wave, the first ally that would die instead survives with 1 HP.
compendium.second-wind.flavorText: Death reached for them. They stepped aside.
compendium.gamblers-coin.title: Gambler's Coin
compendium.gamblers-coin.description: 🎲 Flip a coin: 50% gain 600 Gold. 50% lose 200 Gold. Taken immediately.
compendium.gamblers-coin.flavorText: Fortune rewards the bold. And punishes them.
compendium.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
compendium.sacrifice.description: ☠ Remove a random ally permanently. ALL remaining allies gain +20% to all stats.
compendium.sacrifice.flavorText: One life. To sharpen all the others.
compendium.cursed-strength.title: Cursed Strength
compendium.cursed-strength.description: ⚠️ ALL allies gain +40% damage but enemies also deal +20% more damage.
compendium.dark-bargain.title: Dark Bargain
compendium.dark-bargain.description: 🌑 Barrier loses 15 HP. ALL allies gain +25% permanent damage.
compendium.dark-bargain.flavorText: The wall bleeds so the army thrives.
compendium.war-council.title: War Council
compendium.war-council.description: 📜 Your next 2 level-up offers show 5 cards instead of 3.
compendium.tactical-retreat.title: Tactical Retreat
compendium.tactical-retreat.description: ⚡ Once per wave, when an ally drops below 20% HP, they teleport to the safest grid position and heal 25% max HP.
compendium.tactical-retreat.flavorText: Live to fight again. That is the only order.
compendium.bulwark-formation.title: Bulwark Formation
