compendium.bulwark-formation.description: 🛡 ALL allies gain a permanent 15-HP damage shield that refreshes every wave.
compendium.bulwark-formation.flavorText: A wall of flesh. A wall of will.
compendium.transmutation.title: Transmutation
compendium.transmutation.description: ⚗️ Convert all current Gold into XP. Every 10 gold = 1 bonus XP.
compendium.soul-link.title: Soul Link
compendium.soul-link.description: 🔗 When any ally is healed, ALL other allies heal 20% of that amount too.
compendium.soul-link.flavorText: Bound in life. Bound in battle.
compendium.archer-sniper.title: Sniper Protocol
compendium.archer-sniper.description: 🏹 The first arrow of each wave and every 10th arrow deal triple damage.
compendium.archer-sniper.flavorText: The opening shot decides the fight.
compendium.warlock-hex.title: Hex
compendium.warlock-hex.description: 🌑 Warlock shots curse targets — hexed enemies take +25% damage from ALL sources for 4s.
compendium.warlock-hex.flavorText: The curse does not care who throws the next punch.
compendium.druid-spore.title: Toxic Spores
compendium.druid-spore.description: 🍂 Autumn season: fires 5 spores instead of 3. 2nd stack: poison lasts 3× longer.
compendium.druid-spore.flavorText: The forest is patient. And very thorough.
compendium.cleric-divine-shield.title: Divine Shield
compendium.cleric-divine-shield.descript: ✨ Every 10th Cleric shot creates a 20-damage absorb shield on the most wounded ally.
compendium.paladin-holy-ground.title: Holy Ground
compendium.paladin-holy-ground.descripti: 🛡 Paladin consecrates the battlefield — all enemies move 20% slower permanently.
compendium.paladin-holy-ground.flavorTex: To walk here is to walk in judgment.
compendium.priest-mass-mending.title: Mass Mending
compendium.priest-mass-mending.descripti: ⚕ Priest now heals ALL wounded allies with each shot, not just the most injured.
compendium.bard-dirge.title: Dirge of Doom
compendium.bard-dirge.description: 🎵 Bard aura slows all enemies in range by 30% and reduces their damage by 20%.
compendium.bard-dirge.flavorText: The last song they will hear, played slowly.
compendium.archer-storm.title: Storm of Arrows
compendium.archer-storm.description: 🏹 MYTHIC: Archer enters permanent frenzy — attack speed triples, arrows pierce every enemy, Arrow Rain auto-fires every 8 kills.
compendium.archer-storm.flavorText: The sky darkens. The arrows do not run out.
compendium.mage-overload.title: Arcane Overload
compendium.mage-overload.description: 🔮 Every 10th Mage shot unleashes an Arcane Burst — deals 300% damage in a 120px AoE. Each stack reduces the trigger to every 8th shot.
compendium.mage-overload.flavorText: The spell does not break. It overflows.
compendium.mage-singularity.title: Arcane Singularity
compendium.mage-singularity.description: 🔮 MYTHIC: Every 15th Mage shot tears a void rift that pulls all enemies within 200px and detonates. Echo and Fireball trigger simultaneously inside the rift.
compendium.mage-singularity.flavorText: The spell does not choose a target. It chooses everyone.
compendium.warlock-ascension.title: Void Ascension
compendium.warlock-ascension.description: 🌑 MYTHIC: Warlock loses 2% HP/s but every shot chains 3 extra enemies and deals 3× damage. Surviving the wave fully restores HP.
compendium.warlock-ascension.flavorText: Power absolute has a cost. He paid it in advance.
compendium.druid-ancientwill.title: Ancient Will
compendium.druid-ancientwill.description: 🌿 MYTHIC: Druid applies 2 seasons simultaneously on every shot. At wave start, spirits slow ALL enemies 30% for 10s. Druidic Eclipse triggers every cycle automatically.
compendium.druid-ancientwill.flavorText: The forest has no favorite season. It prefers all of them at once.
compendium.bard-grandfinale.title: Grand Finale
compendium.bard-grandfinale.description: 🎵 MYTHIC: Once per run, when tower falls below 50% HP — all allies gain +200% damage and max attack speed for 12s, all enemies confused for 6s. Bard keeps +60% permanent attack speed after.
compendium.bard-grandfinale.flavorText: The last song lasted three minutes. Nothing survived to hear the encore.
compendium.cleric-sanctifiedwrath.title: Sanctified Wrath
compendium.cleric-sanctifiedwrath.descri: ✨ MYTHIC: every 5th Cleric shot releases a Holy Nova hitting ALL enemies on screen for 60% of her damage, and the barrier recovers 3 HP. Battle Prayer chance +50%.
compendium.cleric-sanctifiedwrath.flavor: The light does not illuminate the path. It ignites the field.
compendium.paladin-eternalcrusade.title: Eternal Crusade
compendium.paladin-eternalcrusade.descri: 🛡 MYTHIC: Divine Caldera damage adds directly to every Paladin attack. Below 30% HP, he becomes immune for 5s once per wave. Caldera radius doubles.
compendium.paladin-eternalcrusade.flavor: There is no limit to what faith endures. It has been tested.
compendium.priest-divinecovenant.title: Divine Covenant
compendium.priest-divinecovenant.descrip: ⚕ MYTHIC: At wave start each ally receives a 50-damage divine shield. Once per wave an ally that would die is automatically saved at 1 HP. Guardian Aura reduction doubles.
compendium.priest-divinecovenant.flavorT: He does not heal wounds. He forbids them from existing.
compendium.runesmith-grandrune.title: Grand Rune
compendium.runesmith-grandrune.descripti: ⚡ MYTHIC: every 20th shot, the Runesmith fires a Grand Rune: lightning that hits ALL enemies on screen for 150% damage. Up to 3 per wave.
compendium.runesmith-grandrune.flavorTex: He does not write spells. He rewrites the rules of the battlefield.
compendium.sylvanite-worldtree.title: World Tree
compendium.sylvanite-worldtree.descripti: 🌿 MYTHIC: Sylvanite's poison afflicts ALL enemies on screen at all times. Nature's Bloom heals double.
compendium.sylvanite-worldtree.flavorTex: The tree does not come to war. War comes to the tree.
compendium.vex-shadowdeath.title: Shadow Death
compendium.vex-shadowdeath.description: 🩸 MYTHIC: Sai Rush triggers every 3rd attack. Each rush kill grows future rush area by 10% for the whole run (up to +100%). At 10 kills, rushes deal 3× damage.
compendium.vex-shadowdeath.flavorText: She does not hunt. She arrives at the end.
compendium.dreadlord-apotheosis.title: Void Apotheosis
compendium.dreadlord-apotheosis.descript: 💀 MYTHIC: +1% permanent damage per 1% of max HP missing (at 10% HP = +90% dmg). Once per run instead of dying he detonates (300% dmg to all enemies) and revives at 30% HP.
compendium.dreadlord-apotheosis.flavorTe: He has already died. He did not enjoy it.
compendium.zylvara-eternaleclipse.title: Eternal Eclipse
compendium.zylvara-eternaleclipse.descri: 🌑 MYTHIC: Shadow Step triggers every 3rd attack with no cooldown. Each kill during Shadow Step extends the next cloak by 0.5s (no cap). Kill shots during cloak detonate all poison stacks in AoE.
compendium.zylvara-eternaleclipse.flavor: She was never here. The arrow was.
compendium.ixara-primalrage.title: Primal Rage
compendium.ixara-primalrage.description: 💥 MYTHIC: Fury is uncapped and never decays between waves. At 15+ Fury, Chaos Nova also fires on its own every 6s.
compendium.ixara-primalrage.flavorText: Pain is not a problem. It is the point.
compendium.sacred-trinity.title: Sacred Trinity
compendium.sacred-trinity.description: ✦ Synergy — Paladin + Priest + Cleric: all holy units +28–65% Dmg, Barrier regenerates extra HP/s.
compendium.shadow-council.title: Shadow Council
compendium.shadow-council.description: ✦ Synergy — Warlock + Necromancer: +45–100% Dmg, Necro skeleton chance greatly increased.
compendium.shadow-council.flavorText: In darkness, they found their accord.
compendium.natures-wrath.title: Nature's Wrath
compendium.natures-wrath.description: ✦ Synergy — Druid + Archer: +18–42% Atk Speed & Crit Chance. Druid roots on crit at tier 2.
compendium.arcane-storm.title: Arcane Storm
compendium.arcane-storm.description: ✦ Synergy — Mage + Warlock: +30–65% Damage & Range. Spells deal more at tier 2.
compendium.arcane-storm.flavorText: Two schools of destruction, one storm.
compendium.iron-bulwark.title: Iron & Ice Bulwark
compendium.iron-bulwark.description: ✦ Synergy — Paladin + Frost Warden: Barrier takes 15–30% less damage, Ice Patches slow 15% more and, at tier 2, Glacial Wall freezes for +1s.
compendium.death-choir.title: Death Choir
compendium.death-choir.description: ✦ Synergy — Necromancer + Bard: skeletons +70–180% Dmg. Tier 2: Bard aura revives fallen allies.
compendium.death-choir.flavorText: Even the dead march to his beat.
compendium.arcane-barrage.title: Arcane Barrage
compendium.arcane-barrage.description: ✦ Synergy — Mage + Archer: +15–35% Range, projectiles pierce extra enemies.
compendium.arcane-barrage.flavorText: Magic and steel find the same mark.
compendium.soul-mending.title: Soul Mending
compendium.soul-mending.description: ✦ Synergy — Priest + Bard: heals spread to nearby allies. Tier 2: heals ALL allies.
compendium.soul-mending.flavorText: Music carries healing as readily as sorrow.
compendium.wild-hunt.title: Wild Hunt
compendium.wild-hunt.description: ✦ Synergy — Archer + Druid + Bard: +18–35% Dmg (and +15% Atk Speed at tier 2); the Bard's aura gives +12–25% Dmg. Bard becomes a damage dealer.
compendium.wild-hunt.flavorText: The hunt has no beginning. No end.
compendium.storm-forge.title: Storm Forge
compendium.storm-forge.description: ✦ Synergy — Runesmith + Mage: chain hits +1 extra enemy, +40–85% Dmg & Range.
compendium.storm-forge.flavorText: The forge and the storm are the same force.
compendium.verdant-pact.title: Verdant Pact
compendium.verdant-pact.description: ✦ Synergy — Sylvanite + Druid: crits poison, +40–85% Dmg. Tier 2: roots on crit.
compendium.verdant-pact.flavorText: The old forest pact is sealed in thorns.
compendium.dark-hunger.title: Dark Hunger
compendium.dark-hunger.description: ✦ Synergy — Dreadlord + Warlock: Dreadlord +35–60% Dmg, and kills restore 3 HP to him.
compendium.life-forge.title: Life Forge
compendium.life-forge.description: ✦ Synergy — Sylvanite + Priest: Priest heals +45% stronger. Tier 2: heals also poison enemies.
compendium.life-forge.flavorText: Life and poison share the same root.
compendium.arcane-ruin.title: Arcane Ruin
compendium.arcane-ruin.description: ✦ Synergy — Runesmith + Warlock + Mage: +50–110% Dmg, chain lightning every 2nd shot.
compendium.umbral-brood.title: Umbral Brood
compendium.umbral-brood.description: ✦ Synergy — Zylvara (1/2/4 copies): Zylvara +20–80% Dmg and +6–28% Atk Speed.
compendium.umbral-brood.flavorText: One shadow is a threat. A brood is a sentence.
compendium.coven-pyre.title: Coven Pyre
compendium.coven-pyre.description: ✦ Synergy — Morrigan (1/2/4 copies): Morrigan +20–80% Dmg; from 2 copies Living Hex hits harder, lasts longer and jumps more.
compendium.coven-pyre.flavorText: A witch is a warning. A coven is a verdict.
compendium.riot-engine.title: Riot Engine
compendium.riot-engine.description: ✦ Synergy — Ixara (1/2/4 copies): Ixara +20–80% Dmg and +10–32% Atk Speed.
compendium.riot-engine.flavorText: Chaos becomes efficient when enough demons agree.
compendium.hexbound-pact.title: Hexbound Pact
compendium.hexbound-pact.description: ✦ Synergy — Morrigan + Warlock: heavy damage, stronger hexes and chain-affliction deaths.
compendium.hexbound-pact.flavorText: A curse whispered twice becomes doctrine.
compendium.grave-contagion.title: Grave Contagion
compendium.grave-contagion.description: ✦ Synergy — Morrigan + Necromancer: cursed kills raise undead and snowball the death wave.
compendium.grave-contagion.flavorText: The dead do not rest. They spread.
compendium.shadow-execution.title: Shadow Execution
compendium.shadow-execution.description: ✦ Synergy — Zylvara + Vex: prey is marked, amplified and eventually executed on sight.
compendium.shadow-execution.flavorText: First the mark. Then the silence.
compendium.hunters-sigil.title: Hunter's Sigil
compendium.hunters-sigil.description: ✦ Synergy — Zylvara + Archer: marked targets are deleted by focused ranged fire.
compendium.hunters-sigil.flavorText: One shadow points. A thousand arrows answer.
compendium.berserker-core.title: Berserker Core
compendium.berserker-core.description: ✦ Synergy — Ixara + Paladin: Fury grants damage reduction and max-Fury novas stabilize the wall.
compendium.berserker-core.flavorText: Rage survives longer when it wears armor.
compendium.war-anthem.title: War Anthem
compendium.war-anthem.description: ✦ Synergy — Ixara + Bard: high Fury becomes a team-wide damage and speed engine.
compendium.war-anthem.flavorText: She supplies the violence. He gives it rhythm.
compendium.new-berserker.title: Summon: Gorak
compendium.new-berserker.description: The Berserker. Blood Rage scales his damage up to 3× as barrier HP drops. Rampage every 12s: triple attack speed, piercing shots for 4s.
compendium.new-berserker.flavorText: He does not fight to win. He fights because stopping would mean thinking.
compendium.berserker-iron-skin.title: Iron Skin
compendium.berserker-iron-skin.descripti: 🪓 Berserker gains +25% max HP. Each time the barrier is hit, Berserker heals 5 HP. Wounds only make him harder.
compendium.berserker-iron-skin.flavorTex: Scars are just armor that grew in.
compendium.berserker-bloodrage.title: Blood Rage
compendium.berserker-bloodrage.descripti: 🪓 Rare: Blood Rage threshold improved — 2× damage activates at 35% barrier HP instead of 25%.
compendium.berserker-bloodrage.flavorTex: Pain is not a warning. It is an invitation.
compendium.berserker-warchief.title: Warchief's Drum
compendium.berserker-warchief.descriptio: 🪓 Legendary: Rampage also increases ALL allies' damage by +25% for its duration. The whole army hears the drum.
compendium.berserker-eternity.title: Eternal Fury
compendium.berserker-eternity.descriptio: 🪓 Mythic: Blood Rage multiplier never resets between waves. Waves that end with low barrier permanently stack +1% damage. No cap.
compendium.berserker-eternity.flavorText: He has been angry for so long he no longer remembers what calm felt like.
compendium.new-frost_warden.title: Summon: Serafyne
compendium.new-frost_warden.description: The Frost Warden. Shots leave frost marks — 3 marks create an Ice Patch (−50% enemy speed). Glacial Wall every 18s blocks and damages enemies.
compendium.new-frost_warden.flavorText: She finds the battlefield too warm. She corrects this.
compendium.frost_warden-deep-freeze.desc: ❄️ Rare: Ice Patches slow enemies by 65% instead of 50%. Frost marks last 2s longer before expiring.
compendium.frost_warden-deep-freeze.flav: Cold enough to stop anything. Anything.
compendium.frost_warden-shatter.title: Shatter
compendium.frost_warden-shatter.descript: ❄️ Rare: Frozen enemies that die explode into ice shards, dealing 80 damage to all enemies within 120px.
compendium.frost_warden-shatter.flavorTe: Death by cold. Then death by shards.
compendium.frost_warden-wall-mastery.des: ❄️ Legendary: Glacial Wall cooldown reduced from 18s to 12s. Wall duration extended by 2s. Enemies that collide take double damage.
compendium.frost_warden-wall-mastery.fla: She does not slow the enemy. She stops them.
compendium.frost_warden-absolute.title: Absolute Zero
compendium.frost_warden-absolute.descrip: ❄️ Mythic: The entire battlefield becomes an Ice Patch permanently. All frozen enemies take +50% damage from all sources.
compendium.frost_warden-absolute.flavorT: Movement is a privilege. She revokes it.
compendium.new-inquisitor.title: Summon: Valdric
compendium.new-inquisitor.description: The Inquisitor. Verdict: every 5 kills of the same enemy type = +20% permanent damage against it (cap +100%). Sentence marks one enemy — all allies deal +30% to it.
compendium.new-inquisitor.flavorText: He does not hate what he kills. He has simply studied it long enough to destroy it perfectly.
compendium.inquisitor-death-warrant.desc: ⚖️ When a Sentenced enemy dies, all enemies of the same type on screen take 80 damage immediately.
compendium.inquisitor-interrogation.desc: ⚖️ Rare: Sentence also reduces the target's speed and resistance by 20%. The marks never lie.
compendium.inquisitor-interrogation.flav: He does not ask questions to learn. He asks to confirm.
compendium.inquisitor-crusade.title: Crusade
compendium.inquisitor-crusade.descriptio: ⚖️ Legendary: When 5+ enemies of the same type are on screen, Inquisitor enters Crusade — auto AoE attacks for 4s. Unstoppable against hordes.
compendium.inquisitor-crusade.flavorText: One inquisitor. An army of reasons.
compendium.inquisitor-judgment.title: Final Judgment
compendium.inquisitor-judgment.descripti: ⚖️ Mythic: Killing a boss with Sentence active restores 15 barrier HP and grants +1 extra shop slot. Justice pays.
compendium.inquisitor-judgment.flavorTex: Every verdict has a price. He collects it.
compendium.blood-and-ice.title: Blood and Ice
compendium.blood-and-ice.description: ✦ Synergy — Berserker + Frost Warden: Ice Patches empower Blood Rage. Frozen enemies take +40% physical damage. Tier 3: Rampage freezes nearby enemies.
compendium.blood-and-ice.flavorText: One burns cold. The other burns hot. Together, nothing survives.
compendium.divine-verdict.title: Divine Verdict
compendium.divine-verdict.description: ✦ Synergy — Inquisitor + Paladin: Sentence applies Consecrated Ground. Verdict bonuses also empower Paladin. Tier 3: Sentence marks all enemies.
compendium.divine-verdict.flavorText: Judgment is not a moment. It is a policy.
compendium.iron-conviction.title: Iron Conviction
compendium.iron-conviction.description: ✦ Synergy — Berserker + Inquisitor: Sentenced enemies take full Blood Rage bonus. Verdict kills grant Berserker permanent damage. Tier 3: Rampage auto-sentences all enemies.
compendium.iron-conviction.flavorText: Rage without purpose is violence. With purpose, it is war.
compendium.permafrost-ward.title: Permafrost Ward
compendium.permafrost-ward.description: ✦ Synergy — Frost Warden + Cleric: Ice Patches pulse small heals to nearby allies. Tier 2: Glacial Wall blocks barrier damage. Tier 3: Flash Freeze also heals all allies.
compendium.permafrost-ward.flavorText: Cold preserves. Faith restores. Together, nothing decays.
compendium.new-malachar_human.title: Summon: Malachar
compendium.new-malachar_human.descriptio: The Redeemed. Cycles through 4 spells of the Chaos Grimoire. Collects souls for Empowered spells. Solitary: stronger with fewer allies. Ultimate: Ascension.
compendium.new-malachar_human.flavorText: He did not come back to apologize. He came back because he is the only one who knows what is coming.
compendium.malachar-soulpact.title: Soul Pact
compendium.malachar-soulpact.description: ✦ Malachar: Soul threshold reduced from 10 to 7. Empowered spells last 2 shots instead of 1.
compendium.malachar-soulpact.flavorText: The dead give willingly when asked by one of their own.
compendium.malachar-voidstorm.title: Void Storm
compendium.malachar-voidstorm.descriptio: ✦ Legendary: Death Nova explodes in a chain — each explosion has a 60% chance to trigger another (max 3 chains). Total damage can triple.
compendium.malachar-ascension.title: Mythic Ascension
compendium.malachar-ascension.descriptio: ✦ Mythic: During Ascension, Malachar levitates immune. All 4 spells fire simultaneously. Duration doubled to 20s.
compendium.malachar-ascension.flavorText: Four hundred years of power, compressed into twenty seconds.
compendium.malachar-solitude.title: Perfect Solitude
compendium.malachar-solitude.description: ✦ Legendary: When alone (no allies), Malachar becomes untargetable and gains +120% damage. Solitude is his weapon.
compendium.malachar-solitude.flavorText: He has been alone for four hundred years. He is very good at it.
compendium.vex-deathmark.title: Death Mark
compendium.vex-deathmark.description: ⚔️ Rare: Every kill during Sai Rush resets its cooldown once per wave. Rush kills also deal +50% bonus damage.
compendium.vex-deathmark.flavorText: She was never here. She just left a mark.
compendium.zylvara-widow.title: Widow's Mark
compendium.zylvara-widow.description: 🌑 Rare: Every 10th arrow marks the target for 5s. Marked enemies take 2× damage from Zylvara and reveal their max HP.
compendium.zylvara-widow.flavorText: She counts. You are not the first.
compendium.morrigan-soulecho.title: Soul Echo
compendium.morrigan-soulecho.description: 💜 Rare: When Devour Mode activates, all souls collected this wave count double for the permanent damage bonus.
compendium.morrigan-soulecho.flavorText: The dead are generous when properly motivated.
compendium.ixara-furysurge.title: Fury Surge
compendium.ixara-furysurge.description: 💥 Rare: At maximum Fury stacks, Ixara gains +40% attack speed and projectiles pierce through 2 enemies for 5s.
compendium.ixara-furysurge.flavorText: At full fury she does not aim. She does not need to.
compendium.berserker-battlecry.title: Battle Cry
compendium.berserker-battlecry.descripti: 🪓 Rare: At the start of Rampage, nearby enemies are feared (−70% speed) for 2s. Feared enemies also take +20% damage.
compendium.berserker-battlecry.flavorTex: They do not run from the sound. They run from what made it.
compendium.frost_warden-coldsnap.title: Cold Snap
compendium.frost_warden-coldsnap.descrip: ❄️ Rare: Every 5th Frost Warden shot instantly freezes the target for 1.5s regardless of frost mark stacks.
compendium.frost_warden-coldsnap.flavorT: No buildup. No warning. Just cold.
compendium.inquisitor-holybrand.title: Holy Brand
compendium.inquisitor-holybrand.descript: ⚖️ Rare: When Sentence is applied, a second nearby enemy is also Branded — taking +20% damage from all sources for the duration.
compendium.inquisitor-holybrand.flavorTe: He has enough judgment for everyone.
compendium.malachar-voidrift.title: Void Rift
compendium.malachar-voidrift.description: 🔮 Rare: After Extinction triggers, all enemies on screen are slowed −50% for 3s as void energy dissipates. Extinction cooldown reduced by 1 cycle.
compendium.malachar-voidrift.flavorText: The silence after Extinction is not empty. It is full of something worse.
relic.relic_acc_barrier.name: Barrier Resonance
relic.relic_acc_barrier.desc: Each wave completed without barrier damage permanently increases barrier max HP by +2 (stacks up to +30).
relic.relic_acc_barrier.flavor: "The barrier remembers every battle it survived."
relic.relic_acc_predator.name: Predator Instinct
relic.relic_acc_predator.desc: The first kill of each wave grants all allies +20% attack speed for 8s. Hunt fast.
relic.relic_acc_ancient.name: Ancient Echo
relic.relic_acc_ancient.desc: At the start of the run, all allies gain +1 level for free. Their stats scale as if they had already leveled up once.
relic.relic_acc_ancient.flavor: "Echoes of a thousand battles, carried forward."
relic.relic_acc_warlord.name: Warlord's Legacy
relic.relic_acc_warlord.desc: Start the run with 2 random free allies already placed in the field (based on your unlocked roster).
relic.cm_mage_1.name: Arcane Amplifier
relic.cm_mage_1.desc: Mage shots pierce through 1 extra enemy.
relic.cm_mage_2.name: Mana Surge
relic.cm_mage_2.desc: Every 5th Mage shot deals 3× damage and stuns for 0.8s.
relic.cm_mage_3.name: Spellweave
relic.cm_mage_3.desc: Mage damage increases by 2% per wave (stacks permanently, no cap).
relic.cm_mage_4.name: Arcane Dominion
relic.cm_mage_4.desc: All synergy damage bonuses for Mage are doubled.
relic.cm_mage_5.name: Chrono Collapse
relic.cm_mage_5.desc: On wave start, freeze ALL enemies for 2.5s. Mage dmg +80% while enemies are frozen.
relic.cm_archer_1.name: Hawk Eye
relic.cm_archer_2.name: Quiver of Plenty
relic.cm_archer_2.desc: Archer attack speed -20% (faster). Each 10th shot is a guaranteed crit.
relic.cm_archer_3.name: Predator Mark
relic.cm_archer_3.desc: Archer crits mark enemies for 4s. Marked enemies take +35% damage from all sources.
relic.cm_archer_4.name: Phantom Quiver
relic.cm_archer_4.desc: Every 3rd arrow is a ghost arrow — passes through all enemies and hits 3× times.
relic.cm_archer_5.name: Rain of Arrows
relic.cm_archer_5.desc: On wave start, fire a volley of 20 arrows hitting all enemies on screen for 200% Archer dmg.
relic.cm_warlock_1.name: Soul Rift
relic.cm_warlock_1.desc: Warlock shots slow enemies by -25% for 2s on hit.
relic.cm_warlock_2.name: Void Grasp
relic.cm_warlock_2.desc: Warlock kills grant +5% damage to all allies for the rest of the wave (stacks up to +60%).
relic.cm_warlock_3.name: Dark Resonance
relic.cm_warlock_3.desc: Warlock shots chain to 1 nearby enemy for 70% damage.
relic.cm_warlock_4.name: Abyss Walker
relic.cm_warlock_4.desc: Warlock ignores 40% of enemy resistance. Void damage bypasses shields.
relic.cm_warlock_5.name: Eldritch Tide
relic.cm_warlock_5.desc: Warlock fires 3 projectiles simultaneously. Each deals 60% base damage.
relic.cm_druid_1.name: Nature's Grasp
relic.cm_druid_1.desc: Druid roots last 0.5s longer. Rooted enemies take +20% damage.
relic.cm_druid_2.name: Cycle Mastery
relic.cm_druid_2.desc: Each season cycle completed permanently adds +5% damage to all Druid shots.
relic.cm_druid_3.name: Verdant Surge
relic.cm_druid_3.desc: Spring season heals ALL allies for 8 HP. Winter freeze duration doubled.
relic.cm_druid_4.name: Eclipse Mastery
relic.cm_druid_4.desc: Druidic Eclipse cooldown reduced by 50%. Eclipse shots deal 2× damage and AoE +40px.
relic.cm_druid_5.name: World Soul
relic.cm_druid_5.desc: All four seasons trigger every cycle simultaneously. Druid dmg +100%.
relic.cm_necro_1.name: Grave Robber
relic.cm_necro_1.desc: Necromancer raises undead from every 3rd kill (not just execute). Undead +15% HP.
relic.cm_necro_2.name: Bone Armor
relic.cm_necro_2.desc: Living undead grant +2 barrier HP regen/5s each. Max +10 per wave.
relic.cm_necro_3.name: Death Mark
relic.cm_necro_3.desc: Necromancer's curse applies to all enemies within 120px of the target (-30% speed & -20% dmg).
relic.cm_necro_4.name: Undying Legion
relic.cm_necro_4.desc: Undead that survive the wave carry over to the next wave (up to 3 undead persist).
relic.cm_necro_5.name: Avatar of Death
relic.cm_necro_5.desc: Necromancer permanently raises every enemy it kills as undead. No execute threshold.
relic.cm_cleric_1.name: Holy Fervor
relic.cm_cleric_1.desc: Cleric heals trigger 30% faster. Regen applies every 3.5s instead of 5s.
relic.cm_cleric_2.name: Blessed Aura
relic.cm_cleric_2.desc: Cleric also damages nearby enemies for 40% of the heal amount (holy damage).
relic.cm_cleric_3.name: Sacred Barrier
relic.cm_cleric_3.desc: Barrier starts each wave with +20 temporary HP that doesn't carry over.
relic.cm_cleric_4.name: Divine Wrath
relic.cm_cleric_4.desc: When barrier is hit, cleric retaliates with a holy bolt dealing 80 dmg to the attacker.
relic.cm_cleric_5.name: Seraph's Grace
relic.cm_cleric_5.desc: Once per run, at 20 HP or below, Cleric instantly restores barrier to 60 HP.
relic.cm_paladin_1.name: Holy Strike
relic.cm_paladin_1.desc: Paladin deals +50% damage to undead and demons. Holy smite AoE +20px.
relic.cm_paladin_2.name: Aegis of Light
relic.cm_paladin_2.desc: Paladin absorbs up to 8 damage per wave for each ally on the field.
relic.cm_paladin_3.name: Consecrated Ground
relic.cm_paladin_3.desc: Paladin creates a 160px holy zone. Enemies inside take +25% damage from all sources.
relic.cm_paladin_4.name: Blessed Weapon
relic.cm_paladin_4.desc: Paladin shots blessed. Each hit has 20% to stun enemy for 1.2s regardless of type.
relic.cm_paladin_5.name: Avatar of Justice
relic.cm_paladin_5.desc: Paladin becomes a frontline hero: +200% HP, +100% dmg. Barrier immune while Paladin alive.
relic.cm_priest_1.name: Mending Touch
relic.cm_priest_1.desc: Priest heals crit for 2× every 4th cast.
relic.cm_priest_2.name: Renew
relic.cm_priest_2.desc: Priest applies a HoT: allies healed gain +3 HP/s for 5s after the heal.
relic.cm_priest_3.name: Circle of Life
relic.cm_priest_3.desc: Priest heals the 2 most wounded allies simultaneously (was just the lowest HP).
relic.cm_priest_4.name: Holy Nova
relic.cm_priest_4.desc: Every 5th Priest cast triggers Holy Nova: heals ALL allies for 12 HP.
relic.cm_priest_5.name: Miracle
relic.cm_priest_5.desc: Once per wave, when any ally reaches 0 HP, Priest auto-triggers a full emergency heal to all allies for 25 HP.
relic.cm_bard_1.name: Battle Hymn
relic.cm_bard_1.desc: Bard aura also grants +10% attack speed to all allies in range.
relic.cm_bard_2.name: Resonant Chord
relic.cm_bard_2.desc: Bard gains a damage projectile that fires every 2s at the nearest enemy.
relic.cm_bard_3.name: Ballad of War
relic.cm_bard_3.desc: Bard aura doubles in strength during boss waves automatically.
relic.cm_bard_4.name: Encore
relic.cm_bard_4.desc: Once per wave, when first ally dies, Bard plays Encore: resurrects them with 40% HP.
relic.cm_bard_5.name: Symphony of Souls
relic.cm_bard_5.desc: Bard aura is now global. All allies gain +35% dmg & +25% attack speed permanently.
relic.cm_rune_1.name: Rune Mastery
relic.cm_rune_1.desc: Runesmith chain lightning jumps 1 extra time. +20% chain damage.
relic.cm_rune_2.name: Sigil Overcharge
relic.cm_rune_2.desc: Runesmith sigils explode when they expire, dealing 60% of stored damage in AoE.
relic.cm_rune_3.name: Arc Conduit
relic.cm_rune_3.desc: Runesmith becomes a lightning rod: every 8s, auto-fires a mega chain hitting all enemies.
relic.cm_rune_4.name: Static Field
relic.cm_rune_4.desc: Enemies hit by chain lightning are slowed -40% for 2s and take +20% damage.
relic.cm_rune_5.name: Storm Forge Prime
relic.cm_rune_5.desc: Runesmith unlocks Thunderstorm: every 15s, lightning strikes hit ALL enemies simultaneously for 150% dmg.
relic.cm_sylva_1.name: Toxic Bloom
relic.cm_sylva_1.desc: Sylvanite poison ticks 25% faster. Poison stacks cap increased by 2.
relic.cm_sylva_2.name: Ancient Roots
relic.cm_sylva_2.desc: Sylvanite regen also heals allies for 3 HP/tick. Grove expands to +60px radius.
relic.cm_sylva_3.name: Spore Cloud
relic.cm_sylva_3.desc: Poisoned enemies leave a spore cloud on death that poisons nearby enemies for 3s.
relic.cm_sylva_4.name: Nature's Wrath
relic.cm_sylva_4.desc: Every 10th poison tick calls a nature strike: 3 vines hit random enemies for 80 dmg each.
relic.cm_sylva_5.name: Gaia's Embrace
relic.cm_sylva_5.desc: Sylvanite permanently envenoms the battlefield: ALL enemies are always poisoned upon spawn.
relic.cm_dread_1.name: Void Hunger
relic.cm_dread_1.desc: Dreadlord starts each wave with 5 free Void Harvest stacks.
relic.cm_dread_2.name: Eclipse Rite
relic.cm_dread_2.desc: Dreadlord Eclipse activates 30% faster. Eclipse shots chain to 1 nearby enemy.
relic.cm_dread_3.name: Entropy
relic.cm_dread_3.desc: Dreadlord shots reduce enemy max HP by 5% permanently (up to -40%). Debuff stacks.
relic.cm_dread_4.name: Doom Harbinger
relic.cm_dread_4.desc: Void Harvest stacks persist between waves. Stacks never reset (was resetting each wave).
relic.cm_dread_5.name: Apocalypse Now
relic.cm_dread_5.desc: At wave 10, 20, 30, 40, 50: Dreadlord triggers Void Apocalypse — deals 500 damage to all enemies on screen.
relic.cm_jester_1.name: Loaded Dice
relic.cm_jester_1.desc: Jester confusion chance +15%. Confused enemies have 30% chance to attack each other.
relic.cm_jester_2.name: Trick Shot
relic.cm_jester_2.desc: Jester shots now bounce off walls once, potentially hitting enemies twice.
relic.cm_jester_3.name: Wild Card
relic.cm_jester_3.desc: Once per wave, Jester swaps the stats of the strongest and weakest enemy on screen.
relic.cm_jester_4.name: House of Cards
relic.cm_jester_4.desc: Dead Man's Hand drops 2 cards instead of 1. Card drop cooldown halved.
relic.cm_jester_5.name: Grand Finale
relic.cm_jester_5.desc: On wave completion, Jester juggles — fires 10 random shots at 10 random enemies, each dealing 200% dmg.
relic.cm_vex_1.name: Phantom Edge
relic.cm_vex_1.desc: Vex normal attacks have 20% chance to apply a bleed for 3s (50 dmg/s).
relic.cm_vex_2.name: Shadow Step
relic.cm_vex_2.desc: Sai Rush blink is now instant (was 600ms delay). AoE radius +20px.
relic.cm_vex_3.name: Blood Ritual
relic.cm_vex_3.desc: Vex lifesteal doubles on Sai Rush. Normal attacks also steal 3% HP per hit.
relic.cm_vex_4.name: Veil of Knives
relic.cm_vex_4.desc: During blink, Vex leaves a sai trap at origin point dealing 150% dmg to passing enemies for 3s.
relic.cm_vex_5.name: Death's Embrace
relic.cm_vex_5.desc: Vex becomes unkillable during Sai Rush. Every kill during blink resets the blink cooldown.
relic.cm_zylvara_1.name: Venom of the Deep
relic.cm_zylvara_1.desc: Zylvara's poison lasts 1s longer. Each poison tick has 15% chance to apply a second stack.
relic.cm_zylvara_2.name: Shadow Cloak
relic.cm_zylvara_2.desc: Shadow Step cooldown reduced from 6 to 5 attacks. Dodge chance increased to 25% during cloak.
relic.cm_zylvara_3.name: Umbral Sight
relic.cm_zylvara_3.desc: Zylvara always targets the highest-HP enemy on screen. Shadow Step guaranteed triple-damage hit.
relic.cm_zylvara_4.name: Darkstep
relic.cm_zylvara_4.desc: After Shadow Step, Zylvara leaves a shadow clone that fires 3 poison arrows at the nearest enemy before vanishing.
relic.cm_zylvara_5.name: Extinction Protocol
relic.cm_zylvara_5.desc: Shadow Step now instantly kills any enemy below 25% HP, no damage check. Generates 1 extra gold per execution.
relic.cm_morri_1.name: Ravenous
relic.cm_morri_1.desc: Soul collection radius +80px. Morrigan also collects souls from kills made by any ally within range.
relic.cm_morri_2.name: Bitter Harvest
relic.cm_morri_2.desc: Each soul grants +3% damage instead of +2%. Soul bonus is doubled during Devour Mode.
relic.cm_morri_3.name: Consuming Dark
relic.cm_morri_3.desc: Devour Mode triggers every 8 souls instead of 10. During Devour Mode, Morrigan fires 3 projectiles simultaneously.
relic.cm_morri_4.name: Soul Resonance
relic.cm_morri_4.desc: Consuming Strike stacks up to 3× bonus charges (+15% each, max +45%). Charges persist between shots if hits land.
relic.cm_morri_5.name: Devouring Storm
relic.cm_morri_5.desc: At 50+ souls: permanently enter half-Devour state — all projectiles deal AoE splash. No soul cap, no diminishing returns.
relic.cm_ixara_1.name: Rage Conduit
relic.cm_ixara_1.desc: Each Fury stack also increases Ixara's attack speed by 3% (max +30% at 10 stacks).
relic.cm_ixara_2.name: Horns of Chaos
relic.cm_ixara_2.desc: Chaos Nova ricochet hits 2 additional nearby enemies instead of 1. Stun duration increased to 1.2s.
relic.cm_ixara_3.name: Bloodlust
relic.cm_ixara_3.desc: When Ixara kills an enemy with Chaos Nova, she instantly gains 3 Fury stacks. Overkill kills count.
relic.cm_ixara_4.name: Inverse Pain
relic.cm_ixara_4.desc: Ixara heals 4 HP for every Fury stack she has when a Chaos Nova detonates. At 10 stacks: full 40 HP restored.
relic.cm_ixara_5.name: Total Collapse
relic.cm_ixara_5.desc: Total Collapse incapacitation reduced from 2s to 0.5s. Enemies that survive the blast are permanently Cursed (−20% all stats) for the rest of the wave.
relic.cm_berserk_1.name: Scarred Hide
relic.cm_berserk_1.desc: Each time the barrier is hit, Berserker gains +3% permanent damage (cap +60%).
relic.cm_berserk_2.name: Warchief's Drum
relic.cm_berserk_2.desc: Rampage also increases ALL allies' damage by +25% for its duration.
relic.cm_berserk_3.name: Battle Trance
relic.cm_berserk_3.desc: Berserker cannot be killed during Rampage. HP is reduced to 1 instead of 0.
relic.cm_berserk_4.name: Berserker's Will
relic.cm_berserk_4.desc: If barrier reaches 1 HP, Berserker auto-triggers Rampage for 8s.
relic.cm_berserk_5.name: Eternal Fury
relic.cm_berserk_5.desc: Blood Rage multiplier no longer resets between waves. Each wave that ends with low barrier permanently stacks bonus damage.
relic.cm_frost_1.name: Frozen Core
relic.cm_frost_1.desc: Ice Patches last 2s longer. Enemies leaving a patch stay slowed for 1s extra.
relic.cm_frost_2.name: Arctic Aura
relic.cm_frost_2.desc: Allies within 150px of Frost Warden receive 15% damage resistance.
relic.cm_frost_3.name: Shatter
relic.cm_frost_3.desc: Frozen enemies that die explode into ice shards, dealing 80 damage to nearby enemies.
relic.cm_frost_4.name: Absolute Zero
relic.cm_frost_4.desc: Every 3rd Glacial Wall is permanent until end of wave.
relic.cm_frost_5.name: Flash Freeze
relic.cm_frost_5.desc: At the start of each wave, ALL enemies are instantly frozen for 2s.
relic.cm_inq_1.name: Codex of Sins
relic.cm_inq_1.desc: Inquisitor starts with +10% damage against the most frequent enemy type in the current act.
relic.cm_inq_2.name: Interrogation
relic.cm_inq_2.desc: Sentence also reduces target's speed and resistance by 20%.
relic.cm_inq_3.name: Holy Mandate
relic.cm_inq_3.desc: Verdict bonus does not reset between waves. Progress accumulates through the entire run.
relic.cm_inq_4.name: Crusade
relic.cm_inq_4.desc: When 5+ enemies of the same type are on screen, Inquisitor enters Crusade: auto AoE attacks for 4s.
relic.cm_inq_5.name: Final Judgment
relic.cm_inq_5.desc: Killing a boss with Sentence active restores 15 barrier HP and grants +1 extra shop slot.
relic.cm_mal_1.name: Eternal Grimoire
relic.cm_mal_1.desc: Spell cycle speeds up by 15%. Empowered spells deal +30% extra damage.
relic.cm_mal_2.name: Chaos Master
relic.cm_mal_2.desc: Void Chains also reduces enemy damage by 25% for 4s. Soul collection radius +50px.
relic.cm_mal_3.name: Extinction
relic.cm_mal_3.desc: Every 5th spell cycle includes Extinction — kills all non-boss enemies on screen instantly.
relic.cm_mal_4.name: Absolute Solitude
relic.cm_mal_4.desc: Solitary bonus doubled. At 0 other allies: Malachar becomes untargetable by enemies.
relic.cm_mal_5.name: Eternal Ascension
relic.cm_mal_5.desc: Ascension cooldown reduced to 60s. During Ascension, Malachar fires all 4 spells simultaneously every shot.
relic.relic_bloodpact.name: Blood Pact
relic.relic_bloodpact.desc: All allies start with +25% permanent damage, but with -20% max HP.
relic.relic_bloodpact.flavor: "Power has a price. Pay it gladly."
relic.relic_warcry.name: War Cry
relic.relic_warcry.desc: At the start of each wave, all allies gain +15% attack speed for 10s.
relic.relic_warcry.flavor: "Before the battle, the cry. After, the silence of your enemies."
relic.relic_overkill.name: Total Execution
relic.relic_overkill.desc: Overkill is already active. Excess damage on a kill ricochets to the nearest enemy.
relic.relic_critchain.name: Chain Strike
relic.relic_critchain.desc: Each consecutive critical increases crit chance by +5% (max +30%). Resets each wave.
relic.relic_ironwall.name: Iron Wall
relic.relic_ironwall.desc: The Barrier starts with +30 extra HP and takes 15% less damage throughout the run.
relic.relic_ironwall.flavor: "It does not yield. It never has."
relic.relic_phoenix.name: Phoenix Spark
relic.relic_phoenix.desc: Once per run, when the Barrier would reach 0 HP, it is restored to 25 HP instead.
relic.relic_guardian.name: Ancestral Guardian
relic.relic_guardian.desc: Start with a free ally (Paladin lv5 already in the field).
relic.relic_goldvein.name: Gold Vein
relic.relic_goldvein.desc: +50 starting gold and +15% gold gained per kill throughout the run.
relic.relic_goldvein.flavor: "Wars are won with gold, not swords."
relic.relic_merchant.name: Merchant's Deal
relic.relic_merchant.desc: Level-up offers 4 card choices instead of 3. The extra option might be exactly what you need.
relic.relic_merchant.flavor: "I have exactly what you need. For a reasonable price."
relic.relic_hoarder.name: Hoarder
relic.relic_hoarder.desc: For every 10 gold held at the end of a wave, gain 1 bonus Essence.
relic.relic_twins.name: Soul Twin
relic.relic_twins.desc: The hero starts with a copy of themselves (lv5 ally of the same class, not a hero).
relic.relic_gamble.name: The Grand Gambler
relic.relic_gamble.desc: Random: you receive one of the other 11 relics as a surprise. Could be anything.
relic.relic_gamble.flavor: "Luck is a skill. Or was supposed to be."
synergy.archer.name: Patrol
synergy.archer.level.3.desc: 🔥 VOLLEY: +55% Atk Speed & fire 2 arrows per shot
synergy.mage.name: Arcane Circle
synergy.mage.level.3.desc: 🔥 ARCANE OVERLOAD: +85% Dmg & every shot has 25% chance to explode AoE
synergy.warlock.name: Dark Pact
synergy.warlock.level.3.desc: 🔥 VOID ASCENSION: +130% Range/Speed, shots heal the Warlock for 15% of damage & slow enemies -60%
synergy.druid.name: Force of Nature
synergy.druid.level.1.desc: +22% Crit Chance, seasons advance every 8 shots (was 10)
synergy.druid.level.2.desc: +40% Crit Chance, seasons advance every 5 shots
synergy.druid.level.3.desc: 🔥 WORLD TREE: +65% Crit Chance, seasons advance every 3 shots
synergy.necromancer.name: Undead Horde
synergy.necromancer.level.0.desc: Necromancer deals +35% Dmg to enemies below 50% HP
synergy.necromancer.level.1.desc: +1 Undead per Necromancer at wave start, +20% Undead Dmg; Necromancer +70% Dmg vs enemies below 50% HP
synergy.necromancer.level.2.desc: +2 Undead per Necromancer at wave start, +50% Undead Dmg; Necromancer +120% Dmg vs enemies below 50% HP
synergy.necromancer.level.3.desc: 🔥 LICH ASCENSION: +3 Undead per Necromancer & +5 permanent Elite Undead (2x HP/Dmg, up to 10 on the field); Necromancer +200% Dmg vs enemies below 50% HP
synergy.bard.name: Harmony
synergy.bard.level.3.desc: 🔥 GRAND SYMPHONY: infinite aura range & all allies gain +45% Dmg and +30% Atk Speed
synergy.cleric.name: Steadfast Faith
synergy.cleric.level.3.desc: 🔥 DIVINE AEGIS: +40 Barrier Regen/5s & Barrier is immune to damage for 4s at wave start
synergy.paladin.name: Holy Vanguard
synergy.paladin.level.3.desc: 🔥 CRUSADE: +35% Dmg, +200% vs Undead & Demons & every 3rd hit a Holy Smite stuns enemies within 160px of the target for 1s (bosses: −25% speed)
synergy.priest.name: Divine Light
synergy.priest.level.3.desc: 🔥 RESURRECTION: Heal +160% Strength & revives each fallen ally once per run with 50% HP
synergy.runesmith.name: Rune Network
synergy.runesmith.level.3.desc: ✦ RUNE SINGULARITY: Chain every shot, +150% Chain Dmg
synergy.sylvanite.name: Ancient Grove
synergy.dreadlord.name: Void Covenant
synergy.dreadlord.level.0.desc: Void Harvest cap +5, each stack +12% Dmg
synergy.dreadlord.level.3.desc: ✦✦ VOID ASCENDANT: +110% Dmg, unlimited Void Harvest stacks & every Dreadlord kill explodes in AoE (55% of the damage, 140px; bosses 50%)
synergy.vex.name: Phantom Step
synergy.vex.level.1.desc: Sai Rush every 3rd attack, +25% Rush Dmg
synergy.vex.level.2.desc: Sai Rush every 2nd attack, +60% Rush Dmg, blink lasts 900ms (was 600ms)
synergy.vex.level.3.desc: ✦ ENDLESS BLINK: EVERY attack is a Sai Rush, +120% Rush Dmg, and enemies can't target or hit Vex while she blinks
synergy.jester.name: Fool's Court
synergy.jester.level.0.desc: Ball cycle speeds up: the Jester attacks 20% faster
synergy.jester.level.1.desc: All 3 ball effects proc together every 5th attack, +30% Dmg
synergy.jester.level.2.desc: +60% Dmg, confusion lasts 2x longer & the gold ball heals ALL wounded allies (at most once every 2s)
synergy.jester.level.3.desc: 🔥 GRAND CIRCUS: +80% Dmg, every 2nd attack fires all 3 balls together; confusion doesn't affect bosses (they get 25% slower)
synergy.morrigan.name: Soul Coven
synergy.morrigan.level.0.desc: Each soul gives Morrigan +1% more Dmg
synergy.morrigan.level.1.desc: Consuming Strike gives +25% Dmg per charge (was +15%)
synergy.morrigan.level.3.desc: 🔥 FEAST: Devour Mode lasts 8s and each soul collected during it restores 1 Barrier HP
synergy.yue.name: Dancer
synergy.yue.level.0.desc: +30px Audience range. Fan Step pierces +1 target.
synergy.yue.level.1.desc: Fan Step damage +25%. Charmed enemies take +20% damage from all sources.
synergy.yue.level.3.desc: 🔥 GRAND FINALE: Triggering Charm deals 100% damage to the entire audience and Charm lasts +1s.
synergy.billy.name: Gunslinger
synergy.billy.level.0.desc: Reload after 4th shot reduced by 20%. 4th shot gains +25% crit damage.
synergy.billy.level.1.desc: 4th shot explodes in an AoE impact (60px radius) dealing damage to nearby enemies.
synergy.billy.level.2.desc: Every 2 reloads (was 4), the 4th shot triggers Curtain and pierces the entire line.
synergy.billy.level.3.desc: 🔥 FOURTH ACT: If the 4th shot slays an enemy, the next shot is instantly a 4th shot with no reload.
combo.sacred-trinity.name: Sacred Trinity
combo.sacred-trinity.desc.0: All holy units +28% Dmg & Barrier regens +4 HP/5s extra
combo.sacred-trinity.desc.1: All holy units +65% Dmg, +60% Heal Strength & Barrier regens +10 HP/5s extra
combo.natures-wrath.name: Nature's Wrath
combo.natures-wrath.desc.0: Druid & Archer +20% Atk Speed, Druid gains +8% Crit Chance (Atk Speed doesn't stack with Wild Hunt)
combo.natures-wrath.desc.1: Druid & Archer +20% Atk Speed, Druid gains +22% Crit Chance & roots on crit (Atk Speed doesn't stack with Wild Hunt)
combo.arcane-storm.name: Arcane Storm
combo.iron-bulwark.name: Iron & Ice Bulwark
combo.iron-bulwark.desc.0: Barrier takes 15% less damage & Ice Patches slow 15% more
combo.iron-bulwark.desc.1: Barrier takes 30% less damage, Ice Patches slow 15% more & Glacial Wall freezes for +1s
combo.death-choir.name: Death Choir
combo.death-choir.desc.1: Necro skeletons deal +180% Damage & Bard aura revives fallen allies once
combo.arcane-barrage.name: Arcane Barrage
combo.arcane-barrage.desc.0: Mage & Archer +32% Range & projectiles pierce 1 extra enemy
combo.arcane-barrage.desc.1: Mage & Archer +55% Range & projectiles pierce 2 extra enemies
combo.soul-mending.name: Soul Mending
combo.soul-mending.desc.0: Priest heals spread to 2 nearby allies
combo.soul-mending.desc.1: Priest heals spread to ALL allies
combo.wild-hunt.name: Wild Hunt
combo.wild-hunt.desc.0: Archer & Druid +18% Dmg; the Bard's aura gives +12% Dmg to nearby allies
combo.wild-hunt.desc.1: Archer & Druid +35% Dmg & +15% Atk Speed; the Bard's aura gives +25% Dmg and the Bard becomes a damage dealer
combo.storm-forge.name: Storm Forge
combo.storm-forge.desc.1: Chain lightning fires on every shot & deals +85% Dmg
combo.verdant-pact.name: Verdant Pact
combo.dark-hunger.name: Dark Hunger
combo.dark-hunger.desc.0: Dreadlord +35% Dmg, kills restore 3 HP to Dreadlord
combo.dark-hunger.desc.1: Dreadlord +60% Dmg, kills restore 3 HP to Dreadlord
combo.life-forge.name: Life Forge
combo.arcane-ruin.name: Arcane Ruin
combo.arcane-ruin.desc.0: Runesmith chain lightning fires every 2nd shot & deals +50% Dmg
combo.arcane-ruin.desc.1: Runesmith chain lightning fires every 2nd shot & deals +110% Dmg
combo.fools-carnival.name: Fool's Carnival
combo.fools-carnival.desc.0: With the Jester on the field, each kill has a 15% chance to give +50% gold
combo.fools-carnival.desc.1: Bard aura reaches ALL allies, and every kill grants the Jester +8% Atk Speed, stacking up to +40%
combo.sacred-grove.name: Sacred Grove
combo.sacred-grove.desc.0: Cleric Barrier regen +30%, and the Barrier regens +2 HP/5s extra
combo.sacred-grove.desc.1: Cleric Barrier regen +70%, and the Barrier regens +3 HP/5s extra
combo.fallen-crusade.name: Fallen Crusade
combo.fallen-crusade.desc.0: Paladin & Warlock +40% Dmg, Warlock Hex lasts 6s & the Barrier takes 10% less damage
combo.fallen-crusade.desc.1: Paladin & Warlock +90% Dmg, and hexed enemies also bleed
combo.blood-rush.name: Blood Rush
combo.blood-rush.desc.1: Vex lifesteal 12% on Sai Rush, Warlock +50% Dmg, Sai Rush gains 2 extra AoE hits
combo.blood-rush.desc.2: ✦ HEMORRHAGE: +20% lifesteal on Sai Rush, which leaves a blood pool — enemies inside bleed. Vex becomes unkillable below 20% HP.
combo.shadow-step.name: Shadow Step
combo.shadow-step.desc.0: Sai Rush has 40% chance to raise a skeleton at impact point
combo.shadow-step.desc.1: Sai Rush has 40% chance to raise a skeleton, now elite (+150% HP & Dmg)
combo.shadow-step.desc.2: ✦ DEATH BLINK: Sai Rush ALWAYS raises an elite skeleton.
combo.ghost-hunt.name: Ghost Hunt
combo.ghost-hunt.desc.0: Vex & Archer +30% Atk Speed. Sai Rush marks the enemies it hits for 3s
combo.ghost-hunt.desc.1: Vex & Archer +60% Atk Speed & +35% Dmg. Marked enemies take double Sai Rush damage
combo.ghost-hunt.desc.2: ✦ PHANTOM VOLLEY: Every Sai Rush fires 3 spectral arrows from ALL Archers. Marked enemies explode on death for 150% of their max HP (at most 3× the killing blow) to nearby enemies. Bosses: 50%.
combo.umbral-brood.name: Umbral Brood
combo.umbral-brood.desc.2: ✦ NIGHT COLONY: Zylvara +80% Dmg & +28% Atk Speed
combo.coven-pyre.name: Coven Pyre
combo.coven-pyre.desc.1: Morrigan +45% Dmg. Living Hex deals +20% damage, lasts +1s and jumps 1 extra time
combo.coven-pyre.desc.2: ✦ WITCHFIRE ASCENDANT: Morrigan +80% Dmg. Living Hex deals +50% damage, lasts +1s and jumps 1 extra time
combo.riot-engine.name: Riot Engine
combo.riot-engine.desc.2: ✦ TOTAL RIOT: Ixara +80% Dmg & +32% Atk Speed
combo.grave-contagion.name: Grave Contagion
combo.grave-contagion.desc.0: Morrigan & Necromancer +38% Dmg. Cursed kills have 25% chance to raise an undead
combo.grave-contagion.desc.1: Morrigan & Necromancer +85% Dmg. Cursed kills have 45% chance to raise a stronger undead
combo.grave-contagion.desc.2: ✦ PLAGUE PROCESSION: Morrigan & Necromancer +130% Dmg. Cursed kills have 70% chance to raise an even stronger undead
combo.shadow-execution.name: Shadow Execution
combo.shadow-execution.desc.0: Zylvara & Vex +40% Dmg. Their hits mark prey for 4s: they deal +18% damage to it
combo.shadow-execution.desc.1: Zylvara & Vex +90% Dmg. They deal +30% damage to marked prey
combo.shadow-execution.desc.2: ✦ NIGHTFALL JUDGMENT: Zylvara & Vex +140% Dmg. They deal +45% damage to marked prey
combo.hunters-sigil.name: Hunter's Sigil
combo.hunters-sigil.desc.0: Zylvara marks prey for 4s. Zylvara +30% Dmg; Archer & Zylvara deal +30% damage to marked enemies
combo.hunters-sigil.desc.1: Zylvara +60% Dmg & +18% Atk Speed. Archer & Zylvara deal +60% to marked enemies, and marked kills explode (12% of target max HP, 170px)
combo.hunters-sigil.desc.2: ✦ TERMINAL VOLLEY: Zylvara +100% Dmg & +30% Atk Speed. Archer & Zylvara deal +60% to marked enemies, and marked kills explode (22% of target max HP)
combo.berserker-core.name: Berserker Core
combo.berserker-core.desc.2: ✦ RED HALO: Ixara +95% Dmg, Paladin +45% Dmg
combo.war-anthem.name: War Anthem
combo.war-anthem.desc.0: While Ixara is at high Fury, all allies gain +10% Atk Speed
combo.war-anthem.desc.1: While Ixara is at high Fury, all allies gain +20% Atk Speed and +18% Dmg
combo.war-anthem.desc.2: ✦ RIOT CHORUS: While Ixara is at high Fury, all allies gain +30% Atk Speed and +30% Dmg
combo.blood-and-ice.name: Blood and Ice
combo.blood-and-ice.desc.2: ✦ FROZEN RAGE: Berserker & Frost Warden +110% Dmg
combo.divine-verdict.name: Divine Verdict
combo.iron-conviction.name: Iron Conviction
combo.permafrost-ward.name: Permafrost Ward
combo.permafrost-ward.desc.2: ✦ GLACIAL SANCTUARY: Frost Warden & Cleric +110% Dmg
combo.stage-and-aim.name: Stage & Aim
combo.stage-and-aim.desc.0: Enemies charmed by Yue take +40% crit damage from Billy. Billy's 4th shot stuns for 1s if target is in Yue's audience.
combo.stage-and-aim.desc.1: When Billy fires his 4th shot, Yue slashes dealing 80% of that shot's damage to his audience. 4th shot kills reset Billy's reload if target is in audience.
combo.ballad-and-dance.name: Ballad & Dance
combo.ballad-and-dance.desc.0: For each enemy in Yue's audience, Bard & Yue deal +3% extra damage. Bard aura reaches the entire audience.
combo.ballad-and-dance.desc.1: When Yue's Charm triggers, Bard aura grants +30% Atk Speed to all allies for 3s, and Bard deals +50% damage.
combo.law-and-trigger.name: Law & Trigger
combo.law-and-trigger.desc.0: Billy's shots 1–3 judge the target. His 4th shot consumes judgment for +25% extra holy damage. Inquisitor gains +20% damage.
combo.law-and-trigger.desc.1: Inquisitor & Billy deal +40% damage to wounded targets. If Inquisitor slays an enemy, Billy's next shot is instantly a critical 4th shot.

ending.mage.name: Krash
ending.mage.title: The Mage
ending.mage.panel.0: The last wave broke against the walls of Grimhold, and Krash's spells broke against the wave. Neither gave way. His stance was wrong, the grimoire lay open at page forty-three, and none of it mattered: what came out of the dark understood only that something was striking it, without pause, until nothing was left but ash.
ending.mage.panel.1: Days later came the letter from the Arcane Collegium — seal, praise, a delicate note that one of their own had stood among the defenders. Expelled twice. Krash read it twice and fed it to the fire.
ending.mage.panel.2: He went back to studying, as he always does. The spells are still inelegant, and they still land. Some lessons are only learned alone, in the dark, with the book open to the next page.
ending.archer.name: Ifigenia
ending.archer.title: The Archer
ending.archer.panel.0: The enemy learned too late that range is not distance — it is intent. Ifigenia had no master and no formula. She had a bow, a line of sight, and the silence of someone raised in a forest that kills the instant your attention slips. Hers had not slipped in eleven years.
ending.archer.panel.1: When it was over, they offered her a title. Defender of the Realm. She listened, waited for the speech to end, and asked if there was food. She ate, gave thanks, and was gone before anyone thought to ask where.
ending.archer.panel.2: She went back to the edge of the Thornwood, where silence keeps you alive. The forest is as it ever was: patient, indifferent, full of things that want you dead. Nothing in it is faster than Ifigenia's arrow. She intends to keep it that way.
ending.druid.name: Vindimia
ending.druid.title: The Druid
ending.druid.panel.0: The vines did more than any blade. For three hours before the last wave, Vindimia bargained with the earth, explaining what was coming and what she needed. The earth, which still remembered the burning of the old forest, had a score to settle.
ending.druid.panel.1: Afterwards, the ground by the east wall began to change. A root where there had been stone. A green shoot in cracked mortar. Within a week, a tree had begun — small, but a beginning. Vindimia told no one. It was none of their business.
ending.druid.panel.2: She still tends what grew there: quietly, patiently, without ceremony. The old forest is gone. But the wounded world is willing to try again, if asked the right way and given time. She has given time before. She will give more.
ending.cleric.name: Alva
ending.cleric.title: The Cleric
ending.cleric.panel.0: The mace's haft cracked on the third-to-last enemy. Alva finished the last two with her hands — a thing found in no manual the Church has ever approved. She never read the manuals. She read the situation, and the situation did not call for approved technique.
ending.cleric.panel.1: Three days later came the Church's letter, sealed in gold, smelling of incense. She looked at it for a long while. Then she set her water cup on it. A gesture of respect, she judged, of the proper size.
ending.cleric.panel.2: She went where the mace was needed, not where the prayer was. There is always a place: a siege, a plague, a village with a gate that will not hold. She does not carry the letter. She carries the cracked haft — what breaks and goes on deserves remembering. She calls that theology.
ending.paladin.name: Hellel
ending.paladin.title: The Paladin
ending.paladin.panel.0: Hellel did not fight the last wave. He processed it. Every horror was a problem with a solution, and the solution, for twenty years, had been a very large hammer applied with absolute conviction. He did not hate what he killed. Hatred is waste. He simply refused to let it exist.
ending.paladin.panel.1: Afterwards, he made a list of everything still standing that should not be. Old threats. Sleeping things. Places where the barrier had worn thin while everyone looked the other way. The list was too long. He was not surprised. He only prepared.
ending.paladin.panel.2: The list grows shorter. Year by year, item by item, struck through with a line that means finished. He does not celebrate the strikes. He notes them, reviews the list, moves to the next. When he struck the last line, he began a new list. There is always a new list. He finds that comforting.
ending.warlock.name: Sibilus
ending.warlock.title: The Warlock
ending.warlock.panel.0: The power he used at the end came from a place he had stopped examining. That was the pact: he gave the body, and the pact gave what the body needed to survive what it had no right to survive. What came to the gate of Grimhold did not survive. Sibilus did. The pact held.
ending.warlock.panel.1: That night he stopped at the crossing where three dead roads meet and measured the space where something used to be. It was smaller. He knew it would be. It was not mourning — it was measurement, and measuring is how you know where you stand.
ending.warlock.panel.2: He keeps measuring. It keeps taking longer. He tells no one, and no one asks — a mutual courtesy. Something remains. He does not know what. He knows it is shrinking. He has decided that is a problem for later. Later keeps arriving.
ending.priest.name: Hyo
ending.priest.title: The Priest
ending.priest.panel.0: The monastery taught that healing is violence against death. By that measure, Hyo committed considerable violence in the final battle. Every soul torn back from the edge was a line held, a challenge thrown. He healed faster than they fell.
ending.priest.panel.1: Afterwards, he sat with a notebook and wrote the name of everyone who survived. It took time. Those who did not went in a second notebook. There is always a second notebook. He filled more pages than he wished. Fewer than he feared.
ending.priest.panel.2: Death, as ever, is patient. It has time. So does Hyo — and the stubbornness of an entire monastery, and the calloused certainty that every soul stolen from the threshold is a small, personal insult to the end of all things. He keeps writing in both notebooks. The one for the living still has more blank pages.
ending.necromancer.name: Ikan
ending.necromancer.title: The Necromancer
ending.necromancer.panel.0: When the last wave ended, Ikan's dead were still standing. Most of them. The rest rose shortly after. He did not celebrate: he catalogued, writing in the margin of a ledger that smelled of old coin and older things. Field test result: acceptable.
ending.necromancer.panel.1: Grimhold's fallen defenders had families. The families were told. Ikan also took note of the fallen, in his own way. He did not ask permission — he never does. No wages, no sleep and no fear is, he observed, an objective improvement. And they had already proven willing to defend Grimhold once.
ending.necromancer.panel.2: He does not speak of what came after. Grimhold does not ask, partly out of decorum, partly because the night patrols have grown far more efficient. The dead do not lament their condition. Ikan finds that philosophically convenient, and writes it down.
ending.bard.name: Sonetto
ending.bard.title: The Bard
ending.bard.panel.0: He played something fast during the last wave — something that moves the legs even when the head has decided it is over. He has played inside siege engines as they fired, in throne rooms moments before they stopped being throne rooms. He knew what the night needed. It needed tempo. He gave it.
ending.bard.panel.1: Afterwards, he played something slow. Low, in a minor key, unresolved at the end. No one asked him to stop. A few sat down around him without meaning to. He played it twice through, then rested the lute on his knees and stayed with them in the silence. Silence is a song too.
ending.bard.panel.2: There is a song about it now, written on the road between Grimhold and the next place. Three verses, a bridge, an ending on the wrong note — on purpose. A tavern in the lowlands plays it every night. He passed the window once, judged the tempo a little off, and kept walking.
ending.runesmith.name: Veltharion
ending.runesmith.title: The Runesmith
ending.runesmith.panel.0: Veltharion had carved runes into the walls of Grimhold years before, small ones, where no one would look. By the final battle they had gathered enough awareness to act unbidden — turning power down paths he never drew, holding walls he never marked, doing things he could not afterwards explain.
ending.runesmith.panel.1: He spent a week trying to understand. Diagrams. Forty years of notes. He traced the flow backwards through time, hunting the instant when the runes, for want of a better word, decided. He found the instant. He did not find the reason.
ending.runesmith.panel.2: He never finished the study. The runes have no interest in being studied. He knows this the way he knows fire is aware of what it touches — not thinking, but knowing. He stopped carving for pleasure. He still carves with purpose. The runes answer purpose. He suspects they agree.
ending.sylvanite.name: Aelindra
ending.sylvanite.title: The Sylvanite
ending.sylvanite.panel.0: The trees by the east approach leaned as trees do not lean, catching arrows meant for others, closing lines of sight. No one commanded them. Aelindra does not command. She crossed the battle as she crosses the forest: present, silent, accompanied by something with reasons of its own.
ending.sylvanite.panel.1: Afterwards, she stood three days at the edge of what had been the old forest. She did not speak. She did not seem to eat. On the fourth morning, a single sapling broke through the burn line — a kind that had not grown there in two hundred years. She saw it. She told no one.
ending.sylvanite.panel.2: She tends it still. She does not mourn the forest that burned; grief is for what has ended, and this has not ended. The tree is slow, as trees are, and she is patient, as she has always been. The world that made her still leans toward her when she passes. She calls that a conversation in progress.
ending.dreadlord.name: Kael'Vor
ending.dreadlord.title: The Dreadlord
ending.dreadlord.panel.0: He burned the enemy line and part of himself with it. That was always the pact: the curse's power consumes the body that holds it, one battle at a time, and the final battle was not small. He did not hold back. He never has. Restraint is for those with a future to protect.
ending.dreadlord.panel.1: Afterwards, he sat with his back to the wall of Grimhold and counted what was left. Less than yesterday. More than he expected. The curse had advanced; he knew it would. He saw no tragedy in it. It was only the state of the pact — and the pact, as always, had held long enough to be useful.
ending.dreadlord.panel.2: He won one more battle. He wants one more. The thing eating him alive delivered exactly what it promised: enough power to matter, until the instant it stops mattering. He stopped fighting to survive long ago. The grudge, at last, has been delivered in full.
ending.jester.name: Ming
ending.jester.title: The Jester
ending.jester.panel.0: In the last wave, two of the balls developed something like a will. One refused to aim at a certain kind of enemy, for reasons it did not share. The other made up for it. Ming judged the result acceptable and made a small mark on the inside of the sack.
ending.jester.panel.1: Afterwards, he gathered the balls one by one. He always counts. He arrived with seven. He counted eight. He counted again, slowly: eight. He tied the sack with care and did not open it for several days. Some questions are better left sleeping.
ending.jester.panel.2: He is still there. The council stopped asking who hired him. The eighth ball settled in without incident, and he gave it a name — a thing he never did with the others. It is either a beginning or a warning. Perhaps both. The sack stays tied at night.
ending.vex.name: Vex
ending.vex.title: The Assassin
ending.vex.panel.0: She appeared in the middle of the enemy formation before anyone noticed she had left her position. Then in the command line behind it. Then in three places in a row, in a violet flash the survivors would describe with the vagueness of people unsure what they saw. She did not fight for Grimhold. She fought for the flash.
ending.vex.panel.1: When it ended, they looked for her. She was not where she had been. She was not where she had gone. In the stillness that follows the end of something large, she simply ceased to occupy the space. A scrap of purple silk was found on the wall. No one asked whether it was on purpose.
ending.vex.panel.2: She reappeared three weeks later, in a city where no one expected her, with a new contract and the same expression behind the veil. The slaughter at Grimhold was already history. She heard two versions. Both got wrong where she had been standing. She did not correct them. Vagueness suits her.
ending.zylvara.name: Zylvara
ending.zylvara.title: The Shadow Archer
ending.zylvara.panel.0: No one saw where the arrows came from. That was the point. Zylvara had no plan for the last wave. She had a position in the dark where no one would look, a clean angle on everything that mattered, and the stillness of one raised where light is a flaw. The arrows arrived. That was all.
ending.zylvara.panel.1: Afterwards, a commander tried to take her report. He had questions prepared, in order. She answered none — not from hostility, but because she had already turned back into the shadow at the edge of the torchlight. The report was filed as inconclusive. Everyone agreed it had gone about as expected.
ending.zylvara.panel.2: She went back to the dark. That is not a metaphor: she went back to the caverns of Vel'Arath, where the sun does not reach, where silence lives, where the natural state of things has always been exactly what she is. She had no plans. She had results. They were satisfactory. She went home.
ending.morrigan.name: Morrigan
ending.morrigan.title: The Soul Devourer
ending.morrigan.panel.0: The soul count rose sharply in the final battle. Morrigan did not mean to be efficient — only thorough, which at her age amounts to the same thing. The golden ember in her chest burned as it had not in forty years. The first soul, the thief of 1247, seemed especially lively. She wrote it in the book.
ending.morrigan.panel.1: She spent the night updating the records. It took time; she is meticulous. The count had to be checked against three earlier books and an appendix begun in 1809 that she never quite finished. When it was done, she made tea, sat by the fire, and felt, without announcing it to anyone, something close to satisfaction.
ending.morrigan.panel.2: She is 412 years old. She has watched three empires rise and two of them fall. She knows the shape of what ends and the shape of what endures. This, she concluded, will endure. For now. She is not sentimental about for now. She updates the book. She makes more tea. She counts.
ending.ixara.name: Ixara
ending.ixara.title: The Chaos Demoness
ending.ixara.panel.0: For four seconds, in the last wave, she stopped holding back. Not a decision — a failure in the constant effort of holding everything she destroyed before she knew what she was holding. The white flash was not aimed. It was simply everything that had been waiting, let go for an instant, then dragged back with both hands.
ending.ixara.panel.1: What followed was the silence that comes after something very loud. No one spoke to her for minutes. She stood in the middle of the courtyard looking at her own hands — as she had the morning she arrived at Grimhold, and as she suspects she will for a long time yet. The equation is still hard.
ending.ixara.panel.2: She is still learning. It is the most important thing about her, and the most frightening, and the most honest. The four seconds will become three, then two. Or not. Today she woke, and she was still here, and Grimhold was still standing. She looked into the sun. She counted it as progress.
ending.berserker.name: Gorak
ending.berserker.title: The Berserker
ending.berserker.panel.0: He was still swinging when the last enemy fell. He swung twice more, and no one said a word — no one would be the first to tell Gorak it was over while the axe was still coming down. He carried wounds that would have killed a man who was paying attention. He was paying attention to the fight.
ending.berserker.panel.1: Someone came close and said, quietly, that it was over. He stopped, axe in hand, blood on his chest that was mostly not his. He nodded. The pain arrived — that was how he knew he still lived. He sat on a piece of rubble and let the pain tell him about the four hours he had not noticed.
ending.berserker.panel.2: He found something else to fight. He always does. It is not tragedy: it is a man who defined himself precisely and lives by it. The pain says he is in the fight. The fight says he is alive. At the gate of Grimhold, both were true at once. By Gorak's measure, a good day.
ending.frost_warden.name: Serafyne
ending.frost_warden.title: The Frost Warden
ending.frost_warden.panel.0: The field was calmer cold. That is what she would say, if asked to justify the frost on the stone, the ice that slowed what needed slowing, the clarity that comes when the temperature drops and everything slows to its essential function. She was not cruel. She was preferential.
ending.frost_warden.panel.1: Afterwards, someone complained about the frost still on the ground. It was July. The complaint came in writing, delivered by hand. She read it. She genuinely considered the merit of the position. She handed the letter back and walked away. For Serafyne, that was a long deliberation.
ending.frost_warden.panel.2: The frost withdrew on her time — not July's time, but frost's time, which does not negotiate with the calendar. Serafyne has said what she thinks: the world is calmer cold, and cleaner, and more honest. Those who fought beside her in the last wave stopped disagreeing. Some things you only need to live through once.
ending.inquisitor.name: Valdric
ending.inquisitor.title: The Inquisitor
ending.inquisitor.panel.0: Several names were struck from the list in the final battle. Valdric did not celebrate. He noted it, in the small precise hand of twenty years of being fast enough. Once, at nineteen, he was not — and the list has existed ever since as the measure of the distance between that morning and now.
ending.inquisitor.panel.1: Afterwards, he reviewed the list by torchlight. Some items needed correction. Three ran deeper than he understood. Two new ones went in — things only visible now that the larger thing was settled. He closed the list. He opened it again. That, too, is part of the process.
ending.inquisitor.panel.2: The list grows shorter. That is the fact he returns to. Slowly, item by item, the distance between that morning in the village and now grows, and the list shrinks, and that is the direction things were meant to go. He is patient. He learned it the hard way. The list has always been for that.
ending.malachar_human.name: Malachar
ending.malachar_human.title: The Redeemed
ending.malachar_human.panel.0: He knew what the final enemy was. He had served it. Four hundred years in its pay gave him intimacy with its hunger and with the exact way to press the places that hurt. He did not use that knowledge with pride. He used it as one uses a wound to find the scar: as a map. When it ended, he was the only one not surprised.
ending.malachar_human.panel.1: He stayed alone a long while. Not in mourning — Malachar had stopped mistaking stillness for grief — but calculating. The debt does not fit in a ledger. It has no columns. Only items, four hundred years of them, whose weight he accepted when the curse broke and his hands began to shake from holding back instead of letting go.
ending.malachar_human.panel.2: He is still here. That is not nothing. He came because he knew what was coming and because, at last, he could be useful instead of the opposite. His hands still shake. He has decided they will shake until the work is done, and then perhaps stop. He works as if they will. For now, that is enough.
