ui.tutorial.step0.body: Your hero attacks enemies automatically once placed.
ui.tutorial.spellCooldown: Spells have cooldowns — use them at the right moment.
ui.tutorial.goPlay: Now start a real run and hold the line!
ui.tutorial.step1.body: Your hero attacks automatically. Enemies march from the <1>right</1> toward your barrier on the <3>left</3>. Don't let them reach it!
ui.tutorial.step2.body: Wave complete! When a <1>🛒 merchant</1> is available, the <3>SHOP button</3> appears in the bottom HUD. Click it to buy allies and upgrades!
ui.tutorial.step3.body: Having <1>2+ allies of the same class</1> activates a synergy bonus. Check the <3>✦ Synergies</3> panel (top right) to see what's active!
ui.tutorial.step4.body: See the spell buttons at the <1>bottom of the screen</1>? Use <3>Meteor</3>, <5>Freeze</5>, or <7>Repair</7> during this wave!
ui.tutorial.step5.body: Wave 5 — the <1>Goblin King</1> boss appears! Use your spells and hold the line to complete training.
ui.tutorial.forgeHint: <0>Forge</0> — in the main menu, spend Essence to permanently upgrade heroes across all runs!
ui.tutorial.recap.shop: <0>Shop</0> — buy allies in the bottom HUD
ui.dmh.dmh-goblin-spd.title: Goblin Swiftness
ui.dmh.dmh-goblin-spd.description: ⚡ ALL allies gain +12% attack speed (stolen from goblin reflexes).
ui.dmh.dmh-orc-dmg.title: Orc Rage
ui.dmh.dmh-orc-dmg.description: 💢 ALL allies gain +15% damage (stolen from orc fury).
ui.dmh.dmh-undead-hp.title: Undead Resilience
ui.dmh.dmh-undead-hp.description: 💀 ALL allies gain +25 max HP (stolen from undead endurance).
ui.dmh.dmh-lich-range.title: Lich Sight
ui.dmh.dmh-lich-range.description: 👁 ALL allies gain +15% range (stolen from lich arcane vision).
ui.dmh.dmh-dragon.title: Dragon Fire
ui.dmh.dmh-dragon.description: 🔥 ALL allies gain +20% damage (stolen from draconic fire).
ui.dmh.dmh-elf-spd.title: Elven Precision
ui.dmh.dmh-elf-spd.description: 🏹 ALL allies gain +8% attack speed and +8% damage (stolen from elven grace).
ui.dmh.dmh-dwarf-hp.title: Dwarven Fortitude
ui.dmh.dmh-dwarf-hp.description: ⛏ ALL allies gain +35 max HP (stolen from dwarven toughness).
ui.dmh.dmh-demon.title: Infernal Pact
ui.dmh.dmh-demon.description: 😈 ALL allies gain +18% damage (stolen from demonic power).
ui.dmh.dmh-vampire.title: Vampiric Drain
ui.dmh.dmh-vampire.description: 🩸 ALL allies gain +3% lifesteal per shot (stolen from vampire hunger). Stackable.
ui.dmh.dmh-brute.title: Brute Endurance
ui.dmh.dmh-brute.description: 🪨 ALL allies gain +40 max HP and +5% damage (stolen from brute vitality).
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-dmg.title: Soul Power
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-dmg.description: ✨ ALL allies gain +10% damage (soul absorbed by the Jester).
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-spd.title: Soul Haste
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-spd.description: ✨ ALL allies gain +10% attack speed (soul absorbed by the Jester).
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-hp.title: Soul Vitality
ui.dmh.dmh-gen-hp.description: ✨ ALL allies gain +20 max HP (soul absorbed by the Jester).
ui.dmh.archer-sniper.title: Sniper Protocol
ui.dmh.archer-sniper.description: 🏹 The first arrow of each wave and every 10th arrow deal triple damage.
ui.dmh.warlock-hex.title: Hex
ui.dmh.warlock-hex.description: 🌑 Warlock shots curse the target — hexed enemies take +25% damage from ALL sources for 4s.
ui.dmh.druid-roots.title: Ancestral Roots
ui.dmh.druid-roots.description: 🌱 On entering Spring, the earth erupts in roots — ALL enemies are rooted for 1.5s. Once per cycle.
ui.dmh.druid-eclipse.title: Druidic Eclipse
ui.dmh.druid-eclipse.description: 🌑 After completing a full cycle (4 seasons), the next projectile applies ALL 4 season effects simultaneously.
ui.dmh.cleric-divine-shield.title: Divine Shield
ui.dmh.cleric-divine-shield.description: ✨ Every 10th Cleric shot creates a barrier on the most wounded ally, absorbing up to 55 damage.
ui.dmh.paladin-holy-ground.title: Holy Ground
ui.dmh.paladin-holy-ground.description: 🛡 Paladin consecrates a zone — enemies passing through it move 20% slower permanently for the run.
ui.dmh.priest-mass-mending.title: Mass Mending
ui.dmh.priest-mass-mending.description: ⚕ Priest now heals ALL wounded allies with each shot, not just the most injured one.
ui.dmh.jester-chaos.title: Chaos Aura
ui.dmh.jester-chaos.description: 🃏 At the start of each wave, Jester randomly buffs ALL allies: +30% attack speed, +25% damage, or +20% range for 15s.
ui.dmh.jester-pratfall.title: Pratfall
ui.dmh.jester-pratfall.description: 🃏 Jester hits have a 20% chance to stun the enemy for 0.6s (tripped by a banana peel).
ui.dmh.jester-roulette.title: Roulette
ui.dmh.jester-roulette.description: 🃏 Each kill has an 8% chance to trigger a random massive effect: AoE explosion, full team heal, enemy teleport, speed frenzy, or mass confusion.
ui.dmh.jester-deadmanshand.title: Dead Man's Hand
ui.dmh.jester-deadmanshand.description: ☠ ULTIMATE: 5% chance per kill (max 1 every 8s) to drop a card stolen from the soul of the slain — a random upgrade appears mid-battle for you to claim.
ui.dmh.eagle-eye.title: Eagle's Eye
ui.dmh.eagle-eye.description: 🦅 ALL allies gain +15% range permanently. Stackable.
ui.card.momentum.title: Momentum
ui.card.momentum.description: ⚡ Each 5 kills without Barrier taking damage: ALL allies +2% damage (max +20%, 50 kills). Resets and reverts if Barrier is hit.
ui.card.shield-wall.title: Shield Wall
ui.card.shield-wall.description: 🛡 The ally with most HP absorbs 30% of damage dealt to all other allies.
ui.dmh.gamblers-coin.title: Gambler's Coin
ui.dmh.gamblers-coin.description: 🎲 Flip a coin: 50% gain 600 Gold. 50% lose 200 Gold. Applied immediately.
ui.cardx.ranger-focus.title: Ranger Focus
ui.cardx.storm-of-arrows.title: Storm of Arrows
ui.cardx.storm-of-arrows.description: 🏹 MYTHIC: The Archer enters permanent frenzy — attack speed triples, all arrows pierce every enemy in their path, and Arrow Rain auto-fires every 8 kills without needing a hit count.
ui.cardx.arcane-blink.title: Arcane Blink
ui.cardx.arcane-singularity.title: Arcane Singularity
ui.cardx.arcane-singularity.description: 🔮 MYTHIC: Every 15th Mage shot tears open a void rift that pulls all enemies within 200px toward it and detonates for massive AoE damage. All active Echo and Fireball effects trigger simultaneously inside the rift.
ui.cardx.void-ascension.title: Void Ascension
ui.cardx.void-ascension.description: 🌑 MYTHIC: The Warlock surrenders fully to the void — loses 2% HP per second but every shot chains to 3 additional enemies and deals 3× damage. Surviving to wave end fully restores HP. If he lives, nothing else does.
ui.cardx.venom-of-the-deep.title: Venom of the Deep
ui.cardx.venom-of-the-deep.description: 🌑 Zylvara: poison lasts 1s longer and each arrow has a 15% chance to apply an extra stack.
ui.cardx.shadow-cloak.title: Shadow Cloak
ui.cardx.shadow-cloak.description: 🌑 Zylvara: Shadow Step every 4 attacks (was 6) and its immunity lasts 2.5s (was 1.5s).
ui.cardx.extinction-protocol.title: Extinction Protocol
ui.cardx.extinction-protocol.description: 🌑 Legendary: Shadow Step instantly kills non-boss enemies below 25% HP. Each execution grants +1 gold.
ui.cardx.eternal-eclipse.title: Eternal Eclipse
ui.cardx.eternal-eclipse.description: 🌑 MYTHIC: Shadow Step triggers every 3rd attack. When it kills, the poison bursts onto nearby enemies (stronger with more stacks) and the immunity lasts 0.5s longer.
ui.cardx.soul-echo.title: Soul Echo
ui.cardx.soul-echo.description: 💜 When Devour Mode activates, all souls collected this wave count double for the permanent damage bonus.
ui.cardx.ravenous.title: Ravenous
ui.cardx.ravenous.description: 💜 Soul collection radius +80px. Morrigan collects souls from any ally kill within range.
ui.cardx.bitter-harvest.title: Bitter Harvest
ui.cardx.bitter-harvest.description: 💜 Each soul grants +3% damage instead of +2%. Soul bonus doubled during Devour Mode.
ui.cardx.consuming-dark.title: Consuming Dark
ui.cardx.consuming-dark.description: 💜 Legendary: Devour Mode triggers every 8 souls (was 10). During Devour Mode, Morrigan fires 3 projectiles simultaneously.
ui.cardx.soul-plague.title: Soul Plague
ui.cardx.soul-plague.description: 💜 MYTHIC: Attacks infect enemies with a living plague (5s). The plague jumps to the nearest enemy on host death and refreshes.
ui.cardx.fury-surge.title: Fury Surge
ui.cardx.fury-surge.description: 💥 At maximum Fury stacks, Ixara gains +40% attack speed and projectiles pierce 2 enemies for 5s.
ui.cardx.rage-conduit.title: Rage Conduit
ui.cardx.rage-conduit.description: 💥 Ixara: each Fury stack also grants +3% attack speed (max +30%). Fury decays 50% slower between waves.
ui.cardx.horns-of-chaos.title: Horns of Chaos
ui.cardx.horns-of-chaos.description: 💥 Ixara: Chaos Nova radius goes from 110px to 150px and its stun lasts 1.2s.
ui.cardx.total-collapse.title: Total Collapse
ui.cardx.total-collapse.description: 💥 Legendary: Chaos Nova at 10 Fury removes 60% of current HP from every non-boss enemy and heals all allies for 30 HP. Fury resets to zero.
ui.cardx.primal-rage.title: Primal Rage
ui.cardx.primal-rage.description: 💥 MYTHIC: Fury is uncapped and never decays between waves. At 15+ Fury, Chaos Nova also fires on its own every 6s.
ui.cardx.battle-cry.title: Battle Cry
ui.cardx.battle-cry.description: 🪓 At the start of Rampage, nearby enemies are feared (−70% speed) for 2s and take +20% damage.
ui.cardx.blood-rage.title: Blood Rage+
ui.cardx.blood-rage.description: 🪓 Blood Rage tiers kick in earlier: 1.5× below 65% barrier HP, 2× below 40% and 3× below 15%.
ui.cardx.iron-skin.title: Iron Skin
ui.cardx.iron-skin.description: 🪓 Berserker +25% max HP. Each time the barrier is hit, Berserker heals 5 HP. Wounds only make him harder.
ui.cardx.eternal-fury.title: Eternal Fury
ui.cardx.eternal-fury.description: 🪓 MYTHIC: Blood Rage multiplier never resets between waves. Each wave ending at low barrier permanently stacks +1% damage. No cap.
ui.cardx.cold-snap.title: Cold Snap
ui.cardx.cold-snap.description: ❄️ Every 5th Frost Warden shot instantly freezes the target for 1.5s regardless of frost mark stacks.
ui.cardx.deep-freeze.title: Deep Freeze
ui.cardx.deep-freeze.description: ❄️ Ice Patches now slow enemies by 65% instead of 50%. Frost marks last 2s longer before expiring.
ui.cardx.wall-mastery.title: Wall Mastery
ui.cardx.wall-mastery.description: ❄️ Legendary: Glacial Wall cooldown reduced from 18s to 12s. Wall lasts 2s longer. Enemies colliding with the wall take double damage.
ui.cardx.shatter.title: Shatter
ui.cardx.shatter.description: ❄️ Frozen enemies that die explode into ice shards, dealing 80 damage to all enemies within 120px.
ui.cardx.absolute-zero.title: Absolute Zero
ui.cardx.absolute-zero.description: ❄️ MYTHIC: the entire battlefield becomes a permanent Ice Patch: all enemies move 50% slower.
ui.cardx.holy-brand.title: Holy Brand
ui.cardx.holy-brand.description: ⚖️ When Sentence is applied, a second nearby enemy is also Branded — taking +20% damage from all sources for the duration.
ui.cardx.interrogation.title: Interrogation
ui.cardx.interrogation.description: ⚖️ Sentence also reduces the target's speed and resistance by 20%. Verdict bonuses accumulate 50% faster.
ui.cardx.crusade.title: Crusade
ui.cardx.crusade.description: ⚖️ Legendary: When 5+ enemies of the same type are on screen, Inquisitor enters Crusade — auto AoE attacks hit all enemies for 4s. Sentence cooldown resets.
ui.cardx.death-warrant.title: Death Warrant
ui.cardx.death-warrant.description: ⚖️ When a Sentenced enemy dies, all enemies of the same type on screen take 80 damage immediately.
ui.cardx.final-judgment.title: Final Judgment
ui.cardx.final-judgment.description: ⚖️ MYTHIC: every boss or elite killed restores 40 barrier HP and grants +25 gold. Justice pays dividends.
ui.cardx.void-rift.title: Void Rift
ui.cardx.void-rift.description: 🔮 After Extinction triggers, all enemies are slowed by 50% for 3s. Extinction cooldown reduced by 1 cycle.
ui.cardx.soul-pact.title: Soul Pact
ui.cardx.soul-pact.description: 🔮 Soul threshold reduced from 10 to 7. Empowered spells last 2 shots instead of 1.
ui.cardx.void-storm.title: Void Storm
ui.cardx.void-storm.description: 🔮 Legendary: Death Nova explodes in chain — each explosion has a 60% chance to trigger another (max 3 chains). Total damage can triple.
ui.cardx.perfect-solitude.title: Perfect Solitude
ui.cardx.perfect-solitude.description: 🔮 Legendary: When alone (0 allies), Malachar becomes untargetable and gains +120% damage. Solitude is his weapon.
ui.cardx.mythic-ascension.title: Mythic Ascension
ui.cardx.mythic-ascension.description: 🔮 MYTHIC: During Ascension, all 4 spells fire simultaneously. Duration doubled to 20s. Malachar levitates — immobile but immune.
ui.cardx.ancient-will.title: Ancient Will
ui.cardx.ancient-will.description: 🌿 MYTHIC: Druid permanently applies 2 seasons simultaneously on every shot. At the start of each wave, ancient spirits slow ALL enemies by 30% for 10s. Druidic Eclipse triggers every full cycle automatically.
ui.cardx.death-lord.title: ☠ Death Lord
ui.cardx.death-lord.description: 💀 ASCENSION — Necromancer becomes a Death Lord: spawns 3 Undead at wave start, all Undead gain +100% damage, and curses ALL enemies at wave start (−30% speed & damage for 10s).
ui.cardx.crescendo.title: Crescendo
ui.cardx.anthem-of-ruin.title: Anthem of Ruin
ui.cardx.anthem-of-ruin.description: 🎵 Bard joins the fight! Damage: {{bardDmg}} → {{v1}} (+100%), 25% crit. Aura boosts ALL ally damage +20%. Max 2 stacks.
ui.cardx.dirge-of-doom.title: Dirge of Doom
ui.cardx.dirge-of-doom.description: 🎵 Bard aura now slows all enemies in range by 30% and reduces their damage by 20%.
ui.cardx.grand-finale.title: Grand Finale
ui.cardx.grand-finale.description: 🎵 MYTHIC: Once per run, when the tower falls below 50% HP, the Bard performs the Grand Finale — all allies gain +200% damage and max attack speed for 12s, all enemies become confused for 6s. After the Finale the Bard keeps +60% permanent attack speed.
ui.cardx.sanctified-wrath.title: Sanctified Wrath
ui.cardx.sanctified-wrath.description: ✨ MYTHIC: every 5th Cleric shot releases a Holy Nova hitting ALL enemies on screen for 60% of her damage, and the barrier recovers 3 HP. Battle Prayer chance +50%.
ui.cardx.iron-will.title: Iron Will
ui.cardx.eternal-crusade.title: Eternal Crusade
ui.cardx.eternal-crusade.description: 🛡 MYTHIC: Divine Caldera damage adds directly to every Paladin attack. Below 30% HP, he becomes immune for 5s once per wave. Caldera radius doubles.
ui.cardx.mending-touch.title: Mending Touch
ui.cardx.mending-touch.description: ⚕ Priest heal power: {{priestHeal}} → {{v1}} HP/shot (+20%). Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.divine-covenant.title: Divine Covenant
ui.cardx.divine-covenant.description: ⚕ MYTHIC: At the start of every wave each ally receives a divine shield absorbing 50 damage. Once per wave an ally that would die is automatically saved at 1 HP. Guardian Aura damage reduction doubles.
ui.cardx.extended-inscription.title: Extended Inscription
ui.cardx.extended-inscription.descriptio: ⚡ Runesmith range: {{runeRange}} → {{v1}} (+30%) and chain hits 1 more enemy. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.grand-rune.title: Grand Rune
ui.cardx.grand-rune.description: ⚡ MYTHIC: every 20th shot, the Runesmith fires a Grand Rune: lightning that hits ALL enemies on screen for 150% damage. Up to 3 per wave.
ui.cardx.world-tree.title: World Tree
ui.cardx.world-tree.description: 🌿 MYTHIC: Sylvanite's poison afflicts ALL enemies on screen at all times. Nature's Bloom heals double.
ui.cardx.death-mark.title: Death Mark
ui.cardx.death-mark.description: ⚔️ Every kill during Sai Rush resets its cooldown once per wave. Rush kills also deal +50% bonus damage.
ui.cardx.hunger.title: Hunger
ui.cardx.hunger.description: 🩸 Vex: Sai Rush steals 12% of damage dealt as HP (up from 5%). Every dash heals her.
ui.cardx.blink-strike.title: Blink Strike
ui.cardx.blink-strike.description: 🩸 Vex: Sai Rush AoE radius increases from 120px to 160px. More enemies hit per teleport.
ui.cardx.veil-of-shadow.title: Veil of Shadow
ui.cardx.veil-of-shadow.description: 🩸 Vex: 35% chance to dodge each enemy projectile.
ui.cardx.shadow-death.title: Shadow Death
ui.cardx.shadow-death.description: 🩸 MYTHIC: Sai Rush triggers every 3rd attack. Each rush kill grows future rush area by 10% for the whole run (up to +100%). At 10 kills, rushes deal 3× damage.
ui.cardx.void-eclipse.title: Void Eclipse
ui.cardx.void-eclipse.description: 💀 Every 5 kill stacks grant +15% damage (instead of +8%). At 15 stacks: all nearby enemies are feared for 2s.
ui.cardx.void-persistence.title: Void Persistence
ui.cardx.void-persistence.description: 💀 Void Harvest stacks no longer reset between waves — they carry forward and keep growing throughout the run.
ui.cardx.void-apotheosis.title: Void Apotheosis
ui.cardx.void-apotheosis.description: 💀 MYTHIC: Dreadlord gains +1% permanent damage for every 1% of max HP missing (at 10% HP = +90% damage). Once per run instead of dying he detonates — dealing 300% current damage to all enemies on screen — and revives at 30% HP.
ui.cardx.last-stand.title: Last Stand
ui.cardx.last-stand.description: 🔥 ALL allies gain +{{v0}}% damage ({{fallen}} fallen × 15%). Honour the dead.
ui.cardx.war-council.title: War Council
ui.cardx.war-council.description: 📜 Your next 2 level-up offers show 5 cards instead of 3. {{queued}}
ui.cardx.transmutation.title: Transmutation
ui.cardx.transmutation.description: ⚗️ Convert all {{v0}} Gold into +{{xpGain}} XP right now. Gold becomes power.
ui.rotate.title: Rotate Your Device
ui.forge.title: FORGE
ui.forge.subtitle: Permanent upgrades — paid with Essence
ui.daily.title: Daily Challenge
hero.mage.name: Krash (Mage)
hero.mage.description: A balanced mage. Reliable projectiles that deal solid damage.
hero.archer.name: Ifigenia (Archer)
hero.archer.description: High speed and long range. Arrows apply bleed on every hit.
hero.druid.name: Vindimia (Druid)
hero.druid.description: Season cycles: Spring heals, Summer boosts damage, Autumn explodes in spores, Winter freezes and ricochets.
hero.cleric.name: Alva (Cleric)
hero.cleric.description: Fires holy light. Can bless the army with massive damage.
hero.paladin.name: Hellel (Paladin)
hero.paladin.description: Holy warrior who purifies evil. Specialist against the undead and demons.
hero.warlock.name: Sibilus (Warlock)
hero.warlock.description: Slow shots that deal massive damage. Short range.
hero.priest.name: Hyo (Priest)
hero.priest.description: Healing specialist. Fires light orbs that restore the health of wounded allies.
hero.necromancer.name: Ikan (Necromancer)
hero.necromancer.description: Summons a Common Undead at the start of each wave. Commands the dead to fight for him.
hero.bard.name: Sonetto (Bard)
hero.bard.description: Aura that increases ally attack speed by 35%. Weak direct damage.
hero.runesmith.name: Veltharion (Runesmith)
hero.runesmith.description: Inscribes runes on the ground that auto-fire at enemies. Every 5th shot unleashes a chain lightning rune.
hero.sylvanite.name: Aelindra (Sylvanite)
hero.sylvanite.description: Spirit of the ancient forest. Heals all allies passively each wave and poisons enemies in a wide area.
hero.dreadlord.name: Kael'Vor (Dreadlord)
hero.dreadlord.description: A void-touched warrior who grows stronger with each enemy slain. Each kill feeds the void — at 15 stacks, his power becomes catastrophic.
hero.jester.name: Ming (Jester)
hero.jester.description: A mad court jester who cycles between 3 enchanted balls: Red (slow), Gold (heal ally), Purple (confuse). Dies with a bang.
hero.vex.name: Vex (Assassin)
hero.vex.description: Every 5th attack executes Sai Rush: teleports to the target and strikes in AoE. Kills restore HP.
hero.zylvara.name: Zylvara (Shadow Archer)
hero.zylvara.description: Arrows apply poison on hit. Every 6th attack triggers Shadow Step: becomes immune for 1.5s and hits the farthest enemy for triple damage.
hero.morrigan.name: Morrigan (Soul Devourer)
hero.morrigan.description: Soul Harvest: enemies dying nearby drop souls — each soul permanently adds +2% damage and +4px range. Consuming Strike: consecutive hits spend a soul charge for +15% bonus damage. Devour Mode: every 10 souls triggers 5s of AoE explosive shots.
hero.ixara.name: Ixara (Chaos Demoness)
hero.ixara.description: Gains Fury when hit (max 10 stacks; halves between waves). Every 5 attacks fires Chaos Nova: AoE damage that grows with Fury and stuns regular enemies for 0.6s.
hero.berserker.name: Gorak (Berserker)
hero.berserker.description: Blood Rage: the lower the barrier HP, the higher his damage (up to 3×). Every 12s enters Rampage: triple attack speed, piercing shots.
hero.frost_warden.name: Serafyne (Frost Warden)
hero.frost_warden.description: Shots leave frost marks. 3 marks on the same spot create an Ice Patch (−50% speed). Every 18s raises a Glacial Wall that blocks and damages enemies.
hero.inquisitor.name: Valdric (Inquisitor)
hero.inquisitor.description: Verdict: every 5 kills of the same enemy type permanently adds +20% damage against it (cap +100%). Active: Sentence marks one enemy — all allies deal +30% to it. Boss kill with Sentence resets cooldown.
hero.malachar_human.name: Malachar (Redeemed)
hero.malachar_human.description: Chaos Grimoire: cycles through 4 automatic spells. Every 10 souls collected, next spell is Empowered. Solitary: +20-80% damage per empty slot. Ascension charges by damage dealt.
forgeUp.forge_barrier_hp.name: Reinforced Wall
forgeUp.forge_barrier_hp.flavor: "Every brick laid in peace holds twice in war."
forgeUp.forge_barrier_regen.name: Living Stone
forgeUp.forge_barrier_resist.name: Iron Mortar
forgeUp.forge_gold_start.name: Vault Reserve
forgeUp.forge_gold_start.flavor: "Every run begins with a head start."
forgeUp.forge_gold_wave.name: Tribute Network
forgeUp.forge_gold_wave.desc: +3 bonus gold per wave completed per level
forgeUp.forge_lucky_start.name: Lucky Start
forgeUp.forge_lucky_start.desc: First level-up card each run is guaranteed Rare or better
forgeUp.forge_lucky_start.flavor: "Fortune favors the prepared. The forge prepares."
forgeUp.forge_ally_level.name: Veteran Cadre

hero.mage.lore: Krash was never the most talented student at the Arcane Collegium, but he was the most stubborn. Expelled twice, reinstated once by accident, he learned magic the hard way: through failure, explosion, and sheer refusal to stop. His spells rarely look elegant. They always land.
hero.archer.lore: Ifigenia grew up on the edge of the Thornwood, where silence kept you alive and a misfire meant becoming prey. She never had a teacher. Only the forest, the wind, and an endless supply of things trying to kill her. By the time she was fifteen, nothing in the wood was faster than her arrow.
hero.druid.lore: Vindimia does not cast spells. She negotiates. Every root that erupts from the ground, every vine that coils around an enemy's throat, these are acts of cooperation between her and a world that is very, very angry about what was done to the old forest. She just points it in the right direction.
hero.cleric.lore: Alva took her vows at seventeen and broke her first at eighteen, not out of faithlessness, but because the siege of Vel'Morath left no time for prayer. She fought with her mace until the handle cracked, then with her hands. The Church called it insubordination. The survivors called it salvation.
hero.paladin.lore: Hellel has fought the undead for so long that he has stopped thinking of them as enemies and started thinking of them as a problem to be solved: methodically, permanently, and with a very large hammer. He does not hate what he kills. He simply refuses to let it exist.
hero.warlock.lore: Sibilus made a deal at the crossroads of three dead roads under a moonless sky. He got power beyond reckoning. What he gave in return, he has never said, but on cold nights, he checks the space where it used to be, and the checking takes longer every year.
hero.priest.lore: Hyo came from a monastery that preached that healing was a form of violence against death. He believed them completely. Every soul he pulls back from the edge is a battle won, a line held, a small and furious defiance against the inevitable. He heals like a man picking a fight.
hero.necromancer.lore: Ikan does not speak of death as an ending. He speaks of it as a resource. The undead that follow him were once soldiers, farmers, kings, now they are simply more efficient. No wages, no sleep, no fear. He considers this an improvement. Most people who hear him say this do not agree, but they also do not argue.
hero.bard.lore: Sonetto has played in taverns, throne rooms, battlefields, and once, memorably, inside a siege engine while it was firing. He does not consider himself brave, he considers himself very good at reading a room and playing whatever the room needs to hear. In battle, what the room needs is rhythm.
hero.runesmith.lore: Veltharion spent forty years carving runes into stone before he understood that the runes themselves were alive, not thinking, but aware, the way fire is aware of what it touches. He stopped carving for pleasure after that. Now he carves with purpose, and the runes respond to it.
hero.sylvanite.lore: Aelindra is not entirely human, or was not, once. The forest that made her what she is has no name anymore; it was burned in the Third Sundering and exists now only in her memory and in the way trees lean toward her when she passes. She does not grieve. She tends.
hero.dreadlord.lore: Kael'Vor was cursed by a god who thought himself merciful, instead of death, he was given power that consumes the vessel it inhabits. Every battle brings him closer to an end he cannot refuse. He stopped fighting to survive long ago. Now he fights because each strike is a small, magnificent act of spite against the thing eating him alive.
hero.jester.lore: Nobody remembers who hired Ming or why. He appeared one day at the gates of Grimhold with a bag of enchanted balls and an offer to help. The offer was genuine. The balls were genuinely dangerous. After the third incident, the council stopped asking questions and just pointed him at enemies.
hero.vex.lore: Vex does not pursue. She arrives. Between one blink and the next, she is somewhere else, sai in both hands, smile hidden behind a veil of purple silk. She does not fight for the kingdom. She fights for the pleasure of vanishing in a violet flash and reappearing in the middle of the enemy line. The carnage is just the bonus.
hero.zylvara.lore: Zylvara never saw the sun and does not miss it. She grew up in the caverns of Vel'Arath, where light is a design flaw and darkness is simply the natural state of everything. She is not an assassin by training — she is one by temperament. The difference, if she cared to explain it, is that trained killers make mistakes when the plan fails. Zylvara has no plans. She only has results.
hero.morrigan.lore: Morrigan is 412 years old, but she stopped counting after three hundred because she decided that large numbers make conversations dull. The golden ember in her chest is the first soul she ever absorbed by accident — a thief who tried to rob her on a winter night in 1247 and learned that touching a witch without permission has permanent spiritual consequences. She still feels slightly guilty about it. Only slightly. The soul count, however — that she tracks obsessively.
hero.ixara.lore: Ixara was not summoned. She simply appeared. One ordinary morning she was standing in the middle of Grimhold's courtyard, staring at the sun with the expression of someone trying to solve a very difficult equation. The white blaze that erupts from her is not divine light — it is the pressure of everything she destroyed before she learned how to hold it back. She is still learning.
hero.berserker.lore: Gorak was the last soldier standing at the Siege of Ashfen, not because he was the strongest, but because he was too angry to notice he'd been wounded. He has been wounded many times since. He considers this useful. The pain tells him he's still in the fight, and the fight tells him he's still alive, and as long as both those things are true, nothing else matters.
hero.frost_warden.lore: Serafyne was born in the coldest winter in recorded history and has been quietly insulted by warm weather ever since. She does not freeze things out of cruelty. She freezes them out of preference. The world is calmer when it's cold, she says. Cleaner. More honest. Enemies who argue the point do so briefly.
hero.inquisitor.lore: Valdric has a list. It is very long. He has been adding to it since the age of nineteen, when the first demon crossed the threshold of a village he had been assigned to protect, and he was not fast enough to stop what happened after. He is always fast enough now. He made sure of that. The list helps.
hero.malachar_human.lore: Malachar was not defeated. He was freed. Four hundred years serving chaos as its champion, and the first thing he did when the curse broke was look at his own hands. They still trembled, but now from the effort of holding power back, not releasing it. He did not come to ask forgiveness. He came because he knows exactly what is coming, and no one else knows how to stop it.

ui.modeSelect.modes.none.label: STANDARD
ui.modeSelect.modes.none.desc: No modifiers. The classic Grimhold experience.
ui.modeSelect.modes.pacifist.label: PACIFIST
ui.modeSelect.modes.pacifist.desc: Chill mode. Barrier and allies have infinite HP. No essence rewards.
ui.modeSelect.modes.endless.label: ENDLESS
ui.modeSelect.modes.endless.desc: All 10 acts in sequence, wave after wave, forever. Choose your map. How long can you hold?
ui.modeSelect.modes.randomizer.label: RANDOMIZER
ui.modeSelect.modes.randomizer.desc: Completely random enemies every wave. Choose your difficulty and adapt or perish.
ui.modeSelect.diff.easy.label: EASY
ui.modeSelect.diff.easy.desc: For beginners. Slower enemies, more resilient barrier.
ui.modeSelect.diff.normal.label: NORMAL
ui.modeSelect.diff.normal.desc: The standard experience. Strategy and good composition are essential.
ui.modeSelect.diff.hard.label: HARD
ui.modeSelect.diff.hard.desc: Aggressive enemies, scarce gold. Every decision matters.
ui.modeSelect.diff.infernal.label: INFERNAL
ui.modeSelect.diff.infernal.desc: Only the best survive. No mercy, no rest.

ui.charSelectTutorial.step.hero.title: Choose Your Hero
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.hero.desc: Each hero has a unique playstyle, damage type, and ability. Browse the list on the left and click to preview a hero before committing.
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.relics.title: Relics
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.relics.desc: Each hero unlocks Relics as you gain Mastery. Relics are powerful passive bonuses active for the entire run — they stack with synergies and skill tree bonuses.
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.draft.title: Draft
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.draft.desc: Pin up to 2 heroes to the Draft. Pinned heroes appear more often in the shop during a run, letting you build a team around your strategy.
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.skills.title: Skill Tree
ui.charSelectTutorial.step.skills.desc: Spend Mastery points to unlock nodes in your hero's Skill Tree. Each level of Mastery gives 1 point. Choose between two paths — you can't unlock everything, so plan your build!

ui.cardx.sylvanite-toxin.description: 🌿 Poison deals +{{cur}}% → +{{next}}% damage per tick and spreads to 2 nearby enemies. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.sylvanite-bloom.title: Nature's Bloom
ui.cardx.sylvanite-bloom.description: 🌿 Each wave start: heal ALL allies for {{cur}} → {{next}} HP and grant +10% damage for 15s. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.sylvanite-root.title: Entangling Roots
ui.cardx.sylvanite-root.description: 🌿 {{cur}}% → {{next}}% chance: poisoned enemies are rooted 2.5s and take +25% damage while rooted. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.sylvanite-rebirth.title: Forest Rebirth
ui.cardx.sylvanite-rebirth.description: 🌿 Once{{extra}} per wave, when any ally would die, Sylvanite revives them with 40% HP.
ui.cardx.dreadlord-hunger.title: Void Strike
ui.cardx.dreadlord-hunger.description: 💀 Dreadlord base damage: {{cur}} → {{next}} (+25%) and gains double hit chance. Also grants +4% bonus per Void Harvest stack. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.dreadlord-void.title: Void Rupture
ui.cardx.dreadlord-void.description: 💀 {{cur}}% → {{next}}% chance: shot explodes in area for 80% splash damage. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.dreadlord-harvest-cap.title: Void Gluttony
ui.cardx.dreadlord-harvest-cap.descripti: 💀 Void Harvest max stacks: {{cur}} → {{next}} (+5 cap). Current wave: {{active}} stacks active. Max 3 upgrades.
ui.cardx.dreadlord-harvest-cap.flavorTex: The void is never full. Neither is he.
ui.cardx.jester-trick.title: Bag of Tricks
ui.cardx.jester-trick.description: 🃏 Jester damage +20% and ball effects are {{pct}}% stronger. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
ui.cardx.sacrifice.description: ☠ Remove a random ally permanently. ALL remaining allies gain +20% to all stats. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.dmg-boost.title: Global Arcane Power
ui.cardx.dmg-boost.description: ⚡ ALL allies gain +10% damage. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.iron-discipline.title: Iron Discipline
ui.cardx.iron-discipline.description: ⚔️ ALL allies gain +{{pct}}% damage ({{count}} allies × 5%). Max 4 stacks.
ui.cardx.blood-price.title: Blood Price
ui.cardx.blood-price.description: 💉 ALL allies lose 10% HP but gain +30% damage. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.glass-cannon.title: Glass Cannon
ui.cardx.glass-cannon.description: 🔱 ALL allies lose 50% HP but gain +80% permanent damage. Max 2 stacks.
ui.cardx.dark-bargain.title: Dark Bargain
ui.cardx.dark-bargain.description: 🌑 Barrier loses 15 HP. ALL allies gain +25% permanent damage. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.bard-hymn.title: Battle Hymn
ui.cardx.bard-hymn.description: 🎵 Bard aura attack speed buff: +{{cur}}% → +{{next}}% for nearby allies. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.cleric-self.title: Sacred Ground
ui.cardx.cleric-self.description: ✨ Cleric self-heals {{cur}}% → {{next}}% max HP per shot fired. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.cleric-blessing.title: Battle Prayer
ui.cardx.cleric-blessing.description: ✨ {{cur}}% → {{next}}% chance: double ALL ally damage for 3s per shot. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.cleric-retribution.title: Divine Retribution
ui.cardx.cleric-retribution.description: ✨ Cleric deals +{{cur}}% → +{{next}}% damage to undead enemies. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.paladin-caldera.title: Divine Caldera
ui.cardx.paladin-caldera.description: 🛡 Paladin radiates AoE holy fire. Each stack: +{{cur}}% → +{{next}}% Caldera damage. Max 5 stacks.
ui.cardx.paladin-martyr.title: Martyr's Oath
ui.cardx.paladin-martyr.description: 🛡 Below {{cur}}% → {{next}}% HP: Paladin attack speed triples until healed. Max 3 stacks.
ui.cardx.priest-guard.title: Guardian Aura
ui.cardx.priest-guard.description: ⚕ Priest aura reduces all ally damage taken: -{{cur}}% → -{{next}}%. Max 5 stacks (-25%).
ui.cardx.priest-res.title: Resurrection
ui.cardx.priest-res.description: ⚕ Instantly restore {{pct}}% HP to ALL allies right now. Can be taken multiple times.
ui.actSelect.title: SELECT ACT
ui.actSelect.act1.title: Act I
ui.actSelect.act1.subtitle: The Siege of Grimhold
ui.actSelect.act1.lore: The walls of Grimhold have never fallen. Goblins, Orcs and the risen dead batter the gates — but something ancient stirs beneath them all.
ui.actSelect.act2.title: Act II
ui.actSelect.act2.subtitle: The Cursed Forest
ui.actSelect.act2.lore: The ancient forest surrounding Grimhold has awoken. Elves twisted by old magic, minotaurs from the scorched plains, and dragons circling overhead.
ui.actSelect.act3.title: Act III
ui.actSelect.act3.subtitle: Lands of the Giants
ui.actSelect.act3.lore: The mountains beyond Grimhold hide something worse than beasts. Cyclopes, ogres — and the half-brothers whose grudge predates the fortress itself. Then the night comes for real.
ui.actSelect.act4.title: Act IV
ui.actSelect.act4.subtitle: The Abyss
ui.actSelect.act4.lore: The rift has been open too long. What pours through now are not invaders — they are fragments of a realm that should not exist, wearing the faces of things already defeated.
ui.actSelect.act4.lockMsg: Survive the Lands of the Giants.
ui.actSelect.act5.title: Act V
ui.actSelect.act5.subtitle: The End of Grimhold
ui.actSelect.act5.lore: Malachar was not the beginning. He was just the door. What walks through now has no name that survives the speaking of it. Grimhold's last stand starts here.
ui.daily.essenceAwardedFull: +{{n}} Essence awarded. Come back tomorrow for a new challenge.
ui.daily.autoAwarded: Awarded automatically when all {{n}} objectives are completed.
ui.tutorial.step0.main: Drag your hero from the panel on the left and drop it onto the <1>blue grid</1> to the right.
ui.roadmap.quote: "As a solo developer, I can adapt quickly — so what comes next will be guided by your feedback."
ui.charTabs.heroBonusDesc: Your hero starts at Level 10 with 3× base damage and 3× base HP compared to a shop-bought version of the same class.
ui.charTabs.earnXpWith: Earn XP playing with <1>{{name}}</1> to unlock more relics.
ui.skillTree.playWith: Play with <1>{{name}}</1> to earn mastery XP and unlock more skill points.
ui.skillTree.xpRates: +300 base XP per run · +20 per wave · +1 per kill
ui.bossToast.infernoBreath: 🔥 INFERNO BREATH — Vreth'Kal exhales ancient fire!
ui.bossToast.eternalFlame: 🌋 ETERNAL FLAME — The ground burns beneath your feet!
ui.bossToast.petrify: 🗿 PETRIFICATION — every hero has turned to stone!
ui.bossToast.boneCrown: 👑 BONE CROWN — Zog'Krix calls his gang!
ui.bossToast.warCry: ⚔ WAR CRY — the horde surges forward!
ui.bossToast.shadowStep: 🌑 SHADOW STEP — the Reaper slips through the dark!
ui.bossToast.voidClaws: 🌀 VOID CLAWS — Vel'Shade drags your heroes forward!
ui.bossToast.mistForm: 🌫 MIST FORM — Valdris disperses into shadow!
ui.bossToast.summonInfernal: 👿 SUMMON INFERNAL — Malachar calls his infernal servants!
ui.bossToast.soulChain: 🔗 SOUL CHAIN — Two souls are bound together!
ui.bossToast.riftTear: 💀 RIFT TEAR — A wound in reality opens!
ui.bossToast.malacharWrath: ⚡ MALACHAR'S WRATH — All abilities surge at double speed!
ui.bossToast.rouletteFrenzy: 🎪 ROULETTE: Speed Frenzy! All allies +100% dmg for 10s!
ui.spell.meteor.title: ☄ Meteor
ui.spell.meteor.name: Meteor
ui.spell.meteor.desc: Click to select a target. Deals massive AoE damage to all enemies in the impact zone. Great for clearing packed waves.
ui.spell.freeze.title: ❄ Freeze
ui.spell.freeze.name: Freeze
ui.spell.freeze.desc: Instantly freezes all enemies on screen for several seconds. Use it to buy breathing room when overwhelmed.
ui.spell.repair.title: 🔧 Repair
ui.spell.repair.name: Repair
ui.spell.repair.desc: Spends gold to restore Barrier HP. The higher the wave, the more it costs. Use when your barrier is critically low.
ui.spell.rally.title: ⚡ Rally
ui.spell.rally.name: Rally
ui.spell.rally.desc: Buffs all allies: increases attack speed and damage for a short burst. Best used at the start of a tough wave.
ui.spell.bulwark.title: 🛡 Bulwark
ui.spell.bulwark.name: Bulwark
ui.spell.bulwark.desc: Erects a temporary shield on the barrier, absorbing incoming damage. Ideal against ranged enemy barrages.
ui.victory.act1.subtitle: Act I — Siege of Grimhold Conquered
ui.victory.act1.text: The Dragon Lord has fallen and the siege is broken. Grimhold's ramparts hold firm against the darkness.
ui.victory.act1.tagline: They brought fire to shatter your fortress. They found only their grave in the ash.
ui.victory.act2.subtitle: Act II — The Cursed Forest Cleansed
ui.victory.act2.text: The multi-headed terror of the deep grove has been severed. The primeval corruption recedes into the loam, bowing to your mastery.
ui.victory.act2.tagline: Nature bows to those who refuse to break under the weight of the wild.
ui.victory.act3.subtitle: Act III — Lands of the Giants Silenced
ui.victory.act3.text: The colossi of the frozen highlands lie shattered. The icy winds carry only the silence of your triumph.
ui.victory.act3.tagline: Even giants fall before a fortress that will not yield.
ui.victory.act4.subtitle: Act IV — The Void Rift Conquered
ui.victory.act4.text: The cosmic rift seals shut. What sought to tear through the fabric of reality has been eradicated.
ui.victory.act4.tagline: You stared into the void. The void blinked first.
ui.victory.act5.subtitle: Act V — The Final Stand · Apocalypse Broken
ui.victory.act5.text: Malachar has been vanquished. The prophesied apocalypse is averted, and Grimhold ascends into legend.
ui.victory.act5.tagline: Some doors, once closed, stay closed forever.
ui.victory.endless.subtitle: Endless Campaign Trial Cleared
ui.victory.endless.text: Against insurmountable hordes and infinite waves, your tactical formation stood unbreakable.
ui.victory.endless.tagline: There is no end to war — but today, you wrote your name among the immortals.
ui.victory.tutorial.subtitle: Fortress Training Completed
ui.victory.tutorial.text: You have mastered the ancient arts of garrison placement and arcane defense. The realm awaits your command.
ui.victory.tutorial.tagline: Every master was once a beginner. You are a beginner no more.
ui.gameOver.title: GAME OVER
ui.gameOver.w45.subtitle: The last gate fell.
ui.gameOver.w45.flavor: You stood within sight of the end. Malachar's shadow swallowed the last light. But you came closer than most ever will.
ui.gameOver.w35.subtitle: The void closed in.
ui.gameOver.w35.flavor: The half-brothers fell. The vampire emerged. You held longer than any had a right to — and still it wasn't enough.
ui.gameOver.w25.subtitle: The fire was not enough.
ui.gameOver.w25.flavor: The dragon's breath came without warning, and even your finest formation crumbled beneath it. Build differently. Try again.
ui.gameOver.w15.subtitle: The line broke.
ui.gameOver.w15.flavor: Vel'Shade appeared and everything changed. The fog, the cold, the silence. You nearly held — but nearly is not enough in Grimhold.
ui.gameOver.w8.subtitle: An early grave.
ui.gameOver.w8.flavor: Grakh Ironjaw has been declared dead eleven times. You are not on that list. But you could be.
ui.gameOver.w0.subtitle: Grimhold did not wait.
ui.gameOver.w0.flavor: The goblins came before you were ready. The wall does not negotiate. Come back stronger.
ui.demo.achievementsBanner: Achievements are tracked in the full game.
ui.elite.desc.arcane: Fires magic bolts, two at a time — even melee foes.
ui.elite.desc.berserker: Gets faster as it loses health, up to +60%.
ui.elite.desc.frozen: Chills nearby allies: attack speed halved.
dialogo.chegada.mage: I'm here. If something explodes, it was on purpose.
dialogo.chegada.archer: Less talk. The woods taught me noise becomes prey.
dialogo.chegada.druid: The forest agreed to help. Don't ask the price.
dialogo.chegada.cleric: I took vows of peace. I brought the mace too, just in case.
dialogo.chegada.paladin: If there's undead, they're mine. If not, I'll find some.
dialogo.chegada.warlock: I paid dearly for this power. Let me use it.
dialogo.chegada.priest: Whoever falls, I lift. Whoever argues, too.
dialogo.chegada.necromancer: Everything that dies out there becomes reinforcement. Simple math.
dialogo.chegada.bard: No long intro. The field has a rhythm already; I just tune it.
dialogo.chegada.runesmith: Forty years of runes. They know what to do.
dialogo.chegada.sylvanite: The forest that made me is gone. This wall will not be.
dialogo.chegada.dreadlord: Every blow is one less day for me. Still worth it.
dialogo.chegada.jester: I brought the balls! The council said to aim that way.
dialogo.chegada.zylvara: Too much light here. I'll fix that.
dialogo.chegada.morrigan: Four hundred years and they still call me when it's bad. How sweet.
dialogo.chegada.ixara: I'm holding back. Tell me if I stop.
dialogo.chegada.berserker: Getting here hurt. Good. Means I'm alive.
dialogo.chegada.frost_warden: It's far too warm here. I'll correct that.
dialogo.chegada.inquisitor: I have a list. Is anyone here on it?
dialogo.chegada.malachar_human: I know what you think of me. I'm here because I know what's coming.
dialogo.reacao.mage: Welcome. Stand clear when I cast.
dialogo.reacao.archer: Stay behind me and keep quiet.
dialogo.reacao.druid: The forest accepted you. I'm still deciding.
dialogo.reacao.cleric: Pray fast. The wave won't wait.
dialogo.reacao.paladin: You know how to use that? Good. Let's get to work.
dialogo.reacao.warlock: Don't ask what I gave up. Just fight.
dialogo.reacao.priest: If you fall, I'll lift you. Don't make me do it twice.
dialogo.reacao.necromancer: Alive, still. Interesting. Stay that way, it's less work.
dialogo.reacao.bard: Find the beat. I'll handle the rest.
dialogo.reacao.runesmith: Don't step on the runes. They hold grudges.
dialogo.reacao.sylvanite: You're hurt. No? You will be. I'll tend to it.
dialogo.reacao.dreadlord: Don't get attached to me. I won't last.
dialogo.reacao.jester: Red ball or gold? Pick one, it's a surprise!
dialogo.reacao.zylvara: You breathe loud. I'll pretend I didn't hear.
dialogo.reacao.morrigan: Ah, fresh meat. Try not to become a soul before wave ten.
dialogo.reacao.ixara: Don't touch me. Not for your sake. For mine.
dialogo.reacao.berserker: You bleed? Good. Then you know you're alive.
dialogo.reacao.frost_warden: No fire near me. It's a matter of principle.
dialogo.reacao.inquisitor: You're not on the list. Yet.
dialogo.reacao.malachar_human: Don't trust me. I wouldn't. But fight beside me.
dialogo.par.mage.runesmith.h: You're late. The gate runes are fading again.
dialogo.par.mage.runesmith.a: They fade because you burn them with arcane fire, Krash. Every time.
dialogo.par.runesmith.mage.h: Krash. Three paces from my runes, please.
dialogo.par.runesmith.mage.a: One time, Veltharion. It was one time.
dialogo.par.vex.zylvara.h: I thought the forest had swallowed you.
dialogo.par.vex.zylvara.a: It spat me out. Still aiming at what's already dead?
dialogo.par.zylvara.vex.h: You make noise even when you vanish.
dialogo.par.zylvara.vex.a: And you miss even in the dark. We're even.
dialogo.par.archer.sylvanite.h: Aelindra. The woods send their regards.
dialogo.par.archer.sylvanite.a: The woods don't send regards, Ifigenia. They send me.
dialogo.par.sylvanite.archer.h: You still sleep with an arrow in hand.
dialogo.par.sylvanite.archer.a: And you still know that without asking me.
dialogo.par.frost_warden.ixara.h: You run too hot. Stay on the far side of the field.
dialogo.par.frost_warden.ixara.a: Serafyne. I missed you. Truly, without burning anything.
dialogo.par.ixara.frost_warden.h: I won't burn anything today. I promise.
dialogo.par.ixara.frost_warden.a: You promise that every time. I brought ice anyway.
dialogo.par.jester.morrigan.a: Ming, last time the ball ate one of my souls. Purple, then.
dialogo.par.morrigan.jester.h: The jester. I thought the council had returned you.
dialogo.par.morrigan.jester.a: They tried! Nobody would take the return.
dialogo.par.paladin.inquisitor.a: Three names since yesterday, Hellel. Two already crossed out.
dialogo.par.inquisitor.paladin.h: Hellel. Still with the big hammer?
dialogo.par.inquisitor.paladin.a: Still works. You still with the short list?
dialogo.par.necromancer.morrigan.h: Morrigan. You keep the dead too.
dialogo.par.necromancer.morrigan.a: I keep souls, Ikan. You keep the leftovers. Not the same.
dialogo.par.cleric.priest.a: Alva, we agreed those are the same thing.
dialogo.par.priest.cleric.h: Alva. Does the Church still call you insubordinate?
dialogo.par.priest.cleric.a: Only in letters. In person nobody dares.
dialogo.par.paladin.necromancer.h: Ikan. Your dead stay on your side of the line.
dialogo.par.paladin.necromancer.a: They don't even know there's a line, Hellel. I do.
dialogo.par.inquisitor.malachar_human.h: Malachar. You're the first line of my list.
dialogo.par.inquisitor.malachar_human.a: I know, Valdric. Let me reach the end of it first.
dialogo.par.malachar_human.inquisitor.h: Valdric. You can cross my name out later.
dialogo.par.malachar_human.inquisitor.a: I don't cross out. I just change columns.
dialogo.par.berserker.bard.a: Gorak, you're the loud thing. I just keep up.
dialogo.par.druid.sylvanite.a: The forest? Always. But today she's angry at the right side.
dialogo.par.warlock.dreadlord.a: I didn't pay, Sibilus. I was charged. There's a difference.
dialogo.par.mage.malachar_human.h: The Collegium had your portrait on the wall. With an X.
dialogo.par.mage.malachar_human.a: I know. I painted the X myself.
dialogo.par.mesmo.mesmo.a: Apparently. Try not to embarrass me.
dialogo.par.mage.mage.h: Another me. The Collegium is going to have a fit.
dialogo.par.mage.mage.a: Two Krashes, twice the explosions. You stand clear this time.
dialogo.par.druid.druid.h: Did the forest send you too?
dialogo.par.druid.druid.a: She doesn't trust you alone. Neither do I.
dialogo.par.cleric.cleric.h: Did you break the first vow too?
dialogo.par.cleric.cleric.a: At eighteen. During the siege. You know.
dialogo.par.paladin.paladin.a: Half the time. Undead on the left are mine.
dialogo.par.warlock.warlock.h: Do you feel the empty space too?
dialogo.par.warlock.warlock.a: I do. It's growing. Yours too?
dialogo.par.priest.priest.h: If you fall, I'll lift you.
dialogo.par.priest.priest.a: If YOU fall, I'll lift you first. Bet?
dialogo.par.necromancer.necromancer.h: Efficient. Two of us, twice the reserves.
dialogo.par.necromancer.necromancer.a: You talk like me. Is that good or bad?
dialogo.par.bard.bard.h: Can you play the second voice?
dialogo.par.bard.bard.a: I play the first. You keep up.
dialogo.par.runesmith.runesmith.h: Forty years and I never carved one of me.
dialogo.par.runesmith.runesmith.a: The runes carved it. They find it funny.
dialogo.par.sylvanite.sylvanite.h: Does the forest remember both of us?
dialogo.par.sylvanite.sylvanite.a: It remembers one. You pick which.
dialogo.par.dreadlord.dreadlord.a: Slower than you. I got here later.
dialogo.par.jester.jester.h: Ming! Did you bring the balls?
dialogo.par.vex.vex.a: No. You're the one who left.
dialogo.par.morrigan.morrigan.h: Four hundred and twelve years and this is the first time.
dialogo.par.morrigan.morrigan.a: Four hundred and thirteen. You stopped counting earlier.
dialogo.par.frost_warden.frost_warden.h: Finally someone at the right temperature.
dialogo.par.frost_warden.frost_warden.a: It's still too warm here. We both agree.
dialogo.par.inquisitor.inquisitor.a: You're on mine. Shall we cross both out together?
dialogo.par.malachar_human.malachar_huma: Are you what I was, or what I am?
What you could still be. Don't make me regret it.
encontro.desertor.texto: A soldier from another garrison beats on the gate. No shield, no banner, the eyes of someone who watched the line fall. He asks for shelter and swears he'll fight.
encontro.desertor.op.aceitar: Accept — a free ally. He may flee when the boss comes, taking 40 gold.
encontro.desertor.op.recusar: Refuse — let him try his luck on the road.
encontro.desertor.op.interrogar: Interrogate — Valdric gets the truth out of him: +60 gold, and he stays for good.
encontro.reliquia.texto: A refugee offers a black-iron amulet in exchange for passage. It's warm in the hand. It gets warmer when you look toward the field.
encontro.reliquia.op.aceitar: Accept — all allies +25% damage; the wall loses 10 HP every wave.
encontro.reliquia.op.vender: Sell it — the merchant pays 120 gold and asks no questions.
encontro.reliquia.op.quebrar: Break it — Alva or Hyo purify the metal: +15% damage for all, no price.
encontro.padre.texto: An old cleric climbs the stair with a bucket of holy water and a ledger. He says stone has a soul too, and souls cost.
encontro.padre.op.pagar: Pay — a blessing on the stone: +150 max wall HP.
encontro.padre.op.oferecer: Offer your weakest ally to the chapel — they leave the team; the wall gains +300 max HP and heals fully.
encontro.padre.op.recusar: Refuse — the stone can look after itself.
encontro.mercador.texto: A man in a patched cloak opens a case full of vials. "Bottled luck," he says. The vials have no labels. He smiles too much.
encontro.mercador.op.pocao: Buy the potion — your next level-up guarantees a Rare card.
encontro.mercador.op.elixir: Buy the elixir — your next level-up guarantees a Legendary card.
encontro.mercador.op.denunciar: Report him — Valdric or Hellel recognize the scam; he flees and drops 80 gold.
encontro.crianca.texto: A child appeared sitting at the gate. No one saw them arrive. They won't say where they're from. They look at your allies like they're choosing one.
encontro.crianca.op.acolher: Take them in — the child follows a random ally: +15% damage and +15% HP for them.
encontro.crianca.op.vila: Send them to the village — the council pays 40 gold for the good deed.
encontro.crianca.op.bola: Give them a ball — Ming hands one over; the child vanishes laughing. +1 summon slot.
encontro.tocha.texto: The wall torches went out on their own, all at once. There was no wind. The field below is darker than it should be.
encontro.tocha.op.reacender: Relight them — 30 gold in oil and peace of mind.
encontro.tocha.op.apagada: Leave them dark — next wave: enemies +30% HP, but every kill pays double gold.
encontro.tocha.op.escuro: Zylvara prefers it — dark wave (as above) and Zylvara gains +20% damage permanently.
encontro.estranho.texto: Someone is sitting atop the wall, back turned, watching the field. No one saw him climb. He doesn't answer when called.
encontro.estranho.op.deixar: Leave him be — he's gone before dawn and leaves something behind: your next level-up guarantees a Legendary.
encontro.estranho.op.expulsar: Drive him off — he climbs down without a word and drops 20 gold.
encontro.estranho.op.perguntar: Malachar recognizes him — they talk late into the night. Malachar gains +15% damage.
encontro.sino.texto: The chapel bell cracked top to bottom on its last ring. It still sounds, but wrong — a note that makes your teeth ache.
encontro.sino.op.consertar: Repair it — the clean toll heals every ally fully and grants +5% damage.
encontro.sino.op.fundir: Melt it into arrowheads — ranged allies +15% damage; the wall loses 50 HP in the casting.
encontro.cova.texto: Behind the wall, a fresh grave, barely covered. No headstone. The dirt on top is still loose, as if someone was in a hurry.
encontro.cova.op.abrir: Dig it up — there might be 150 gold in there. There might be something that wakes up next wave.
encontro.cova.op.respeitar: Respect it — someone thought it was worth burying. Leave it.
encontro.cova.op.acordar: Wake it — Ikan or Morrigan call whoever's down there: a level 3 necromancer joins the team.
encontro.duelo.texto: Two of your allies are really fighting in the courtyard. No one knows why. They both know, and neither will say.
encontro.duelo.op.deixar: Let them fight — one loses 40% HP; the other walks away with +25% permanent damage. Luck decides who.
encontro.duelo.op.separar: Break it up — it's over, no winner.
encontro.duelo.op.tocar: Sonetto plays — they both stop to listen and forget why they were fighting. All allies +10% damage.
encontro.carta.texto: A messenger delivers a sealed letter. The council "demands measurable results." There's a quota written down. There's a fine, too.
encontro.carta.op.aceitar: Accept the quota — 15+ kills next wave: +200 gold. Fewer than that: −100.
encontro.carta.op.rasgar: Tear it up — the messenger pretends not to notice.
encontro.ferreiro.texto: An old smith with white eyes asks to touch your allies' weapons. He says he can feel the wrong weight from afar. He charges to fix it.
encontro.ferreiro.op.deixar: Let him — he gets one right (+20% damage) and one wrong (−5%). Free.
encontro.ferreiro.op.pagar: Pay — with time he does it properly: +15% damage for all.
encontro.nevoa.texto: A fog rolled over the field and stopped there, thick, with no wind to carry it. You can hear the enemy. You can't see them.
encontro.nevoa.op.esperar: Wait it out — they gather: next wave has +20% enemies.
encontro.nevoa.op.avancar: Push into the dark — next wave: enemies −30% HP, but +30% faster.
encontro.cavaleiro.texto: A paladin of another order drags himself to the gate, armor split at the flank. He asks one last favor. He won't say what until you come close.
encontro.cavaleiro.op.curar: Heal him — costs 100 wall HP in blessed stone; he joins the team as a level 4 paladin.
encontro.cavaleiro.op.confissao: Hear his confession — he dies at peace. Your next level-up guarantees a Rare; the wall gains +50 HP.
encontro.cavaleiro.op.honrar: Hellel honors him — buries his brother of the order with his own hands. Hellel gains +20% damage.
encontro.espelho.texto: A black mirror appeared in the middle of the courtyard, tall as a man. It doesn't reflect the courtyard. It reflects the field, and there are more figures in it than there should be.
encontro.espelho.op.olhar: Look — your hero gains +30% damage. The next boss comes with +25% HP.
encontro.espelho.op.cobrir: Cover it with a cloth — and don't look again.
encontro.espelho.op.quebrar: Break it — Ixara or Kael'Vor know this thing. Your hero gains +15% damage, no price.
ui.encontro.desertou: {{nome}} deserted before the boss and took {{n}} gold.
ui.encontro.cotaOk: Quota met: +{{n}} gold from the council.
ui.encontro.covaVazia: The grave was empty. Something stirs in the field.
ui.encontro.res.semEspaco: No room in the party: +{{n}} gold
ui.encontro.res.cota: Next wave: slay {{n}} enemies (+{{ganha}} gold, or −{{perde}})
ui.encontro.res.dreno: The wall loses {{n}} HP every wave
ui.encontro.res.dueloFerido: {{nome}} came out of the duel hurt (−40% health)
ui.encontro.res.ferreiroBom: The smith struck true: +20% damage to {{nome}}
ui.encontro.res.covaVazia: The grave was empty: elite skeletons next wave
ui.modeSelect.modes.solo.label: LONE GUARDIAN
ui.modeSelect.modes.solo.desc: Defend the wall with your hero alone, in endless waves: all 10 acts in sequence, forever. No summons: every card empowers them, and they level faster. Move your hero with WASD or the arrow keys to dodge shots.
ui.mapSelect.title: CHOOSE THE MAP
ui.mapSelect.hint: The map only changes the scenery. Enemies stay the mode's own.
ui.mapSelect.followDesc: The map follows the enemies' act and changes every 30 waves.
ui.mapSelect.followDescRandomizer: Every 30 waves, a random unlocked map.
ui.mapSelect.randomDesc: Draws one unlocked map at the start and stays there.
ui.posto.preferidoDesc: In that grid column this hero gains +{{n}}% damage and +{{n}}% range. Drag to position: the Vanguard (next to the wall) gives +15% damage but draws fire; the Rear gives +20% range, −20% damage and is immune to projectiles.
ui.posto.bonus.berserker: Blood Rage also rises as his own HP drops.
ui.posto.bonus.paladin: Whoever stands directly behind him in the same row takes −25% damage.
ui.posto.bonus.cleric: Her mace strikes back at every enemy hitting the wall (60% of her damage).
ui.posto.bonus.dreadlord: Takes −20% damage: the void holds him up.
ui.posto.bonus.ixara: Gains 2 Fury per hit taken instead of 1.
ui.posto.bonus.vex: Sai Dash hits a 40px wider area.
ui.posto.bonus.jester: +15% attack speed: more balls in the air.
ui.posto.bonus.druid: +15% attack speed: the seasons turn faster.
ui.posto.bonus.archer: +15% extra range: the whole forest is her field.
ui.posto.bonus.warlock: +15% damage: the slow shot hits harder from behind.
ui.posto.bonus.morrigan: Harvests souls from twice as far.
ui.posto.bonus.malachar_human: Solitary counts the empty cells around him, not team slots.
ui.modeSelect.modes.weekly.label: WEEKLY CHALLENGE
ui.modeSelect.modes.weekly.desc: Same run for everyone this week: fixed seed, drawn hero, Normal, Act I. Beat your best.
hero.yue.name: Yue (Dancer)
hero.yue.description: Fan Step: a short dance strike that hits up to 3 enemies. Audience: every enemy within his reach gives +6% damage (max +30%, elites count twice). Every 5th attack, Charm: the audience stops to watch for 1.5s.
hero.yue.lore: Yue danced in the harbor taverns of Grimhold with the lipstick his mother lent him, and never gave it back. When the siege came, the taverns closed and the stage moved to the wall. He says the monsters are the best crowd he ever had: they never look away.
ui.summonCard.yue.title: Summon: Yue
ui.summonCard.yue.desc: The Dancer. Fan Step hits up to 3 enemies. Audience: nearby enemies give him damage (max +30%). Every 5th attack, Charm freezes the audience for 1.5s.
compendium.new-yue.title: Summon: Yue
compendium.new-yue.description: The Dancer. Fan Step: short strike, up to 3 enemies. Audience: each enemy within his reach gives +6% damage (max +30%, elites count twice). Every 5th attack, Charm stops the audience for 1.5s (bosses 0.5s).
compendium.new-yue.flavorText: They came to break the wall. They stayed for the show.
compendium.yue-holofote.title: Spotlight
compendium.yue-holofote.description: ✦ Rare: Audience cap rises from +30% to +50% damage, and the audience reach grows by 60px.
compendium.yue-passo-duplo.title: Double Step
compendium.yue-passo-duplo.description: ✦ Rare: Charm triggers every 4th attack instead of every 5th.
compendium.yue-camarim.title: Dressing Room
compendium.yue-camarim.description: With any enemy in the audience, Yue takes 35% less damage.
compendium.yue-camarim.flavorText: Nobody touches the artist before the show.
compendium.yue-bis.title: Encore
compendium.yue-bis.description: When Charm ends, the audience takes 40% of the damage Yue dealt during it. Yue heals 20% max HP.
compendium.yue-bis.flavorText: One more. They always want one more.
ui.cardx.yue-holofote.title: Spotlight
ui.cardx.yue-passo-duplo.title: Double Step
ui.cardx.yue-passo-duplo.description: Charm triggers every 4th attack instead of every 5th.
ui.cardx.yue-camarim.title: Dressing Room
ui.cardx.yue-camarim.description: With any enemy in the audience, Yue takes 35% less damage.
ui.cardx.yue-camarim.flavorText: Nobody touches the artist before the show.
