ui.cardx.yue-bis.description: When Charm ends, the audience takes 40% of the damage Yue dealt during it. Yue heals 20% max HP.
ui.cardx.yue-bis.flavorText: One more. They always want one more.
ending.yue.name: Yue
ending.yue.title: The Dancer
ending.yue.panel.0: When the last horn faded, Yue was still on the wall, one arm up, waiting for applause that did not come. The guards were too tired. He bowed anyway — you bow to the room you have.
ending.yue.panel.1: The harbor taverns reopened in spring. He went back to the smallest one, the one with the crooked floor, and danced the same steps he had used on the wall. Nobody there knew that. He liked that nobody knew.
ending.yue.panel.2: His mother came on the third night and sat at the back. Afterwards she asked for her lipstick. He said no. She laughed, and that was the review he kept.
dialogo.chegada.yue: Careful, I need room for the finale.
dialogo.reacao.yue: Front row. Good. You will see everything.
dialogo.par.yue.yue.h: Two of us? Then it is a duet.
dialogo.par.yue.yue.a: I lead. You already know the steps.
dialogo.par.yue.billy.h: A gunman. Please do not shoot during the applause.
dialogo.par.yue.billy.a: I shoot on the fourth beat. Count with me.
dialogo.par.billy.yue.h: A dancer. Keep to your half of the stage.
dialogo.par.billy.yue.a: The whole wall is my half.
dialogo.par.yue.bard.a: For you? The fast one, then the faster one.
dialogo.par.bard.yue.h: The harbor dancer. I wrote a verse about you once.
dialogo.par.bard.yue.a: I know. It was in the wrong key.
dialogo.par.yue.jester.h: Ming. No juggling behind me this time.
dialogo.par.yue.jester.a: Behind you is the only place they cannot see me.
dialogo.par.jester.yue.h: Finally, someone who understands an audience.
dialogo.par.jester.yue.a: I understand them. You just confuse them.
hero.billy.name: Billy (Gunslinger)
hero.billy.description: Four Bullets: shots are counted 1-2-3-4. The 4th is a guaranteed critical and deals bonus damage equal to the target's missing HP (up to +100%). After the 4th, he reloads for 1s. Every 4th reload, Curtain: the 4th shot pierces the whole line.
hero.billy.lore: Billy does not talk about where he learned to shoot, only about why: every shot is a line in a play, and the fourth one is the curtain. He never fires a fifth. He says a fifth would be vulgar.
ui.summonCard.billy.title: Summon: Billy
ui.summonCard.billy.desc: The Gunslinger. Shots count 1-2-3-4: the 4th always crits and hits harder the more wounded the target is. Then he reloads. Every 4th reload, the 4th shot pierces the whole line.
compendium.new-billy.title: Summon: Billy
compendium.new-billy.description: The Gunslinger. Four Bullets: the 4th shot is a guaranteed crit with bonus damage equal to the target's missing HP (up to +100%). 1s reload after the 4th. Every 4th reload, Curtain: the 4th shot pierces the whole line.
compendium.new-billy.flavorText: One. Two. Three. The audience holds its breath.
compendium.billy-balas-marcadas.title: Marked Bullets
compendium.billy-balas-marcadas.descript: ✦ Rare: The 4th shot's missing-HP bonus rises to ×1.5 (up to +150%).
compendium.billy-balas-marcadas.flavorTe: He knows where it hurts. He aims there.
compendium.billy-recarga-rapida.title: Quick Reload
compendium.billy-recarga-rapida.descript: ✦ Rare: Reload after the 4th shot takes 0.4s instead of 1s.
compendium.billy-cortina-final.title: Final Curtain
compendium.billy-cortina-final.descripti: ✦ Legendary: Curtain triggers every 2nd reload instead of every 4th.
compendium.billy-cortina-final.flavorTex: Twice the endings. Half the wait.
compendium.billy-obra-prima.title: Masterpiece
compendium.billy-obra-prima.description: Kills by the 4th shot burst into petals: 60% of the shot's damage to enemies within 120px.
compendium.billy-obra-prima.flavorText: Every death a flower. Every flower a signature.
ui.cardx.billy-balas-marcadas.title: Marked Bullets
ui.cardx.billy-balas-marcadas.descriptio: The 4th shot's missing-HP bonus rises to ×1.5 (up to +150%).
ui.cardx.billy-balas-marcadas.flavorText: He knows where it hurts. He aims there.
ui.cardx.billy-recarga-rapida.title: Quick Reload
ui.cardx.billy-cortina-final.title: Final Curtain
ui.cardx.billy-cortina-final.description: Curtain (piercing 4th shot) every 2nd reload instead of every 4th.
ui.cardx.billy-cortina-final.flavorText: Twice the endings. Half the wait.
ui.cardx.billy-obra-prima.title: Masterpiece
ui.cardx.billy-obra-prima.description: Kills by the 4th shot burst into petals: 60% of the shot's damage to enemies within 120px.
ui.cardx.billy-obra-prima.flavorText: Every death a flower. Every flower a signature.
ending.billy.name: Billy
ending.billy.title: The Gunslinger
ending.billy.panel.0: He counted the last shot out loud. Four. Then he holstered, turned his back on the field, and did not look again. Looking again would be a fifth.
ending.billy.panel.1: They found petals on the wall in the morning, real ones, and nobody could say where he had got them in a siege. He did not explain. An explanation is also vulgar.
ending.billy.panel.2: He left before the thanks. Someone saw a top hat on the north road, walking unhurried, keeping time with something only he could hear.
dialogo.chegada.billy: One. Two. Three. Wait for it.
dialogo.reacao.billy: You are standing in my line. Kindly step aside.
dialogo.par.billy.billy.h: Another me. Do we count together or in turns?
dialogo.par.billy.billy.a: In turns. A duet is eight shots, and eight is vulgar.
dialogo.par.billy.archer.h: Ifigenia. Your arrows have no rhythm.
dialogo.par.billy.archer.a: They have aim. Rhythm is for people who miss.
dialogo.par.archer.billy.h: A pistol on my wall. Do not waste shots.
dialogo.par.archer.billy.a: I never do. The fourth is the only one that matters.
dialogo.par.billy.vex.h: Vex. You strike from behind. I strike on four.
dialogo.par.billy.vex.a: Then I will be done before you reach two.
dialogo.par.vex.billy.a: Quiet man. The gun does the talking, four words at a time.
lore.faccao.igreja.desc: Vows, military orders, the Inquisition, and a monastery that teaches healing as a form of war. It sends letters sealed in gold; the ones who actually fight rarely write back.
lore.faccao.colegiado.desc: The school of magic. It expels, readmits, files away. It learned too late that the runes it teaches are alive — not thinking, but aware.
lore.faccao.mata.desc: The Thornwood and what is left of the ancient forest that burned in the Third Rupture. It has no leader. It has memory, and it is very, very angry.
lore.faccao.sombras.desc: Pacts sealed at crossroads, the dead put back to work, the caves of Vel'Arath, witches who count souls. No one trusts them. No one turns them away.
lore.faccao.abismo.desc: Those touched by Chaos who chose to fight it. Each pays a different price for standing on this side of the Rift — and every one of them pays daily.
lore.faccao.grimhold.desc: Those who came from outside or from the people and stayed on the wall: soldiers, performers, hired hands, and a jester nobody remembers hiring. The walls never fell because of them.
lore.lugar.cruzamento: The crossroads of three dead roads
lore.laco.ifigenia_aelindra: Ifigenia still sleeps with an arrow in her hand. Aelindra is the only one who knows without asking — and the only one she would let take it.
lore.laco.hellel_alva: At Vel'Morath, when the mace handle cracked, it was Hellel's hammer that held the gate one more hour. Alva never thanked him. Hellel never asked. The Church called them both insubordinate in the same letter.
lore.laco.valdric_sibilus: Sibilus has been on Valdric's list since the day of the pact. Valdric hasn't crossed the name out because Sibilus still kills on the right side of the wall. They both know "still" is the important word.
lore.laco.serafyne_ixara: Serafyne says Ixara runs too hot and sends her to the far side of the field. Ixara promises not to burn anything. Serafyne brings ice anyway. Neither calls it friendship, and neither fights without the other nearby.
lore.laco.morrigan_ikan: It was Morrigan who taught Ikan the difference between keeping souls and keeping the rest. He learned the half that was useful. She says it was the wrong half, and keeps teaching.
lore.laco.yue_billy: One wall, one stage, two performers. Yue dances on the beat; Billy shoots on four. Each thinks the other is on his half of the stage — and the whole wall is both their halves.
lore.laco.ming_sonetto: Sonetto wrote the only song in which Ming is the hero. Ming never paid for it; Sonetto never charged. They both call it a debt, and neither wants it settled.
lore.laco.veltharion_krash: Krash's "accidental" readmission to the Collegium bore the signature of one of Veltharion's runes. He swears the rune decided on its own. Krash has burned the gate runes three times since. Veltharion still keeps him three paces away.
lore.laco.zylvara_vex: Vex makes noise even when she vanishes. Zylvara misses even in the dark — according to Vex. They've been even for years and are still keeping score.
lore.laco.kaelvor_malachar: Kael'Vor is eaten by the same Chaos Malachar served for four hundred years. One was charged; the other did the charging. They fight side by side without looking at each other, and that is as much forgiveness as the Rift allows.
lore.laco.gorak_hellel: At Ashfen, it was Hellel who came close and said, quietly, that it was over. Gorak stopped. Since then he is the only one Gorak obeys while the axe is still coming down.
lore.laco.aelindra_vindimia: Vindimia learned to bargain with the earth by listening to Aelindra say nothing for three days. The ancient forest did not come back. The sapling that rose on the fourth day, they tend together.
lore.cleric.faccaoTexto: The Church trained Alva for vows and contemplation. She still carries the silver sigil and answers the synod's letters — with a cup of water placed on top. She simply doesn't believe prayer holds a gate when the wood starts to splinter.
lore.cleric.bomEm.0: Holding the front: high HP, and in the right post her mace strikes back at anyone hitting the wall.
lore.cleric.bomEm.1: Blessing: a huge damage spike for the whole army on the waves that matter.
lore.cleric.bomEm.2: Melee teams, where the blessing multiplies many blows at once.
lore.cleric.sofreCom.0: Weak sustained damage outside the blessing — alone, she kills slowly.
lore.cleric.sofreCom.1: Flyers and ranged enemies that never reach the mace.
lore.paladin.faccaoTexto: Hellel is the military order in its purest form: method, warhammer, and a ledger of things still standing that shouldn't be. The Church wishes he showed holy wrath in sermons; he simply notes, executes, and moves to the next target.
lore.paladin.bomEm.0: Undead and demons: holy damage that purifies what Ikan couldn't recruit.
lore.paladin.bomEm.1: Shielding whoever stands behind him in the same row (−25% damage in the right post).
lore.paladin.bomEm.2: Acts where the horde is slow and heavy and the wall needs a shield before it needs damage.
lore.paladin.sofreCom.0: Fast, numerous enemies that slip past before the hammer lands.
lore.paladin.sofreCom.1: Bosses that are neither undead nor demons, where his bonus doesn't apply.
lore.inquisitor.faccaoTexto: The Inquisition granted Valdric full authority and unrestricted jurisdiction. He attends no ceremonies and frequents no gilded halls; he spends his nights updating the ledger he began at nineteen. Malachar heads the very first page.
lore.inquisitor.bomEm.0: Long runs: Verdict stacks permanent damage against every enemy type he kills.
lore.inquisitor.bomEm.1: Bosses: Sentence marks the target and the whole team deals +30% to it; killing a marked boss resets the cooldown.
lore.inquisitor.bomEm.2: Single-target damage teams, which make full use of the mark.
lore.inquisitor.sofreCom.0: Waves with many different enemy types — Verdict is slow to build.
lore.inquisitor.sofreCom.1: The first minutes of a run, before any stacks.
lore.priest.faccaoTexto: Hyo's monastery is the wing of the Church bishops prefer to omit from treaties: monks who treat healing as hand-to-hand combat against fate. He keeps two record books and considers every saved life a direct insult to death.
lore.priest.bomEm.0: Keeping melee heroes alive: healing orbs that seek whoever is hurt most.
lore.priest.bomEm.1: HP-dependent teams — Gorak, Kael'Vor, Ixara — become far more dangerous with him behind them.
lore.priest.bomEm.2: Long attrition waves, where healing is worth more than damage.
lore.priest.sofreCom.0: Almost no damage of his own: without a killer up front, he only delays defeat.
lore.priest.sofreCom.1: Bosses that kill in one hit — there is nothing to heal.
lore.mage.faccaoTexto: The Arcane Collegium keeps a thick folder of reprimands bearing Krash's name. The masters complain his spells are chaotic and lack scholarly elegance; Krash uses those reprimand scrolls to light his pipe and the trench bonfire.
lore.mage.bomEm.0: Reliable area damage from wave one: fireballs that hit groups.
lore.mage.bomEm.1: Scaling with attack speed and range — almost every card makes him better.
lore.mage.bomEm.2: Being the core of any team: he depends on no one to work.
lore.mage.sofreCom.0: High-HP bosses: without a specialist, his damage starts to look small.
lore.mage.sofreCom.1: Low HP — if the front line falls, he falls soon after.
lore.runesmith.faccaoTexto: Veltharion carved runes into Grimhold's foundation decades before the siege, in crevices no one looked at. When the Fourth Rupture erupted, the stones reacted before the sentinels did. The Collegium demanded a theoretical treatise; he replied that stones don't read essays.
lore.runesmith.bomEm.0: Covering the ground with runes that fire on their own — damage that continues while he reloads.
lore.runesmith.bomEm.1: Every fifth shot drops a chain-lightning rune: great against enemy columns.
lore.runesmith.bomEm.2: Aura teams (Sonetto) that speed up both him and the runes.
lore.runesmith.sofreCom.0: Enemies that cross the runes too fast to take real damage.
lore.runesmith.sofreCom.1: Short waves: the runes need time to pay off.
lore.archer.faccaoTexto: Ifigenia formally refused the rank of archer captain with a dismissive shrug. She swore no fealty to Grimhold's crest nor nobility banners; when the city needed someone to drop abominations at five hundred paces through mist, she mounted the tower and drew her bow.
lore.archer.bomEm.0: High attack speed and range: she fires before any other hero sees the enemy.
lore.archer.bomEm.1: Bleed on every hit — damage that keeps ticking while she switches targets.
lore.archer.bomEm.2: Back post: +15% range turns the whole wood into her field.
lore.archer.sofreCom.0: Armored enemies and bosses: fast, light arrows do little against huge HP.
lore.archer.sofreCom.1: Low HP; anything that reaches her wins.
lore.druid.faccaoTexto: Vindimia serves as the voice for the ancient soil that has no mouth: she pleads, persuades, and guides. The woods still smolder with bitterness over past fires; Vindimia ensures all that botanical fury is directed solely at the invading hordes.
lore.druid.bomEm.0: The seasons turn: healing in Spring, damage in Summer, spores in Autumn, freeze and ricochet in Winter.
lore.druid.bomEm.1: Holding hordes: roots and freezes buy time for the whole team.
lore.druid.bomEm.2: Mixed teams that need a little of everything rather than a lot of one thing.
lore.druid.sofreCom.0: Never the best at anything — without a killer beside her, the cycle only delays.
lore.druid.sofreCom.1: Control-immune bosses, where half the seasons do nothing.
lore.sylvanite.faccaoTexto: Aelindra answers neither to military hierarchy nor city councilors. The deep roots anchoring Grimhold's cliffs stir whenever she walks the ramparts, and wildflowers bloom directly over the bloodstains of fallen monsters.
lore.sylvanite.bomEm.0: Passive healing for the whole team every wave, no aiming required.
lore.sylvanite.bomEm.1: Wide-area poison: dense hordes die slowly while the team handles the rest.
lore.sylvanite.bomEm.2: Full range (360°) — works in any post.
lore.sylvanite.sofreCom.0: Single bosses: slow poison and per-wave healing do little against one target.
lore.warlock.faccaoTexto: At every solstice, Sibilus quietly returns to the crossroads milestone to measure his own shadow. It shrinks by a handbreadth with every passing year. When inquisitors question the cost of his pact, he merely straightens his mantle and smiles in silence.
lore.warlock.bomEm.0: Enormous damage per shot: what he hits, feels it.
lore.warlock.bomEm.1: Bosses and armored enemies — few hits, each one heavy.
lore.warlock.bomEm.2: Back post: +15% damage, and the slow shot hits even harder.
lore.warlock.sofreCom.0: Short range and slow rate of fire: fast hordes slip between shots.
lore.warlock.sofreCom.1: Small, numerous enemies, where a 200-damage shot kills the same as a 20.
lore.necromancer.faccaoTexto: No military registry knows where Ikan came from, and he considers questions about his origin a waste of breath. While clerics debate the dignity of the fallen, Ikan gathers battlefield bones and organizes them into silent, obedient cohorts.
lore.necromancer.bomEm.0: A Common Undead at the start of every wave — a front line that costs nothing.
lore.necromancer.bomEm.1: Commanding the dead: fallen enemies can rise again on his side.
lore.necromancer.bomEm.2: Back post: his undead are born with +25% HP.
lore.necromancer.sofreCom.0: Weak direct damage — without the dead, he is just a man with a ledger.
lore.necromancer.sofreCom.1: Holy and area damage, which clears his horde before it reaches anyone.
lore.zylvara.faccaoTexto: The Shadows never question where Zylvara conceals herself between skirmishes. Following the breach, a commander sought her official combat report; he found only an empty chair and a black-bladed dagger driven through the tactical map.
lore.zylvara.bomEm.0: Poison on every arrow: damage that stacks on whatever takes long to die.
lore.zylvara.bomEm.1: Shadow Step: every six attacks she turns immune, appears behind the farthest enemy, and lands a guaranteed triple-damage shot.
lore.zylvara.bomEm.2: Fat targets at the back of the line that no one else can reach.
lore.zylvara.sofreCom.0: Poison-immune enemies take away half of what she does.
lore.zylvara.sofreCom.1: Low HP between one Step and the next.
lore.vex.faccaoTexto: The Shadows broker her services while magistrates look the other way. Vex refuses gold coin: she demands relic shards salvaged from Abyss rifts and vanishes into a violet haze before the treasury can draft a single receipt.
lore.vex.bomEm.0: Sai Rush: every five attacks she teleports to the target and strikes in an area.
lore.vex.bomEm.1: Kills restore HP — the more she kills, the longer she stands.
lore.vex.bomEm.2: Full range (360°): she covers the whole line without leaving her post.
lore.vex.sofreCom.0: Bosses: little to kill, little healing back.
lore.vex.sofreCom.1: Ranged waves — she needs to get close to pay off.
lore.morrigan.faccaoTexto: Morrigan preserves three thick leather-bound tomes recording every soul claimed across four centuries. She watched entire dynasties crumble from atop her tower; Grimhold, in her calculated judgment, stands a fair chance of surviving another winter.
lore.morrigan.bomEm.0: Soul Harvest: every enemy that dies near her becomes a permanent +2% damage and +4px range.
lore.morrigan.bomEm.1: Long runs — the more waves, the more monstrous she gets.
lore.morrigan.bomEm.2: Back post: she harvests souls from twice as far.
lore.morrigan.sofreCom.0: The first waves: she starts weak and needs time.
lore.morrigan.sofreCom.1: Teams that kill far from her — the souls don't reach.
lore.dreadlord.faccaoTexto: Kael'Vor rests against the granite parapet, examining the limits of his own flesh: less living tissue remains than yesterday, yet still enough for another charge. The Abyss demands its daily toll; he settles the debt by reaping monsters.
lore.dreadlord.bomEm.0: Scaling with kills: every death feeds the void; at 15 stacks he becomes catastrophic.
lore.dreadlord.bomEm.1: A sturdy front line: in the right post he takes −20% damage.
lore.dreadlord.bomEm.2: Dense waves with plenty to kill, where the void fills fast.
lore.dreadlord.sofreCom.0: Waves with few enemies — the void doesn't fill.
lore.dreadlord.sofreCom.1: Losing stacks mid-run if the team kills before he does.
lore.ixara.faccaoTexto: Council scribes spent weeks attempting to decipher Ixara's nature, discovering no trace of summoning or pact in the archives. She stands motionless atop the bulwark, watching the Rift with the unyielding patience of one waiting for the exact moment to seal the gate.
lore.ixara.bomEm.0: Taking hits: every blow received becomes Fury (2 per hit in the right post).
lore.ixara.bomEm.1: Chaos Nova at 10 stacks: every non-boss drops to 1 HP and the whole team heals 30.
lore.ixara.bomEm.2: Turning a lost wave around in one stroke.
lore.ixara.sofreCom.0: She is stunned after a full Nova — someone has to hold the field.
lore.ixara.sofreCom.1: Waves where nobody hits her: no Fury, no Nova.
lore.malachar_human.faccaoTexto: Grimhold's Council voted for his immediate imprisonment; frontline generals who witnessed the horror of Act V demanded he be armed. Malachar paid heed to neither: he marched in silence to the most battered breach and took up the watch.
lore.malachar_human.bomEm.0: Chaos Grimoire: four automatic spells, and every 10 souls the next one comes Empowered.
lore.malachar_human.bomEm.1: Loner: +20–80% damage per empty space around him — shines in small teams.
lore.malachar_human.bomEm.2: Ascension, charged by the damage he deals: the highest peak in the game.
lore.malachar_human.sofreCom.0: Full teams that fill the cells around him and kill Loner.
lore.malachar_human.sofreCom.1: Not in the shop: only those who finish Act V meet him.
lore.jester.faccaoTexto: Ming arrived at the gates during the first siege balancing seven juggling spheres. By the close of the third month of ceaseless fighting, sentries noticed eight spheres dancing in his hands. He gave the eighth a secret name and strictly forbade anyone from touching it.
lore.jester.bomEm.0: Three balls, three effects: Red slows, Gold heals an ally, Purple confuses.
lore.jester.bomEm.1: Horde control: confused enemies attack each other.
lore.jester.bomEm.2: Middle post: +15% attack speed, more balls in the air.
lore.jester.sofreCom.0: Low damage of his own — he disrupts, he doesn't kill.
lore.jester.sofreCom.1: Goes out with a bang: if he falls, he takes the neighbors with him.
lore.bard.faccaoTexto: Sonetto maintains no fixed quarters in Grimhold; he belongs to the dusty road connecting one fortress to the next. The ballad he composed during the gate defense ends abruptly on a discordant note — and taverns across the continent perform it faithfully every night.
lore.bard.bomEm.0: Aura: +35% attack speed for everyone in range.
lore.bard.bomEm.1: Multiplying per-shot damage teams — Krash, Ifigenia, Billy become brutal.
lore.bard.bomEm.2: Middle post: the aura reaches 40% farther.
lore.bard.sofreCom.0: Weak direct damage: the aura is only worth what the team around him is worth.
lore.bard.sofreCom.1: Summoner and aura teams, which don't scale with attack speed.
lore.berserker.faccaoTexto: Gorak marched alone across Ashfen's embers to Grimhold's gates with splintered spearheads jutting from his shield. He accepted neither bed nor ration: he simply pointed toward the eastern gate and asked where the largest horrors gather.
lore.berserker.bomEm.0: Blood Rage: the lower the wall's HP, the more damage he deals (up to 3×).
lore.berserker.bomEm.1: Blood Frenzy every 12s: triple attack speed and piercing shots.
lore.berserker.bomEm.2: Saving runs that are nearly lost — he is at his best when everything goes wrong.
lore.berserker.sofreCom.0: Clean runs: with the wall at full HP, Rage never builds.
lore.berserker.sofreCom.1: Too much healing around him is, for him, a problem.
lore.frost_warden.faccaoTexto: When the administrative council sent a formal grievance regarding the perpetual coat of frost encasing the eastern tower in midsummer, Serafyne returned the parchment frozen in a solid block. No one dared dispatch a second notice.
lore.frost_warden.bomEm.0: Ice Plates: three marks on the same spot create a −50% speed zone.
lore.frost_warden.bomEm.1: Glacial Wall every 18s: blocks and wounds whatever tries to pass.
lore.frost_warden.bomEm.2: Buying time for slow, heavy teams to land their hits.
lore.frost_warden.sofreCom.0: Modest damage of her own — she slows the horde, someone has to kill it.
lore.yue.faccaoTexto: He is no infantry soldier, no academy mage, and swore no oaths before the altar. He is Grimhold folk in the truest sense: he was at the docks when the ramparts sealed, and took the parapet because the show must go on as long as there is an audience before him.
lore.yue.bomEm.0: Audience: every enemy in range gives +6% damage (max +30%; elites count double).
lore.yue.bomEm.1: Charm every 5 attacks: the audience stops to watch for 1.5s — control on the front line.
lore.yue.bomEm.2: Fan Step hits up to 3 at once; full range (360°).
lore.yue.sofreCom.0: Empty waves: no audience, no bonus.
lore.yue.sofreCom.1: Bosses: Charm lasts only 0.5s on them.
lore.billy.faccaoTexto: He arrived via the north road sporting a battered top hat and no papers. He never signed the garrison's recruitment register; he simply takes his post on the rampart at dusk, reloading his piece to the precise tempo of a score only he understands.
lore.billy.bomEm.0: Four Bullets: the fourth shot is a guaranteed crit and adds damage equal to the target's missing HP (up to +100%).
lore.billy.bomEm.1: Finishing what the team started — wounded targets die on four.
lore.billy.bomEm.2: Curtain every 4 reloads: the fourth shot pierces the whole line.
lore.billy.sofreCom.0: Reloads for 1s after the fourth — low rate of fire and low HP.
lore.billy.sofreCom.1: Full-health targets: the first three shots are only the prologue.
ui.codex.semLacos: No one yet. The wall is long.
ui.codex.epilogoBloqueado: Finish Act V with this hero to read what happened after.
chefe.goblin_king.chegada: The wall was distracted. I only came to see what was left.
chefe.goblin_king.meio: This wasn't part of the deal!
chefe.goblin_king.morte: Tell them... I wasn't even with the Chaos.
chefe.goblin_king.contra.jester: A jester? They hired a JESTER?
chefe.grim_reaper.chegada: I did not come for the wall. I came for the door.
chefe.grim_reaper.meio: You count the dead. I only harvest them.
chefe.grim_reaper.contra.necromancer: Ikan. You keep what is mine.
chefe.grim_reaper.contra.morrigan: Four hundred and twelve. I count too, witch.
chefe.dragon_lord.chegada: I have burned a forest for less.
chefe.dragon_lord.meio: Stone burns. It only takes longer.
chefe.dragon_lord.morte: The door... does not need me.
chefe.dragon_lord.contra.sylvanite: The tree that was left. I remember the smell.
chefe.dragon_lord.contra.druid: Does your earth still remember me, bargainer?
chefe.orc_warlord.chegada: Zog'Krix talked too much. I don't talk.
chefe.orc_warlord.meio: The horde does not fall back. I fall back for it.
chefe.orc_warlord.morte: What comes after me... has no face.
chefe.orc_warlord.contra.berserker: Ashfen. I was there too, big man.

ui.actSelect.act6.subtitle: The Other Shore
ui.actSelect.act6.lore: Beyond the Rift lies the other side: Grimhold's wall, reflected on a floor of Chaos. Here the cultists who tore open the first Ruptures still keep their candles lit.
ui.victory.act6.subtitle: Act VI — The Other Shore
ui.victory.act6.text: The Fallen Seraph is silenced. The candles of the far shore gutter out, one by one.
ui.victory.act6.tagline: Every shore has another beyond it.

chefe.cultista_mor.chegada: We knocked on that door. Twice.
chefe.cultista_mor.meio: The Rift does not open. It is opened.
chefe.coro.chegada: Eight voices. One prayer. No end.
chefe.coro.meio: Silence one of us and the rest sing louder.
chefe.anjo_caido.chegada: I fell to this side. You fell to the other.
chefe.anjo_caido.meio: Wings are useless where there is no sky.
chefe.irma_de_cassiel.chegada: I searched every face for my sister. None of you is her.
chefe.irma_de_cassiel.contra.cassiel: Cassiel. You fell the wrong way.
chefe.irma_de_cassiel.meio: She chose the wall. I chose what lies behind it.
chefe.serafim_caido.chegada: I kept this shore for a thousand years. You are the first to cross.
chefe.serafim_caido.meio: What you call Chaos is only the shore of something larger.
chefe.serafim_caido.morte: Go on, then. But don't say no one warned you.

ui.actSelect.act7.title: Act VII
ui.actSelect.act7.subtitle: The Shamans' Ravine
ui.actSelect.act7.lore: Past the far shore, the ground splits into a jungle ravine. The beast tribes live here, and their masked shamans raise totems that keep the dead fighting.
ui.victory.act7.subtitle: Act VII — The Shamans' Ravine
ui.victory.act7.text: Ossoth falls and the totems go dark. The tribes pull back into the ravine, carrying their dead for good this time.
achievement.act7_complete.title: Ravine Walker
achievement.act7_complete.description: Cross the Shamans' Ravine and defeat Ossoth (Act VII).
chefe.sapo_rei.chegada: This ravine is my pond. You are the flies.
chefe.kwazul.chegada: The spirits told me you would come. They did not say you would be so few.
chefe.xiphra.chegada: I wait. I always wait. Until you bleed enough.
chefe.xiphra.meio: The weak first. Always the weak first.
chefe.chefe_tribal.chegada: Four tribes. One ravine. No outsiders.
chefe.chefe_tribal.morte: Tell the tribes... the wall walks.
chefe.ossoth.chegada: Ash becomes bone. Bone becomes warrior. Warrior becomes ash. I only turn the wheel.
chefe.ossoth.meio: Rise. It is not over for you yet.

ui.actSelect.act8.title: Act VIII
ui.actSelect.act8.subtitle: The Bottomless Sea
ui.actSelect.act8.lore: Beyond the ravine, the Chaos turns to water. Sunken ruins sleep beneath the waves, the drowned rise from the deep, and the wall stands as the last pier.
ui.victory.act8.subtitle: Act VIII — The Bottomless Sea
ui.victory.act8.text: The Kraken sinks back into the dark and the tide pulls away from the pier. The drowned finally stop rowing.
ui.victory.act8.tagline: Even the deep has a floor.
achievement.act8_complete.title: Bottomless
achievement.act8_complete.description: Cross the Bottomless Sea and defeat the Kraken (Act VIII).
chefe.capitao_afogado.chegada: My ship sank a hundred years ago. My crew still rows.
chefe.garuda.chegada: The storm has no shore. Neither do I.
chefe.garuda.meio: Feel the wind that sinks ships.
chefe.rei_caranguejo.chegada: Everything that falls into the sea becomes mine. You included.
chefe.rei_caranguejo.meio: My shell has weathered a thousand tides.
chefe.serpente_ancia.chegada: I have swum these ruins since before they were ruins.

ui.actSelect.act9.title: Act IX
ui.actSelect.act9.subtitle: The Guardians
ui.actSelect.act9.lore: Past the sea lies the atrium before the belly: stone and ash, and guardians who have let no one through in a thousand years.
ui.victory.act9.subtitle: Act IX — The Guardians
ui.victory.act9.text: The Chimera falls in the ash and the atrium goes silent. No guardian is left standing between the wall and the belly.
achievement.act9_complete.title: Gatebreaker
achievement.act9_complete.description: Get past the Guardians and defeat the Chimera (Act IX).
chefe.general_ossos.chegada: Ranks! Shields! No one passes the gate.
chefe.drider.chegada: Every thread of this web is a traveler who made it this far.
chefe.drider.meio: Rise, children. The table is set.
chefe.estatua_leste.chegada: A thousand years standing. Not one step past this.
chefe.estatua_oeste.chegada: The East guards the dawn. I guard the end.
chefe.estatua_oeste.morte: Then pass. What comes next is not stone.
chefe.quimera.chegada: Three beasts, one hunger. Can you smell it yet?
chefe.quimera.meio: Burn. The belly likes its meat cooked.
chefe.quimera.morte: The door... is open. Good luck inside.

ui.actSelect.act5r.title: Act V
ui.actSelect.act5r.subtitle: The Fall of Grimhold
ui.actSelect.act5r.lore: The wall never fell from the outside. This time it is sold from within: the money, the sword and the knowledge, by three people who swore to guard it.
ui.victory.act5r.subtitle: Act V — The Fall of Grimhold
ui.victory.act5r.text: The Rector falls and does not ask for forgiveness. The portrait with the X was never of the villain: it was of the guard who holds the door on the other side. The Collegium always knew. The Rift opens for good, and Grimhold decides to cross.
ui.victory.act5r.tagline: The problem was never on this side.
ui.actSelect.act10.title: Act X
ui.actSelect.act10.subtitle: The Belly
ui.actSelect.act10.lore: Past the guardians, the Hunger's door. The legion that once marched on the wall came from here, and it is still waiting at the threshold.
ui.victory.act10.subtitle: Act X — The Belly
ui.victory.act10.text: The Hunger falls silent. For the first time in four hundred years there is light inside, and whoever guarded the door walks out free.
ui.victory.act10.tagline: What comes next does not end at a wall.
achievement.act10_complete.title: The Hunger's Door
achievement.act10_complete.description: Go through the door and defeat the Hunger (Act X).
chefe.tesoureiro.chegada: You never read the contracts. I read every one.
chefe.tesoureiro.meio: The Council never knew what you cost. I did. It was little.
chefe.tesoureiro.morte: I paid in advance. No one ever paid me in advance.
chefe.tesoureiro.contra.vex: Vex. Your pay is late again. This time on purpose.
chefe.capitao_ashfen.chegada: Ashfen did not fall. I opened the gate.
chefe.capitao_ashfen.morte: The last one standing... was never me.
chefe.capitao_ashfen.contra.berserker: Gorak. You stood. I knelt. Do you still hate me?
chefe.capitao_ashfen.contra.paladin: Hellel. You prayed for us. It did not help.
chefe.reitor.chegada: I taught half of what you know. The other half I sold.
chefe.reitor.meio: The Collegium knew. It always knew.
chefe.reitor.morte: You defended the wall. Good. The problem was never on this side.
chefe.reitor.contra.mage: Krash. I expelled you twice. It should have been three times.
chefe.reitor.contra.runesmith: Your runes do not obey me. They never did.
fome.transicao: It was not the beginning. Only the door.
fome.coracao: You came all the way inside. Then stay.
corrompido.chegada: I stayed at the door, like him. Now you are the key.
corrompido.meio: I also thought we could get through.
corrompido.libertacao: Thank you. Do not stay here too long.
corrompido.resistiu: You came back... and you are still you.
enemy.fome_ponto.name: Weak Point
enemy.fome_coracao.name: The Heart
enemy.mind_flayer_anciao.name: Elder Mind Flayer
enemy.corrupted.name: {{hero}}, Corrupted
chefe.corrupted_mage.chegada: I blew the door open once. It only opened wider.
chefe.corrupted_mage.meio: Overload is not power. It is hunger.
chefe.corrupted_cleric.chegada: I healed everyone. In here, I heal what eats you.
chefe.corrupted_paladin.chegada: I swore to guard the wall. The Hunger accepted the oath.
chefe.corrupted_paladin.meio: My shield still holds. It just changed sides.
chefe.corrupted_archer.chegada: From here I see all of you. I always did.
chefe.corrupted_archer.meio: Every arrow I ever loosed came back here.
chefe.corrupted_jester.chegada: The joke is good, I swear. It just eats whoever laughs.
chefe.corrupted_jester.meio: Pick a card. Any card. They are all mine.
chefe.corrupted_yue.meio: Stay for the final act. Stay forever.
